========== src/services/admin/admin.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 5;
const LOW_STOCK_LIMIT = 5;

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: -1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const ACTIVE_ORDER_STATUSES = [
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "shipped",
];

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (
    typeof value !== "string" ||
    !/^\d+$/.test(value)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeAdminProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "status",
    "stockStatus",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (
    query.category !== undefined &&
    typeof query.category !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product status filter.");
  }

  const stockStatus = query.stockStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    !["all", "in_stock", "low_stock", "out_of_stock"].includes(
      stockStatus
    )
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid stock status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  };
};

const getDashboardStats = async () => {
  const [
    totalOrders,
    totalProducts,
    totalCustomers,
    activeCustomers,
    inactiveCustomers,
    activeOrders,
    totalCancelledOrders,
    revenueResult,
    orderValueResult,
    cancelledValueResult,
    lowStockCount,
    recentOrders,
    lowStockProducts,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    Order.countDocuments(),

    Product.countDocuments({ isActive: true }),

    User.countDocuments({ role: "customer" }),

    User.countDocuments({
      role: "customer",
      isActive: true,
    }),

    User.countDocuments({
      role: "customer",
      isActive: false,
    }),

    Order.countDocuments({
      status: {
        $in: ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"],
      },
    }),

    Order.countDocuments({ status: "cancelled" }),

    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: {
          paymentStatus: "paid",
          status: { $ne: "cancelled" },
        },
      },
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          total: { $sum: "$total" },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          total: { $sum: "$total" },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: { status: "cancelled" },
      },
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          total: { $sum: "$total" },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Product.countDocuments({
      isActive: true,
      stock: { $lte: 5 },
    }),

    Order.find()
      .select(
        "orderNumber customer.fullName total status paymentStatus createdAt"
      )
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .limit(8)
      .lean(),

    Product.find({
      isActive: true,
      stock: { $lte: 5 },
    })
      .select("name sku price stock image category")
      .sort({ stock: 1 })
      .limit(8)
      .lean(),
  ]);

  return {
    stats: {
      totalRevenue: revenueResult[0]?.total ?? 0,
      totalOrderValue: orderValueResult[0]?.total ?? 0,
      cancelledOrderValue: cancelledValueResult[0]?.total ?? 0,
      totalOrders,
      totalCancelledOrders,
      activeOrders,
      totalProducts,
      totalCustomers,
      activeCustomers,
      inactiveCustomers,
      lowStockCount,
    },
    recentOrders,
    lowStockProducts,
  };
};

const getAdminProducts = async (query = {}) => {
  const {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  } = normalizeAdminProductQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { name: searchRegex },
      { sku: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  if (category) {
    filter.category = category;
  }

  if (stockStatus === "in_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "low_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: 0, $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "out_of_stock") {
    filter.stock = 0;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [products, total, categories] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),

    Product.distinct("category"),
  ]);

  return {
    products,
    categories: categories.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminProductById = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const updateProductStatus = async (productId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: !isActive },
    { $set: { isActive } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  ).lean();

  if (!product) {
    const exists = await Product.exists({ _id: productId });

    if (!exists) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Product not found."
      );
    }

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Product is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const activateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, true);

const deactivateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, false);

const adminService = {
  getDashboardStats,
  getAdminProducts,
  getAdminProductById,
  activateProduct,
  deactivateProduct,
};

export default adminService;


========== src/services/admin/admin-customer.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 10;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_asc: { fullName: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { fullName: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const throwNotFound = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "status",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim() || "";

  if (search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return { search, status, sort, page, limit };
};

const getAdminCustomers = async (query = {}) => {
  const { search, status, sort, page, limit } = normalizeQuery(query);

  const filter = { role: "customer" };

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { fullName: searchRegex },
      { email: searchRegex },
      { phone: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [customers, total] = await Promise.all([
    User.find(filter)
      .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    User.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  const customerIds = customers.map((customer) => customer._id);

  const orderStats = customerIds.length
    ? await Order.aggregate([
        {
          $match: {
            user: { $in: customerIds },
          },
        },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: "$user",
            totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
            deliveredOrders: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0],
              },
            },
            totalOrderValue: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [
                  { $ne: ["$status", "cancelled"] },
                  "$total",
                  0,
                ],
              },
            },
          },
        },
      ])
    : [];

  const statsMap = new Map(
    orderStats.map((item) => [item._id.toString(), item])
  );

  const result = customers.map((customer) => {
    const stats = statsMap.get(customer._id.toString());

    return {
      ...customer,
      orderStats: {
        totalOrders: stats?.totalOrders ?? 0,
        deliveredOrders: stats?.deliveredOrders ?? 0,
        totalOrderValue: stats?.totalOrderValue ?? 0,
      },
    };
  });

  return {
    customers: result,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminCustomerById = async (customerId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOne({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  })
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (!customer) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  const [summaryResult, recentOrders] = await Promise.all([
    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: {
          user: customer._id,
        },
      },
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
          deliveredOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0],
            },
          },
          cancelledOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] }, 1, 0],
            },
          },
          activeOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [
                {
                  $in: [
                    "$status",
                    ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"],
                  ],
                },
                1,
                0,
              ],
            },
          },
          totalOrderValue: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [
                { $ne: ["$status", "cancelled"] },
                "$total",
                0,
              ],
            },
          },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Order.find({ user: customer._id })
      .select(
        "orderNumber status paymentStatus paymentMethod subtotal total items createdAt"
      )
      .sort({ createdAt: -1, _id: -1 })
      .limit(RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT)
      .lean(),
  ]);

  const summary = summaryResult[0] || {
    totalOrders: 0,
    deliveredOrders: 0,
    cancelledOrders: 0,
    activeOrders: 0,
    totalOrderValue: 0,
  };

  return {
    customer,
    summary,
    recentOrders,
  };
};

const updateCustomerStatus = async (customerId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  if (typeof isActive !== "boolean") {
    throwBadRequest("Customer status must be a boolean.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: customerId,
      role: "customer",
      isActive: !isActive,
    },
    {
      $set: { isActive },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  )
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (customer) return customer;

  const exists = await User.exists({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  });

  if (!exists) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  throw new ApiError(
    HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
    `Customer is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
  );
};

const adminCustomerService = {
  getAdminCustomers,
  getAdminCustomerById,
  updateCustomerStatus,
};

export default adminCustomerService;


========== src/services/admin/admin-order.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const ORDER_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "shipped",
  "delivered",
  "cancelled",
]);

const PAYMENT_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "pending",
  "paid",
  "failed",
  "refunded",
]);

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  total_asc: { total: 1, _id: 1 },
  total_desc: { total: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const STATUS_TRANSITIONS = Object.freeze({
  placed: ["confirmed"],
  confirmed: ["processing"],
  processing: ["shipped"],
  shipped: ["delivered"],
  delivered: [],
  cancelled: [],
});

const CANCELLABLE_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
]);

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const validateOrderId = (orderId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(orderId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order ID.");
  }
};

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (
    typeof value !== "string" ||
    !/^\d+$/.test(value)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ||
    parsed < min ||
    parsed > max
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parseDateFilter = (value, field, endOfDay = false) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
    throwBadRequest(`${field} must be a valid date.`);
  }

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    throwBadRequest(`${field} must be a valid date.`);
  }

  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    date.setUTCHours(
      endOfDay ? 23 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 59 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 59 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 999 : 0
    );
  }

  return date;
};

const normalizeListQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "status",
    "paymentStatus",
    "paymentMethod",
    "from",
    "to",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (
    status !== "all" &&
    !ORDER_STATUSES.includes(status)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order status filter.");
  }

  const paymentStatus = query.paymentStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    paymentStatus !== "all" &&
    !PAYMENT_STATUSES.includes(paymentStatus)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid payment status filter.");
  }

  const paymentMethod = query.paymentMethod ?? "all";

  if (
    paymentMethod !== "all" &&
    paymentMethod !== "cod"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid payment method filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  const from =
    query.from === undefined
      ? null
      : parseDateFilter(query.from, "From date");

  const to =
    query.to === undefined
      ? null
      : parseDateFilter(query.to, "To date", true);

  if (from && to && from > to) {
    throwBadRequest("From date cannot be later than to date.");
  }

  return {
    search,
    status,
    paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod,
    from,
    to,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  };
};

const getAdminOrders = async (query = {}) => {
  const {
    search,
    status,
    paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod,
    from,
    to,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  } = normalizeListQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status !== "all") {
    filter.status = status;
  }

  if (paymentStatus !== "all") {
    filter.paymentStatus = paymentStatus;
  }

  if (paymentMethod !== "all") {
    filter.paymentMethod = paymentMethod;
  }

  if (search) {
    const regex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { orderNumber: regex },
      { "customer.fullName": regex },
      { "customer.email": regex },
      { "customer.phone": regex },
    ];
  }

  if (from || to) {
    filter.createdAt = {};

    if (from) filter.createdAt.$gte = from;
    if (to) filter.createdAt.$lte = to;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [orders, total] = await Promise.all([
    Order.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Order.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    orders,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminOrderById = async (orderId) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const order = await Order.findById(orderId).lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  return order;
};

const updateAdminOrderStatus = async (
  orderId,
  status,
  note = ""
) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  if (!ORDER_STATUSES.includes(status) || status === "cancelled") {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order status.");
  }

  const normalizedNote = String(note || "").trim();

  if (normalizedNote.length > 500) {
    throwBadRequest("Status note cannot exceed 500 characters.");
  }

  const order = await Order.findById(orderId).select("status");

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  const allowedNextStatuses = STATUS_TRANSITIONS[order.status] || [];

  if (!allowedNextStatuses.includes(status)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Order cannot move from ${order.status} to ${status}.`
    );
  }

  const updatedOrder = await Order.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: orderId,
      status: order.status,
    },
    {
      $set: { status },
      $push: {
        statusHistory: {
          status,
          timestamp: new Date(),
          note: normalizedNote || `Order status updated to ${status}.`,
        },
      },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  ).lean();

  if (!updatedOrder) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      "Order was updated by another request. Please refresh and try again."
    );
  }

  return updatedOrder;
};

const cancelAdminOrder = async (orderId, reason) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const normalizedReason = String(reason || "").trim();

  if (
    normalizedReason.length < 5 ||
    normalizedReason.length > 500
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Cancellation reason must contain 5 to 500 characters."
    );
  }

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let cancelledOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const order = await Order.findById(orderId).session(session);

      if (!order) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "Order not found."
        );
      }

      if (!CANCELLABLE_STATUSES.includes(order.status)) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
          "This order is no longer eligible for cancellation."
        );
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          { _id: item.product.productId },
          { $inc: { stock: item.quantity } },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.matchedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Unable to restore inventory for ${item.product.name}.`
          );
        }
      }

      const updatedOrder = await Order.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
          _id: orderId,
          status: order.status,
        },
        {
          $set: {
            status: "cancelled",
            cancellationReason: normalizedReason,
          },
          $push: {
            statusHistory: {
              status: "cancelled",
              timestamp: new Date(),
              note: normalizedReason,
            },
          },
        },
        {
          new: true,
          runValidators: true,
          session,
        }
      );

      if (!updatedOrder) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
          "Order status changed. Please refresh and try again."
        );
      }

      cancelledOrder = updatedOrder;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return cancelledOrder.toObject();
};

const adminOrderService = {
  getAdminOrders,
  getAdminOrderById,
  updateAdminOrderStatus,
  cancelAdminOrder,
};

export default adminOrderService;


========== src/services/product/product.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";
import imageService from "./image.service.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: 1 },
  rating: { rating: -1, _id: -1 },
  popular: { bestSeller: -1, reviewCount: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const parseInteger = (value, field, { min, max }) => {
  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parsePrice = (value, field) => {
  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be a valid non-negative number.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parseBoolean = (value, field) => {
  if (value === "true" || value === true) return true;
  if (value === "false" || value === false) return false;

  throwBadRequest(`${field} must be true or false.`);
};

const handleDatabaseError = (error) => {
  if (error?.code === 11000) {
    const duplicateField = Object.keys(error.keyPattern || {})[0];

    const messages = {
      sku: "A product with this SKU already exists.",
      slug: "A product with this slug already exists.",
    };

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      messages[duplicateField] ||
        "A product with these details already exists."
    );
  }

  throw error;
};

// Resolve a category while preserving legacy string compatibility.
const resolveCategory = async ({ categoryId, category }) => {
  if (categoryId !== undefined) {
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(categoryId)) {
      throwBadRequest("Invalid category ID.");
    }

    const categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
      _id: categoryId,
      isActive: true,
    }).select("_id name");

    if (!categoryDocument) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Selected category was not found or is inactive."
      );
    }

    return {
      categoryId: categoryDocument._id,
      category: categoryDocument.name,
    };
  }

  if (category !== undefined) {
    const categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
      name: category,
      isActive: true,
    }).select("_id name");

    if (categoryDocument) {
      return {
        categoryId: categoryDocument._id,
        category: categoryDocument.name,
      };
    }

    // Existing legacy products and clients remain compatible.
    return {
      category,
      categoryId: null,
    };
  }

  return {};
};

const normalizeProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
    "isNewArrival",
    "bestSeller",
    "inStock",
    "minPrice",
    "maxPrice",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (query.search !== undefined && typeof query.search !== "string") {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && typeof query.category !== "string") {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort || "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", {
          min: 1,
          max: 1000000,
        });

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", {
          min: 1,
          max: MAX_LIMIT,
        });

  const minPrice =
    query.minPrice === undefined
      ? undefined
      : parsePrice(query.minPrice, "Minimum price");

  const maxPrice =
    query.maxPrice === undefined
      ? undefined
      : parsePrice(query.maxPrice, "Maximum price");

  if (
    minPrice !== undefined &&
    maxPrice !== undefined &&
    minPrice > maxPrice
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Minimum price cannot exceed maximum price."
    );
  }

  return {
    search,
    category,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
    isNewArrival:
      query.isNewArrival === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.isNewArrival, "isNewArrival"),
    bestSeller:
      query.bestSeller === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.bestSeller, "bestSeller"),
    inStock:
      query.inStock === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.inStock, "inStock"),
    minPrice,
    maxPrice,
  };
};

const getProducts = async (query) => {
  const filters = normalizeProductQuery(query);

  const {
    search,
    category,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
    isNewArrival,
    bestSeller,
    inStock,
    minPrice,
    maxPrice,
  } = filters;

  const filter = { isActive: true };

  if (search) {
    filter.$text = { $search: search };
  }

  if (category) {
    let categoryDocument = null;

    if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(category)) {
      categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
        _id: category,
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name");
    } else {
      categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
        slug: category,
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name");
    }

    if (categoryDocument) {
      filter.$or = [
        { categoryId: categoryDocument._id },
        {
          category: categoryDocument.name,
          categoryId: null,
        },
      ];
    } else {
      // Backward compatibility for legacy category-name filters.
      filter.category = category;
    }
  }

  if (isNewArrival !== undefined) {
    filter.isNewArrival = isNewArrival;
  }

  if (bestSeller !== undefined) {
    filter.bestSeller = bestSeller;
  }

  if (inStock === true) filter.stock = { $gt: 0 };
  if (inStock === false) filter.stock = 0;

  if (minPrice !== undefined || maxPrice !== undefined) {
    filter.price = {};

    if (minPrice !== undefined) {
      filter.price.$gte = minPrice;
    }

    if (maxPrice !== undefined) {
      filter.price.$lte = maxPrice;
    }
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [products, total] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    products,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getProductBySlug = async (slug) => {
  const product = await Product.findOne({
    slug,
    isActive: true,
  }).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const getCategories = async () =>
  Product.distinct("category", { isActive: true });

const createProduct = async (values) => {
  try {
    const categoryValues = await resolveCategory(values);

    return await Product.create({
      ...values,
      ...categoryValues,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    handleDatabaseError(error);
  }
};

const updateProduct = async (productId, values) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId);

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  const previousImages = (product.images || []).map((image) => ({
    url: image.url,
    publicId: image.publicId,
  }));

  const updatedPrice =
    values.price !== undefined ? values.price : product.price;

  const updatedCompareAtPrice =
    values.compareAtPrice !== undefined
      ? values.compareAtPrice
      : product.compareAtPrice;

  if (
    updatedCompareAtPrice !== null &&
    updatedCompareAtPrice !== undefined &&
    updatedCompareAtPrice <= updatedPrice
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Compare-at price must be greater than the selling price."
    );
  }

  const updateValues = { ...values };

  if (
    values.categoryId !== undefined ||
    values.category !== undefined
  ) {
    const categoryValues = await resolveCategory(values);
    Object.assign(updateValues, categoryValues);
  }

  if (updateValues.images?.length > 0) {
    updateValues.image = updateValues.images[0].url;
  }

  try {
    Object.assign(product, updateValues);

    await product.save();

    if (values.images !== undefined) {
      const currentPublicIds = new Set(
        (product.images || []).map((image) => image.publicId)
      );

      const removedImages = previousImages.filter(
        (image) => !currentPublicIds.has(image.publicId)
      );

      if (removedImages.length > 0) {
        await imageService.deleteProductImages(removedImages);
      }
    }

    return product;
  } catch (error) {
    handleDatabaseError(error);
  }
};

const deleteProduct = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: true },
    { $set: { isActive: false } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  );

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const productService = {
  getProducts,
  getProductBySlug,
  getCategories,
  createProduct,
  updateProduct,
  deleteProduct,
};

export default productService;


========== src/services/category/category.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1 },
});

const createSlug = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parsePagination = (query = {}) => {
  const page = Math.max(
    DEFAULT_PAGE,
    Number.parseInt(query.page, 10) || DEFAULT_PAGE
  );

  const limit = Math.min(
    MAX_LIMIT,
    Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(query.limit, 10) || DEFAULT_LIMIT)
  );

  return { page, limit, skip: (page - 1) * limit };
};

const generateUniqueSlug = async (value, excludeId = null) => {
  const baseSlug = createSlug(value);

  if (!baseSlug) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "A valid category name is required."
    );
  }

  let slug = baseSlug;
  let counter = 1;

  while (
    await Category.exists({
      slug,
      ...(excludeId && { _id: { $ne: excludeId } }),
    })
  ) {
    counter += 1;
    slug = `${baseSlug}-${counter}`;
  }

  return slug;
};

const handleDuplicateError = (error) => {
  if (error?.code === 11000) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      "A category with this slug already exists."
    );
  }

  throw error;
};

const getPublicCategories = async () =>
  Category.find({ isActive: true })
    .select("name slug description image")
    .sort({ name: 1 })
    .lean();

const getCategoryBySlug = async (slug) => {
  const category = await Category.findOne({
    slug,
    isActive: true,
  }).lean();

  if (!category) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Category not found."
    );
  }

  return category;
};

const getAdminCategories = async (query = {}) => {
  const { page, limit, skip } = parsePagination(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (query.search?.trim()) {
    const search = escapeRegex(query.search.trim().slice(0, 80));

    filter.$or = [
      { name: { $regex: search, $options: "i" } },
      { slug: { $regex: search, $options: "i" } },
    ];
  }

  if (query.status === "active") {
    filter.isActive = true;
  } else if (query.status === "inactive") {
    filter.isActive = false;
  }

  const sort = SORT_OPTIONS[query.sort] || SORT_OPTIONS.newest;

  const [categories, total] = await Promise.all([
    Category.find(filter)
      .sort(sort)
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Category.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    categories,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const createCategory = async (payload) => {
  try {
    const slug = payload.slug
      ? createSlug(payload.slug)
      : await generateUniqueSlug(payload.name);

    if (!slug) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
        "A valid category slug is required."
      );
    }

    return await Category.create({
      ...payload,
      slug,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    handleDuplicateError(error);
  }
};

const updateCategory = async (categoryId, payload) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(categoryId)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid category ID."
    );
  }

  const category = await Category.findById(categoryId);

  if (!category) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Category not found."
    );
  }

  if (payload.isActive === false && category.isActive) {
    const assignedProducts = await Product.countDocuments({
      category: category.name,
      isActive: true,
    });

    if (assignedProducts > 0) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
        "This category has active products. Reassign those products before deactivating it."
      );
    }
  }

  const previousName = category.name;

  try {
    if (payload.name && payload.name !== category.name) {
      category.name = payload.name;

      category.slug =
        payload.slug || (await generateUniqueSlug(payload.name, categoryId));
    } else if (payload.slug) {
      category.slug = createSlug(payload.slug);
    }

    if (payload.description !== undefined) {
      category.description = payload.description;
    }

    if (payload.image !== undefined) {
      category.image = payload.image;
    }

    if (payload.isActive !== undefined) {
      category.isActive = payload.isActive;
    }

    await category.save();

    if (previousName !== category.name) {
      await Product.updateMany(
        { category: previousName },
        { $set: { category: category.name } }
      );
    }

    return category;
  } catch (error) {
    handleDuplicateError(error);
  }
};

const deactivateCategory = async (categoryId) =>
  updateCategory(categoryId, { isActive: false });

const activateCategory = async (categoryId) =>
  updateCategory(categoryId, { isActive: true });

const categoryService = {
  getPublicCategories,
  getCategoryBySlug,
  getAdminCategories,
  createCategory,
  updateCategory,
  deactivateCategory,
  activateCategory,
};

export default categoryService;

import orderService from "../../services/order/order.service.js";
import ApiResponse from "../../utils/ApiResponse.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const createOrder = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const result = await orderService.createOrder({
      customer: req.body.customer,
      items: req.body.items,
      deliveryMethod: req.body.deliveryMethod,
      paymentMethod: req.body.paymentMethod,
      userId: req.user?._id || null,
    });

    return res.status(HTTP_STATUS.CREATED).json(
      new ApiResponse(
        HTTP_STATUS.CREATED,
        result,
        "Order placed successfully."
      )
    );
  } catch (error) {

  }
};

const getMyOrders = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const orders = await orderService.getCustomerOrders(req.user._id);

    return res.status(HTTP_STATUS.OK).json(

};

========== E:\NexMart\backend\src\services\admin\admin.service.js ==========

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 5;
const LOW_STOCK_LIMIT = 5;

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: -1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (
    typeof value !== "string" ||
    !/^\d+$/.test(value)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeAdminProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "status",
    "stockStatus",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (
    query.category !== undefined &&
    typeof query.category !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product status filter.");
  }

  const stockStatus = query.stockStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    !["all", "in_stock", "low_stock", "out_of_stock"].includes(
      stockStatus
    )
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid stock status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return { search, category, status, stockStatus, sort, page, limit };
};

const getDashboardStats = async () => {
  const [
    totalOrders,
    totalProducts,
    totalCustomers,
    activeOrders,
    revenueResult,
    orderValueResult,
    lowStockCount,
    recentOrders,
    lowStockProducts,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    Order.countDocuments(),

    Product.countDocuments({ isActive: true }),

    User.countDocuments({ role: "customer" }),

    Order.countDocuments({
      status: { $in: ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"] },
    }),

    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: {
          paymentStatus: "paid",
          status: { $ne: "cancelled" },
        },
      },
      { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$total" } } },
    ]),

    Order.aggregate([
      { $match: { status: { $ne: "cancelled" } } },
      { $group: { _id: null, total: { $sum: "$total" } } },
    ]),

    Product.countDocuments({
      isActive: true,
      stock: { $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD },
    }),

    Order.find()
      .select(
        "orderNumber customer.fullName total status paymentStatus createdAt"
      )
      .sort({ createdAt: -1, _id: -1 })
      .limit(RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT)
      .lean(),

    Product.find({
      isActive: true,
      stock: { $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD },
    })
      .select("name sku price stock image category")
      .sort({ stock: 1, _id: 1 })
      .limit(LOW_STOCK_LIMIT)
      .lean(),
  ]);

  return {
    stats: {
      totalRevenue: revenueResult[0]?.total ?? 0,
      totalOrderValue: orderValueResult[0]?.total ?? 0,
      totalOrders,
      activeOrders,
      totalProducts,
      totalCustomers,
      lowStockCount,
    },
    recentOrders,
    lowStockProducts,
  };
};

const getAdminProducts = async (query = {}) => {
  const { search, category, status, stockStatus, sort, page, limit } =
    normalizeAdminProductQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { name: searchRegex },
      { sku: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  if (category) {
    filter.category = category;
  }

  if (stockStatus === "in_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "low_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: 0, $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "out_of_stock") {
    filter.stock = 0;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [products, total, categories] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),

    Product.distinct("category"),
  ]);

  return {
    products,
    categories: categories.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminProductById = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const updateProductStatus = async (productId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: !isActive },
    { $set: { isActive } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  ).lean();

  if (!product) {
    const exists = await Product.exists({ _id: productId });

    if (!exists) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Product not found."
      );
    }

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Product is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const activateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, true);

const deactivateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, false);

const adminService = {
  getDashboardStats,
  getAdminProducts,
  getAdminProductById,
  activateProduct,
  deactivateProduct,
};

export default adminService;


========== E:\NexMart\backend\src\services\order\order.service.js ==========

import { randomBytes, randomUUID, createHash } from "node:crypto";

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";

import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY = 100;
const GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES = 32;

const generateOrderNumber = () =>
  `NEXA-${Date.now().toString().slice(-8)}-${randomUUID()
    .replace(/-/g, "")
    .slice(0, 8)
    .toUpperCase()}`;

const generateGuestAccessToken = () =>
  randomBytes(GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES).toString("hex");

const hashGuestAccessToken = (token) =>
  createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

const normalizeEmail = (email) =>
  String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase();

const sanitizeOrder = (order) => {
  if (!order) return null;

  const safeOrder = order.toObject
    ? order.toObject()
    : { ...order };

  delete safeOrder.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return safeOrder;
};

const validateOrderId = (orderId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(orderId)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid order ID."
    );
  }
};

const createOrder = async ({
  customer,
  items,
  deliveryMethod,
  paymentMethod,
  userId = null,
}) => {
  if (!customer || !Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Required order information is missing."
    );
  }

  if (paymentMethod !== "cod") {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Currently, only Cash on Delivery is available."
    );
  }

  if (!["standard", "express"].includes(deliveryMethod)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid delivery method."
    );
  }

  if (items.length > 50) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "An order cannot contain more than 50 products."
    );
  }

  const normalizedItems = items.map((item) => ({
    sku: String(item.sku || "").trim().toUpperCase(),
    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
  }));

  const uniqueSkus = new Set(
    normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku)
  );

  if (
    uniqueSkus.size !== normalizedItems.length ||
    normalizedItems.some(
      (item) =>
        !item.sku ||
        !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) ||
        item.quantity < 1 ||
        item.quantity > MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY
    )
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid or duplicate products in your order."
    );
  }

  const guestAccessToken = userId
    ? null
    : generateGuestAccessToken();

  const guestAccessTokenHash = guestAccessToken
    ? hashGuestAccessToken(guestAccessToken)
    : null;

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let createdOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const products = await Product.find({
        sku: { $in: normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku) },
        isActive: true,
      }).session(session);

      if (products.length !== normalizedItems.length) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "One or more products are unavailable."
        );
      }

      const productMap = new Map(
        products.map((product) => [product.sku, product])
      );

      const orderItems = [];
      let subtotal = 0;

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        if (!product) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
            `Product ${item.sku} was not found.`
          );
        }

        if (product.stock < item.quantity) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Insufficient stock for ${product.name}.`
          );
        }

        const unitPrice = Number(product.price);
        const lineTotal = unitPrice * item.quantity;

        if (
          !Number.isFinite(unitPrice) ||
          unitPrice < 0 ||
          !Number.isFinite(lineTotal)
        ) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            "Invalid product pricing configuration."
          );
        }

        subtotal += lineTotal;

        orderItems.push({
          product: {
            productId: product._id,
            sku: product.sku,
            name: product.name,
            slug: product.slug,
            image: product.image,
          },
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice,
          lineTotal,
        });
      }

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          {
            _id: product._id,
            isActive: true,
            stock: { $gte: item.quantity },
          },
          {
            $inc: { stock: -item.quantity },
          },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.modifiedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Stock changed for ${product.name}. Please try again.`
          );
        }
      }

      const orderData = {
        orderNumber: generateOrderNumber(),
        user: userId || null,
        guestAccessTokenHash,
        customer: {
          fullName: customer.fullName.trim(),
          email: normalizeEmail(customer.email),
          phone: customer.phone.trim(),
          addressLine1: customer.addressLine1.trim(),
          addressLine2: customer.addressLine2?.trim() || "",
          city: customer.city.trim(),
          province: customer.province.trim(),
          postalCode: customer.postalCode.trim(),
        },
        items: orderItems,
        subtotal,
        deliveryFee: null,
        total: subtotal,
        deliveryMethod,
        paymentMethod: "cod",
        paymentStatus: "pending",
        status: "placed",
        statusHistory: [
          {
            status: "placed",
            timestamp: new Date(),
            note: "Your order has been successfully placed.",
          },
        ],
      };

      const [order] = await Order.create(
        [orderData],
        { session }
      );

      createdOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return {
    order: sanitizeOrder(createdOrder),
    guestAccessToken,
  };
};

const getCustomerOrders = async (userId) => {
  return Order.find({ user: userId })
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .lean();
};

const getCustomerOrderById = async (orderId, userId) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: userId,
  }).lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  return order;
};

const getGuestOrderConfirmation = async (
  orderId,
  accessToken
) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  if (
    typeof accessToken !== "string" ||
    !/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(accessToken)
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
      "Invalid order access credentials."
    );
  }

  const tokenHash = hashGuestAccessToken(accessToken);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: null,
    guestAccessTokenHash: tokenHash,
  })
    .select("+guestAccessTokenHash")
    .lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found or access denied."
    );
  }

  delete order.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return order;
};

const cancelOrder = async (orderId, userId, reason) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const normalizedReason = String(reason || "").trim();

  if (
    normalizedReason.length < 5 ||
    normalizedReason.length > 500
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Cancellation reason must contain 5 to 500 characters."
    );
  }

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let cancelledOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const order = await Order.findOne({
        _id: orderId,
        user: userId,
      }).session(session);

      if (!order) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "Order not found."
        );
      }

      if (
        !["placed", "confirmed", "processing"].includes(
          order.status
        )
      ) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
          "This order is no longer eligible for cancellation."
        );
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          { _id: item.product.productId },
          { $inc: { stock: item.quantity } },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.matchedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            "Unable to restore product inventory."
          );
        }
      }

      order.status = "cancelled";
      order.cancellationReason = normalizedReason;

      order.statusHistory.push({
        status: "cancelled",
        timestamp: new Date(),
        note: normalizedReason,
      });

      await order.save({ session });

      cancelledOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return sanitizeOrder(cancelledOrder);
};

const orderService = {
  createOrder,
  getCustomerOrders,
  getCustomerOrderById,
  getGuestOrderConfirmation,
  cancelOrder,
};

export default orderService;

import { z } from "zod";

const customerSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().trim().min(3).max(80),
  email: z.string().trim().email().max(254),
  phone: z.string().trim().min(7).max(20),
  addressLine1: z.string().trim().min(5).max(200),
  addressLine2: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().default(""),
  city: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  province: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  postalCode: z.string().trim().min(2).max(20),
}).strict();

const orderItemSchema = z.object({
  sku: z.string().trim().min(3).max(40).transform((value) =>
    value.toUpperCase()
  ),
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(100),
}).strict();

export const createOrderSchema = z.object({
  customer: customerSchema,
  items: z.array(orderItemSchema).min(1).max(50),
  deliveryMethod: z.enum(["standard", "express"]),
  paymentMethod: z.literal("cod"),
}).strict();

export const cancelOrderSchema = z.object({
  reason: z.string().trim().min(5).max(500),
}).strict();

export const guestOrderConfirmationSchema = z.object({
  accessToken: z.string().regex(
    /^[a-f\d]{64}$/i,
    "Invalid guest order access token."
  ),
}).strict();

import express from "express";
import cors from "cors";
import helmet from "helmet";
import cookieParser from "cookie-parser";
import rateLimit from "express-rate-limit";

import authRoutes from "./routes/auth/auth.routes.js";
import orderRoutes from "./routes/order/order.routes.js";
import productRoutes from "./routes/product/product.routes.js";
import adminRoutes from "./routes/admin/admin.routes.js";

import notFoundMiddleware from "./middleware/not-found.middleware.js";
import errorMiddleware from "./middleware/error.middleware.js";
import categoryRoutes from "./routes/category/category.routes.js";
import adminCategoryRoutes from "./routes/category/category.admin.routes.js";
const app = express();

// Security
app.use(helmet());

app.use(
  cors({
    origin: process.env.CLIENT_URL,
    credentials: true,
  })
);

// Request parsing
app.use(express.json({ limit: "10kb" }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: "10kb" }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// API rate limiting
const apiLimiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  limit: 100,
  standardHeaders: "draft-7",
  legacyHeaders: false,
  message: {
    success: false,
    message: "Too many requests. Please try again later.",
  },
});

app.use("/api", apiLimiter);

// Health check
app.get("/api/v1/health", (req, res) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    message: "NexaMart API is operational.",
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
  });
});

// API routes
app.use("/api/v1/products", productRoutes);
app.use("/api/v1/orders", orderRoutes);
app.use("/api/v1/auth", authRoutes);
app.use("/api/v1/admin", adminRoutes);
app.use("/api/v1/categories", categoryRoutes);
app.use("/api/v1/admin/categories", adminCategoryRoutes);

// Error handling
app.use(notFoundMiddleware);
app.use(errorMiddleware);

export default app;

import { v2 as cloudinary } from "cloudinary";

const getCloudinary = () => {
  const {
    CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME,
    CLOUDINARY_API_KEY,
    CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET,
  } = process.env;

  if (
    !CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME ||
    !CLOUDINARY_API_KEY ||
    !CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
  ) {
    throw new Error("Cloudinary credentials are not configured.");
  }

  cloudinary.config({
    cloud_name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME,
    api_key: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY,
    api_secret: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET,
    secure: true,
  });

  return cloudinary;
};

export default getCloudinary;

import mongoose from "mongoose";

const connectDatabase = async () => {
  const databaseUri = process.env.MONGODB_URI;

  if (!databaseUri) {
    throw new Error("MONGODB_URI is not configured.");
  }

  const connection = await mongoose.connect(databaseUri);

  console.log(
    `MongoDB connected: ${connection.connection.host}`
  );

  return connection;
};

export default connectDatabase;

import authService from "../../services/auth/auth.service.js";
import ApiResponse from "../../utils/ApiResponse.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const COOKIE_NAME = "nexamart_access_token";

const getCookieOptions = () => ({
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
  sameSite: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "none" : "lax",
  path: "/",
  maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
});

const register = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { user, token } = await authService.register(req.body);

    res.cookie(COOKIE_NAME, token, getCookieOptions());

    return res.status(HTTP_STATUS.CREATED).json(
      new ApiResponse(
        HTTP_STATUS.CREATED,
        { user },
        "Account created successfully."
      )
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
};

const login = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { user, token } = await authService.login(req.body);

    res.cookie(COOKIE_NAME, token, getCookieOptions());

    return res.status(HTTP_STATUS.OK).json(
      new ApiResponse(
        HTTP_STATUS.OK,
        { user },
        "Signed in successfully."
      )
    );
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
};

const logout = (req, res) => {
  const options = getCookieOptions();
  delete options.maxAge;

  res.clearCookie(COOKIE_NAME, options);

  return res.status(HTTP_STATUS.OK).json(
    new ApiResponse(
      HTTP_STATUS.OK,
      null,
      "Signed out successfully."
    )
  );
};

const authController = {
  register,
  login,
  logout,
};

export default authController;

import ApiError from "../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../constants/index.js";

const authorizeAdmin = (req, res, next) => {
  if (!req.user || req.user.role !== "admin") {
    return next(
      new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.FORBIDDEN,
        "You do not have permission to perform this action."
      )
    );
  }

  return next();
};

export default authorizeAdmin;



================================================================================
FILE: backend\src\middleware\auth\auth.middleware.js
================================================================================

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const COOKIE_NAME = "nexamart_access_token";

const authenticate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const token = req.cookies?.[COOKIE_NAME];

    if (!token) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
        "Authentication required. Please sign in."
      );
    }

    const payload = jwt.verify(
      token,
      process.env.JWT_SECRET,
      {
        issuer: "nexamart-api",
        audience: "nexamart-client",
      }
    );

    if (!payload.sub) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
        "Invalid authentication session."
      );
    }

    const user = await User.findById(payload.sub).select(
      "_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt"
    );

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
        "Your session is no longer valid."
      );
    }

    req.user = user;

    return next();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) {
      return next(error);
    }

    if (
      error.name === "JsonWebTokenError" ||
      error.name === "TokenExpiredError" ||
      error.name === "NotBeforeError"
    ) {
      return next(
        new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
          "Invalid or expired session."
        )
      );
    }

    return next(error);
  }
};

export default authenticate;

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const COOKIE_NAME = "nexamart_access_token";

const optionalAuthenticate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const token = req.cookies?.[COOKIE_NAME];

    if (!token) {
      return next();
    }

    const payload = jwt.verify(
      token,
      process.env.JWT_SECRET,
      {
        issuer: "nexamart-api",
        audience: "nexamart-client",
      }
    );

    const user = await User.findById(payload.sub).select(
      "_id fullName email phone role isActive"
    );

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
        "Your session is no longer valid."
      );
    }

    req.user = user;

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ApiError) {
      return next(error);
    }

    if (
      error.name === "JsonWebTokenError" ||
      error.name === "TokenExpiredError"
    ) {
      return next(
        new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
          "Invalid or expired session."
        )
      );
    }

    next(error);
  }
};

export default optionalAuthenticate;

FILE: backend\src\middleware\error.middleware.js

const errorMiddleware = (err, req, res, next) => {
  const statusCode = err.statusCode || 500;

  const response = {
    success: false,
    message:
      statusCode === 500
        ? "Internal server error."
        : err.message,
    errors: err.errors || [],
  };

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
    response.stack = err.stack;
  }

  res.status(statusCode).json(response);
};

export default errorMiddleware;

FILE: backend\src\middleware\upload.middleware.js
================================================================================

import multer from "multer";

import ApiError from "../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../constants/index.js";

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_FILES = 8;

const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
  "image/avif",
]);

const upload = multer({
  storage: multer.memoryStorage(),

  limits: {
    fileSize: MAX_FILE_SIZE,
    files: MAX_FILES,
  },

  fileFilter: (req, file, callback) => {
    if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(file.mimetype)) {
      return callback(
        new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
          "Only JPG, PNG, WEBP and AVIF images are allowed."
        )
      );
    }

    callback(null, true);
  },
});

const uploadProductImages = (req, res, next) => {
  upload.array("images", MAX_FILES)(req, res, (error) => {
    if (!error) {
      return next();
    }

    if (error instanceof multer.MulterError) {
      const message =
        error.code === "LIMIT_FILE_SIZE"
          ? "Each image must be 5 MB or smaller."
          : error.code === "LIMIT_FILE_COUNT"
            ? `You can upload a maximum of ${MAX_FILES} images.`
            : "Invalid image upload request.";

      return next(
        new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message)
      );
    }

    next(error);
  });
};

export default uploadProductImages;

FILE: backend\src\middleware\validate.middleware.js

import ApiError from "../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../constants/index.js";

const validate = (schema) => (req, res, next) => {
  const result = schema.safeParse(req.body);

  if (!result.success) {
    const errors = result.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
      field: issue.path.join("."),
      message: issue.message,
    }));

    return next(
      new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
        "Request validation failed.",
        errors
      )
    );
  }

  req.body = result.data;
  next();
};

export default validate;

import mongoose from "mongoose";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

const userSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    fullName: {
      type: String,
      required: [true, "Full name is required."],
      trim: true,
      minlength: 3,
      maxlength: 80,
    },

    email: {
      type: String,
      required: [true, "Email address is required."],
      unique: true,
      lowercase: true,
      trim: true,
      index: true,
    },

    phone: {
      type: String,
      required: [true, "Phone number is required."],
      trim: true,
    },

    password: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      minlength: 8,
      select: false,
    },

    role: {
      type: String,
      enum: ["customer", "admin"],
      default: "customer",
    },

    isActive: {
      type: Boolean,
      default: true,
    },
  },
  {
    timestamps: true,
    versionKey: false,
  }
);

userSchema.pre("save", async function () {
  if (!this.isModified("password")) return;

  this.password = await bcrypt.hash(this.password, 12);
});

userSchema.methods.comparePassword = async function (candidatePassword) {
  return bcrypt.compare(candidatePassword, this.password);
};

const User = mongoose.model("User", userSchema);

export default User;

FILE: backend\src\scripts\promote-admin.js

import "dotenv/config";
import mongoose from "mongoose";

import User from "../models/user/User.model.js";

const promoteAdmin = async () => {
  const databaseUri = process.env.MONGODB_URI;
  const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL?.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!databaseUri) {
    throw new Error("MONGODB_URI is not configured.");
  }

  if (!adminEmail) {
    throw new Error("ADMIN_EMAIL is not configured.");
  }

  await mongoose.connect(databaseUri);

  const user = await User.findOne({ email: adminEmail }).select(
    "_id email role isActive"
  );

  if (!user) {
    throw new Error("No account found for the specified admin email.");
  }

  if (!user.isActive) {
    throw new Error("Inactive accounts cannot be promoted.");
  }

  if (user.role === "admin") {
    console.log("Account already has admin privileges.");
    return;
  }

  if (user.role !== "customer") {
    throw new Error("Account has an unsupported role.");
  }

  const updatedUser = await User.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: user._id,
      role: "customer",
      isActive: true,
    },
    {
      $set: { role: "admin" },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  ).select("_id email role");

  if (!updatedUser) {
    throw new Error("Admin promotion failed. Please retry.");
  }

  console.log("Admin account successfully promoted.");
  console.log(`Email: ${updatedUser.email}`);
  console.log(`Role: ${updatedUser.role}`);
};

try {
  await promoteAdmin();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("Admin promotion failed:", error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  if (mongoose.connection.readyState !== 0) {
    await mongoose.disconnect();
  }
}

const seedProducts = async () => {
  if (!process.env.MONGODB_URI) {
    throw new Error("MONGODB_URI is not configured.");
  }

  await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI);

  console.log("MongoDB connected. Seeding products...");

  const migrationResult = await Product.collection.updateMany(
  {
    isNew: { $exists: true },
    isNewArrival: { $exists: false },
  },
  {
    $rename: {
      isNew: "isNewArrival",
    },
  }
);

console.log(
  `Migrated product fields: ${migrationResult.modifiedCount}`
);

  const operations = products.map((product) => ({
    updateOne: {
      filter: { sku: product.sku },
      update: {
        $setOnInsert: product,
      },
      upsert: true,
    },
  }));

  const result = await Product.bulkWrite(operations, {
    ordered: true,
  });

  console.log("Product seeding completed.");
  console.log(`Inserted: ${result.upsertedCount}`);
  console.log(`Already existing: ${result.matchedCount}`);

  const totalProducts = await Product.countDocuments();

  console.log(`Total products in database: ${totalProducts}`);
};

try {
  await seedProducts();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("Product seeding failed:", error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  await mongoose.disconnect();
}
