import "dotenv/config";

import app from "./app.js";
import connectDatabase from "./config/database.js";

const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;

const startServer = async () => {
  try {
    await connectDatabase();

    const server = app.listen(PORT, () => {
      console.log(
        `NexaMart API running on port ${PORT}`
      );
    });

    const shutdown = (signal) => {
      console.log(`${signal} received. Shutting down...`);

      server.close(async () => {
        try {
          const mongoose = await import("mongoose");
          await mongoose.default.connection.close();
          process.exit(0);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Shutdown error:", error);
          process.exit(1);
        }
      });
    };

    process.on("SIGTERM", () => shutdown("SIGTERM"));
    process.on("SIGINT", () => shutdown("SIGINT"));

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Server startup failed:", error.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
};

startServer();

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 8;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 8;
const LOW_STOCK_LIMIT = 8;

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: -1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const ACTIVE_ORDER_STATUSES = [
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "shipped",
];

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");


const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  const normalizedValue = String(value);

  if (!/^\d+$/.test(normalizedValue)) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(normalizedValue);

  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ||
    parsed < min ||
    parsed > max
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};


const normalizeAdminProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "status",
    "stockStatus",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (
    query.category !== undefined &&
    typeof query.category !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product status filter.");
  }

  const stockStatus = query.stockStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    !["all", "in_stock", "low_stock", "out_of_stock"].includes(
      stockStatus
    )
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid stock status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  };
};

const getDashboardStats = async () => {
 

const [
  totalOrders,
  totalProducts,
  totalCustomers,
  activeCustomers,
  inactiveCustomers,
  activeOrders,
  totalCancelledOrders,
  revenueResult,
  orderValueResult,
  cancelledValueResult,
  lowStockCount,
  recentOrders,
  lowStockProducts,
] = await Promise.all([
  Order.countDocuments(),

  Product.countDocuments({ isActive: true }),

  User.countDocuments({ role: "customer" }),

  User.countDocuments({
    role: "customer",
    isActive: true,
  }),

  User.countDocuments({
    role: "customer",
    isActive: false,
  }),

  Order.countDocuments({
    status: {
      $in: ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"],
    },
  }),

  Order.countDocuments({ status: "cancelled" }),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $match: {
        paymentStatus: "paid",
        status: { $ne: "cancelled" },
      },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $match: { status: "cancelled" },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Product.countDocuments({
    isActive: true,
    stock: { $lte: 5 },
  }),

  Order.find()
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .limit(8)
    .select(
      "orderNumber customer.fullName total status paymentStatus createdAt"
    )
    .lean(),

  Product.find({
    isActive: true,
    stock: { $lte: 5 },
  })
    .sort({ stock: 1 })
    .limit(8)
    .select("name sku price stock image category")
    .lean(),
]);

const stats = {
  totalRevenue: revenueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  totalOrderValue: orderValueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  cancelledOrderValue: cancelledValueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  totalOrders,
  totalCancelledOrders,
  activeOrders,
  totalProducts,
  totalCustomers,
  activeCustomers,
  inactiveCustomers,
  lowStockCount,
};

return {
  stats,
  recentOrders,
  lowStockProducts,
};
};


const getAdminProducts = async (query = {}) => {
  const {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  } = normalizeAdminProductQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { name: searchRegex },
      { sku: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  if (category) {
    const categoryDocument = mongoose.isValidObjectId(category)
      ? await Category.findOne({ _id: category, isActive: true })
          .select("_id name")
          .lean()
      : await Category.findOne({
          isActive: true,
          $or: [
            { slug: category },
            {
              name: {
                $regex: `^${escapeRegex(category)}$`,
                $options: "i",
              },
            },
          ],
        })
          .select("_id name")
          .lean();

    const categoryFilter = categoryDocument
      ? {
          $or: [
            { categoryId: categoryDocument._id },
            {
              category: categoryDocument.name,
              categoryId: null,
            },
            {
              category: categoryDocument.name,
              categoryId: { $exists: false },
            },
          ],
        }
      : { category };

    filter.$and = [
      ...(filter.$and || []),
      categoryFilter,
    ];
  }

  if (stockStatus === "in_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "low_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: 0, $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "out_of_stock") {
    filter.stock = 0;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [
    products,
    total,
    categoryDocuments,
    legacyCategories,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),

    Category.find({ isActive: true })
      .select("name")
      .lean(),

    Product.distinct("category"),
  ]);

  const categoryNames = new Map();

  for (const name of [
    ...categoryDocuments.map((item) => item.name),
    ...legacyCategories,
  ]) {
    if (typeof name !== "string" || !name.trim()) continue;

    const normalizedName = name.trim();
    const key = normalizedName.toLocaleLowerCase();

    if (!categoryNames.has(key)) {
      categoryNames.set(key, normalizedName);
    }
  }

  return {
    products,
    categories: [...categoryNames.values()].sort((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b)
    ),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminProductById = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const updateProductStatus = async (productId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: !isActive },
    { $set: { isActive } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  ).lean();

  if (!product) {
    const exists = await Product.exists({ _id: productId });

    if (!exists) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Product not found."
      );
    }

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Product is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const activateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, true);

const deactivateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, false);

const adminService = {
  getDashboardStats,
  getAdminProducts,
  getAdminProductById,
  activateProduct,
  deactivateProduct,
};

export default adminService;

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 10;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_asc: { fullName: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { fullName: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const throwNotFound = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "status",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim() || "";

  if (search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return { search, status, sort, page, limit };
};

const getAdminCustomers = async (query = {}) => {
  const { search, status, sort, page, limit } = normalizeQuery(query);

  const filter = { role: "customer" };

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { fullName: searchRegex },
      { email: searchRegex },
      { phone: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [customers, total] = await Promise.all([
    User.find(filter)
      .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    User.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  const customerIds = customers.map((customer) => customer._id);

  const orderStats = customerIds.length
    ? await Order.aggregate([
        {
          $match: {
            user: { $in: customerIds },
          },
        },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: "$user",
            totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
            deliveredOrders: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0],
              },
            },
            totalOrderValue: { $sum: "$total" },
            cancelledOrderValue: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [
                  { $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] },
                  "$total",
                  0,
                ],
              },
            },
          },
        },
      ])
    : [];

  const statsMap = new Map(
    orderStats.map((item) => [item._id.toString(), item])
  );

  const result = customers.map((customer) => {
    const stats = statsMap.get(customer._id.toString());

    return {
      ...customer,
      orderStats: {
        totalOrders: stats?.totalOrders ?? 0,
        deliveredOrders: stats?.deliveredOrders ?? 0,
        totalOrderValue: stats?.totalOrderValue ?? 0,
        cancelledOrderValue: stats?.cancelledOrderValue ?? 0,
      },
    };
  });

  return {
    customers: result,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminCustomerById = async (customerId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOne({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  })
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (!customer) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  const [summaryResult, recentOrders] = await Promise.all([
    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: {
          user: customer._id,
        },
      },
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
          deliveredOrders: {
            $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0] },
          },
          cancelledOrders: {
            $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] }, 1, 0] },
          },
          activeOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [
                {
                  $in: ["$status", ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"]],
                },
                1,
                0,
              ],
            },
          },
          totalOrderValue: { $sum: "$total" },
          cancelledOrderValue: {
            $sum: { $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] }, "$total", 0] },
          },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Order.find({ user: customer._id })
      .select(
        "orderNumber status paymentStatus paymentMethod subtotal total items createdAt"
      )
      .sort({ createdAt: -1, _id: -1 })
      .limit(RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT)
      .lean(),
  ]);

  const summary = summaryResult[0] || {
    totalOrders: 0,
    deliveredOrders: 0,
    cancelledOrders: 0,
    activeOrders: 0,
    totalOrderValue: 0,
    cancelledOrderValue: 0,
  };

  return {
    customer,
    summary,
    recentOrders,
  };
};

const updateCustomerStatus = async (customerId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  if (typeof isActive !== "boolean") {
    throwBadRequest("Customer status must be a boolean.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: customerId,
      role: "customer",
      isActive: !isActive,
    },
    {
      $set: { isActive },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  )
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (customer) return customer;

  const exists = await User.exists({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  });

  if (!exists) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  throw new ApiError(
    HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
    `Customer is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
  );
};

const adminCustomerService = {
  getAdminCustomers,
  getAdminCustomerById,
  updateCustomerStatus,
};

export default adminCustomerService;


================================================================================
FILE: backend\src\services\admin\admin-order.service.js
================================================================================

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const ORDER_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "shipped",
  "delivered",
  "cancelled",
]);

const PAYMENT_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "pending",
  "paid",
  "failed",
  "refunded",
]);

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  total_asc: { total: 1, _id: 1 },
  total_desc: { total: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const STATUS_TRANSITIONS = Object.freeze({
  placed: ["confirmed"],
  confirmed: ["processing"],
  processing: ["shipped"],
  shipped: ["delivered"],
  delivered: [],
  cancelled: [],
});

const CANCELLABLE_STATUSES = Object.freeze([
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
]);

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const validateOrderId = (orderId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(orderId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order ID.");
  }
};

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (
    typeof value !== "string" ||
    !/^\d+$/.test(value)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ||
    parsed < min ||
    parsed > max
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parseDateFilter = (value, field, endOfDay = false) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
    throwBadRequest(`${field} must be a valid date.`);
  }

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    throwBadRequest(`${field} must be a valid date.`);
  }

  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    date.setUTCHours(
      endOfDay ? 23 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 59 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 59 : 0,
      endOfDay ? 999 : 0
    );
  }

  return date;
};

const normalizeListQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "status",
    "paymentStatus",
    "paymentMethod",
    "from",
    "to",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (
    status !== "all" &&
    !ORDER_STATUSES.includes(status)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order status filter.");
  }

  const paymentStatus = query.paymentStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    paymentStatus !== "all" &&
    !PAYMENT_STATUSES.includes(paymentStatus)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid payment status filter.");
  }

  const paymentMethod = query.paymentMethod ?? "all";

  if (
    paymentMethod !== "all" &&
    paymentMethod !== "cod"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid payment method filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  const from =
    query.from === undefined
      ? null
      : parseDateFilter(query.from, "From date");

  const to =
    query.to === undefined
      ? null
      : parseDateFilter(query.to, "To date", true);

  if (from && to && from > to) {
    throwBadRequest("From date cannot be later than to date.");
  }

  return {
    search,
    status,
    paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod,
    from,
    to,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  };
};

const getAdminOrders = async (query = {}) => {
  const {
    search,
    status,
    paymentStatus,
    paymentMethod,
    from,
    to,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  } = normalizeListQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status !== "all") {
    filter.status = status;
  }

  if (paymentStatus !== "all") {
    filter.paymentStatus = paymentStatus;
  }

  if (paymentMethod !== "all") {
    filter.paymentMethod = paymentMethod;
  }

  if (search) {
    const regex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { orderNumber: regex },
      { "customer.fullName": regex },
      { "customer.email": regex },
      { "customer.phone": regex },
    ];
  }

  if (from || to) {
    filter.createdAt = {};

    if (from) filter.createdAt.$gte = from;
    if (to) filter.createdAt.$lte = to;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [orders, total] = await Promise.all([
    Order.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Order.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    orders,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminOrderById = async (orderId) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const order = await Order.findById(orderId).lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  return order;
};

const updateAdminOrderStatus = async (
  orderId,
  status,
  note = ""
) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  if (!ORDER_STATUSES.includes(status) || status === "cancelled") {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid order status.");
  }

  const normalizedNote = String(note || "").trim();

  if (normalizedNote.length > 500) {
    throwBadRequest("Status note cannot exceed 500 characters.");
  }

  const order = await Order.findById(orderId).select("status");

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  const allowedNextStatuses = STATUS_TRANSITIONS[order.status] || [];

  if (!allowedNextStatuses.includes(status)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Order cannot move from ${order.status} to ${status}.`
    );
  }

  const updatedOrder = await Order.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: orderId,
      status: order.status,
    },
    {
      $set: { status },
      $push: {
        statusHistory: {
          status,
          timestamp: new Date(),
          note: normalizedNote || `Order status updated to ${status}.`,
        },
      },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  ).lean();

  if (!updatedOrder) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      "Order was updated by another request. Please refresh and try again."
    );
  }

  return updatedOrder;
};

const cancelAdminOrder = async (orderId, reason) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const normalizedReason = String(reason || "").trim();

  if (
    normalizedReason.length < 5 ||
    normalizedReason.length > 500
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Cancellation reason must contain 5 to 500 characters."
    );
  }

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let cancelledOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const order = await Order.findById(orderId).session(session);

      if (!order) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "Order not found."
        );
      }

      if (!CANCELLABLE_STATUSES.includes(order.status)) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
          "This order is no longer eligible for cancellation."
        );
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          { _id: item.product.productId },
          { $inc: { stock: item.quantity } },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.matchedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Unable to restore inventory for ${item.product.name}.`
          );
        }
      }

      const updatedOrder = await Order.findOneAndUpdate(
        {
          _id: orderId,
          status: order.status,
        },
        {
          $set: {
            status: "cancelled",
            cancellationReason: normalizedReason,
          },
          $push: {
            statusHistory: {
              status: "cancelled",
              timestamp: new Date(),
              note: normalizedReason,
            },
          },
        },
        {
          new: true,
          runValidators: true,
          session,
        }
      );

      if (!updatedOrder) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
          "Order status changed. Please refresh and try again."
        );
      }

      cancelledOrder = updatedOrder;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return cancelledOrder.toObject();
};

const adminOrderService = {
  getAdminOrders,
  getAdminOrderById,
  updateAdminOrderStatus,
  cancelAdminOrder,
};

export default adminOrderService;

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const generateToken = (user) => {
  if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET) {
    throw new Error("JWT_SECRET is not configured.");
  }

  return jwt.sign(
    {
      sub: user._id.toString(),
      role: user.role,
    },
    process.env.JWT_SECRET,
    {
      expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN || "7d",
      issuer: "nexamart-api",
      audience: "nexamart-client",
    }
  );
};

const sanitizeUser = (user) => {
  const userData = user.toObject();

  delete userData.password;

  return userData;
};

const register = async (values) => {
  const existingUser = await User.findOne({
    email: values.email,
  });

  if (existingUser) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      "An account with this email already exists."
    );
  }

  try {
    const user = await User.create({
      fullName: values.fullName,
      email: values.email,
      phone: values.phone,
      password: values.password,
    });

    return {
      user: sanitizeUser(user),
      token: generateToken(user),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === 11000) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
        "An account with this email already exists."
      );
    }

    throw error;
  }
};

const login = async ({ email, password }) => {
  const user = await User.findOne({ email }).select("+password");

  if (!user || !(await user.comparePassword(password))) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
      "Invalid email address or password."
    );
  }

  if (!user.isActive) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.FORBIDDEN,
      "This account is currently unavailable."
    );
  }

  return {
    user: sanitizeUser(user),
    token: generateToken(user),
  };
};

const updateProfile = async (userId, values) => {
  const user = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(
    userId,
    {
      $set: {
        fullName: values.fullName,
        phone: values.phone,
      },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  ).select(
    "_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt"
  );

  if (!user) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "User account not found."
    );
  }

  return user;
};

const authService = {
  register,
  login,
  updateProfile,
};

export default authService;



================================================================================

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1 },
});

const createSlug = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parsePagination = (query = {}) => {
  const page = Math.max(
    DEFAULT_PAGE,
    Number.parseInt(query.page, 10) || DEFAULT_PAGE
  );

  const limit = Math.min(
    MAX_LIMIT,
    Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(query.limit, 10) || DEFAULT_LIMIT)
  );

  return { page, limit, skip: (page - 1) * limit };
};

const generateUniqueSlug = async (value, excludeId = null) => {
  const baseSlug = createSlug(value);

  if (!baseSlug) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "A valid category name is required."
    );
  }

  let slug = baseSlug;
  let counter = 1;

  while (
    await Category.exists({
      slug,
      ...(excludeId && { _id: { $ne: excludeId } }),
    })
  ) {
    counter += 1;
    slug = `${baseSlug}-${counter}`;
  }

  return slug;
};

const handleDuplicateError = (error) => {
  if (error?.code === 11000) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      "A category with this slug already exists."
    );
  }

  throw error;
};

const getPublicCategories = async () =>
  Category.find({ isActive: true })
    .select("name slug description image")
    .sort({ name: 1 })
    .lean();

const getCategoryBySlug = async (slug) => {
  const category = await Category.findOne({
    slug,
    isActive: true,
  }).lean();

  if (!category) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Category not found."
    );
  }

  return category;
};

const getAdminCategories = async (query = {}) => {
  const { page, limit, skip } = parsePagination(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (query.search?.trim()) {
    const search = escapeRegex(query.search.trim().slice(0, 80));

    filter.$or = [
      { name: { $regex: search, $options: "i" } },
      { slug: { $regex: search, $options: "i" } },
    ];
  }

  if (query.status === "active") {
    filter.isActive = true;
  } else if (query.status === "inactive") {
    filter.isActive = false;
  }

  const sort = SORT_OPTIONS[query.sort] || SORT_OPTIONS.newest;

  const [categories, total] = await Promise.all([
    Category.find(filter)
      .sort(sort)
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Category.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    categories,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const createCategory = async (payload) => {
  try {
    const slug = payload.slug
      ? createSlug(payload.slug)
      : await generateUniqueSlug(payload.name);

    if (!slug) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
        "A valid category slug is required."
      );
    }

    return await Category.create({
      ...payload,
      slug,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    handleDuplicateError(error);
  }
};

const updateCategory = async (categoryId, payload) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(categoryId)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid category ID."
    );
  }

  const category = await Category.findById(categoryId);

  if (!category) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Category not found."
    );
  }

  if (payload.isActive === false && category.isActive) {
    const assignedProducts = await Product.countDocuments({
      isActive: true,
      $or: [
        { categoryId: category._id },
        { category: category.name },
      ],
    });

    if (assignedProducts > 0) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
        "This category has active products. Reassign those products before deactivating it."
      );
    }
  }

  const previousName = category.name;

  try {
    if (payload.name && payload.name !== category.name) {
      category.name = payload.name;

      category.slug =
        payload.slug || (await generateUniqueSlug(payload.name, categoryId));
    } else if (payload.slug) {
      category.slug = createSlug(payload.slug);
    }

    if (payload.description !== undefined) {
      category.description = payload.description;
    }

    if (payload.image !== undefined) {
      category.image = payload.image;
    }

    if (payload.isActive !== undefined) {
      category.isActive = payload.isActive;
    }

    await category.save();

    if (previousName !== category.name) {
      await Product.updateMany(
        {
          $or: [
            { categoryId: category._id },
            { category: previousName },
          ],
        },
        { $set: { category: category.name } }
      );
    }

    return category;
  } catch (error) {
    handleDuplicateError(error);
  }
};

const deactivateCategory = async (categoryId) =>
  updateCategory(categoryId, { isActive: false });

const activateCategory = async (categoryId) =>
  updateCategory(categoryId, { isActive: true });

const categoryService = {
  getPublicCategories,
  getCategoryBySlug,
  getAdminCategories,
  createCategory,
  updateCategory,
  deactivateCategory,
  activateCategory,
};

export default categoryService;

import { randomBytes, randomUUID, createHash } from "node:crypto";

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";

import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY = 100;
const GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES = 32;

const generateOrderNumber = () =>
  `NEXA-${Date.now().toString().slice(-8)}-${randomUUID()
    .replace(/-/g, "")
    .slice(0, 8)
    .toUpperCase()}`;

const generateGuestAccessToken = () =>
  randomBytes(GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES).toString("hex");

const hashGuestAccessToken = (token) =>
  createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

const normalizeEmail = (email) =>
  String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase();

const sanitizeOrder = (order) => {
  if (!order) return null;

  const safeOrder = order.toObject
    ? order.toObject()
    : { ...order };

  delete safeOrder.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return safeOrder;
};

const validateOrderId = (orderId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(orderId)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid order ID."
    );
  }
};

const createOrder = async ({
  customer,
  items,
  deliveryMethod,
  paymentMethod,
  userId = null,
}) => {
  if (!customer || !Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Required order information is missing."
    );
  }

  if (paymentMethod !== "cod") {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Currently, only Cash on Delivery is available."
    );
  }

  if (!["standard", "express"].includes(deliveryMethod)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid delivery method."
    );
  }

  if (items.length > 50) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "An order cannot contain more than 50 products."
    );
  }

  const normalizedItems = items.map((item) => ({
    sku: String(item.sku || "").trim().toUpperCase(),
    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
  }));

  const uniqueSkus = new Set(
    normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku)
  );

  if (
    uniqueSkus.size !== normalizedItems.length ||
    normalizedItems.some(
      (item) =>
        !item.sku ||
        !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) ||
        item.quantity < 1 ||
        item.quantity > MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY
    )
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid or duplicate products in your order."
    );
  }

  const guestAccessToken = userId
    ? null
    : generateGuestAccessToken();

  const guestAccessTokenHash = guestAccessToken
    ? hashGuestAccessToken(guestAccessToken)
    : null;

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let createdOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const products = await Product.find({
        sku: { $in: normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku) },
        isActive: true,
      }).session(session);

      if (products.length !== normalizedItems.length) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "One or more products are unavailable."
        );
      }

      const productMap = new Map(
        products.map((product) => [product.sku, product])
      );

      const orderItems = [];
      let subtotal = 0;

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        if (!product) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
            `Product ${item.sku} was not found.`
          );
        }

        if (product.stock < item.quantity) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Insufficient stock for ${product.name}.`
          );
        }

        const unitPrice = Number(product.price);
        const lineTotal = unitPrice * item.quantity;

        if (
          !Number.isFinite(unitPrice) ||
          unitPrice < 0 ||
          !Number.isFinite(lineTotal)
        ) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            "Invalid product pricing configuration."
          );
        }

        subtotal += lineTotal;

        orderItems.push({
          product: {
            productId: product._id,
            sku: product.sku,
            name: product.name,
            slug: product.slug,
            image: product.image,
          },
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice,
          lineTotal,
        });
      }

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          {
            _id: product._id,
            isActive: true,
            stock: { $gte: item.quantity },
          },
          {
            $inc: { stock: -item.quantity },
          },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.modifiedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Stock changed for ${product.name}. Please try again.`
          );
        }
      }

      const orderData = {
        orderNumber: generateOrderNumber(),
        user: userId || null,
        guestAccessTokenHash,
        customer: {
          fullName: customer.fullName.trim(),
          email: normalizeEmail(customer.email),
          phone: customer.phone.trim(),
          addressLine1: customer.addressLine1.trim(),
          addressLine2: customer.addressLine2?.trim() || "",
          city: customer.city.trim(),
          province: customer.province.trim(),
          postalCode: customer.postalCode.trim(),
        },
        items: orderItems,
        subtotal,
        deliveryFee: null,
        total: subtotal,
        deliveryMethod,
        paymentMethod: "cod",
        paymentStatus: "pending",
        status: "placed",
        statusHistory: [
          {
            status: "placed",
            timestamp: new Date(),
            note: "Your order has been successfully placed.",
          },
        ],
      };

      const [order] = await Order.create(
        [orderData],
        { session }
      );

      createdOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return {
    order: sanitizeOrder(createdOrder),
    guestAccessToken,
  };
};

const getCustomerOrders = async (userId) => {
  return Order.find({ user: userId })
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .lean();
};

const getCustomerOrderById = async (orderId, userId) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: userId,
  }).lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  return order;
};

const getGuestOrderConfirmation = async (
  orderId,
  accessToken
) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  if (
    typeof accessToken !== "string" ||
    !/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(accessToken)
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
      "Invalid order access credentials."
    );
  }

  const tokenHash = hashGuestAccessToken(accessToken);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: null,
    guestAccessTokenHash: tokenHash,
  })
    .select("+guestAccessTokenHash")
    .lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found or access denied."
    );
  }

  delete order.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return order;
};

const cancelOrder = async (orderId, userId, reason) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const normalizedReason = String(reason || "").trim();

  if (
    normalizedReason.length < 5 ||
    normalizedReason.length > 500
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Cancellation reason must contain 5 to 500 characters."
    );
  }

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let cancelledOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const order = await Order.findOne({
        _id: orderId,
        user: userId,
      }).session(session);

      if (!order) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "Order not found."
        );
      }

      if (
        !["placed", "confirmed", "processing"].includes(
          order.status
        )
      ) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
          "This order is no longer eligible for cancellation."
        );
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          { _id: item.product.productId },
          { $inc: { stock: item.quantity } },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.matchedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            "Unable to restore product inventory."
          );
        }
      }

      order.status = "cancelled";
      order.cancellationReason = normalizedReason;

      order.statusHistory.push({
        status: "cancelled",
        timestamp: new Date(),
        note: normalizedReason,
      });

      await order.save({ session });

      cancelledOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return sanitizeOrder(cancelledOrder);
};

const orderService = {
  createOrder,
  getCustomerOrders,
  getCustomerOrderById,
  getGuestOrderConfirmation,
  cancelOrder,
};

export default orderService;

import getCloudinary from "../../config/cloudinary.js";

const CLOUDINARY_FOLDER = "nexamart/products";

const uploadSingleImage = (file) => {
  if (!file?.buffer?.length) {
    throw new Error("Invalid image file buffer.");
  }

  const cloudinaryClient = getCloudinary();

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const stream = cloudinaryClient.uploader.upload_stream(
      {
        folder: CLOUDINARY_FOLDER,
        resource_type: "image",
        quality: "auto",
        fetch_format: "auto",
      },
      (error, result) => {
        if (error) {
          console.error("Cloudinary upload failed:", {
            message: error.message,
            httpCode: error.http_code,
          });

          return reject(error);
        }

        if (!result?.secure_url || !result?.public_id) {
          return reject(
            new Error("Invalid Cloudinary upload response.")
          );
        }

        resolve({
          url: result.secure_url,
          publicId: result.public_id,
        });
      }
    );

    stream.on("error", reject);
    stream.end(file.buffer);
  });
};

const deleteProductImages = async (images = []) => {
  const publicIds = [
    ...new Set(
      images
        .map((image) => image?.publicId)
        .filter(
          (publicId) =>
            typeof publicId === "string" &&
            publicId.trim().length > 0
        )
    ),
  ];

  if (!publicIds.length) {
    return { deleted: 0, failed: 0 };
  }

  const cloudinaryClient = getCloudinary();

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    publicIds.map((publicId) =>
      cloudinaryClient.uploader.destroy(publicId, {
        resource_type: "image",
        invalidate: true,
      })
    )
  );

  let deleted = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  results.forEach((result, index) => {
    if (
      result.status === "fulfilled" &&
      ["ok", "not found"].includes(result.value?.result)
    ) {
      deleted += 1;
      return;
    }

    failed += 1;

    console.error("Cloudinary image cleanup failed:", {
      publicId: publicIds[index],
      error:
        result.status === "rejected"
          ? result.reason?.message
          : result.value?.result,
    });
  });

  return { deleted, failed };
};

const uploadProductImages = async (files = []) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(files) || files.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("At least one image file is required.");
  }

  const uploadedImages = [];

  try {
    for (const file of files) {
      const image = await uploadSingleImage(file);
      uploadedImages.push(image);
    }

    return uploadedImages;
  } catch (error) {
    const rollback = await deleteProductImages(uploadedImages);

    if (rollback.failed > 0) {
      console.error("Cloudinary upload rollback incomplete:", rollback);
    }

    throw error;
  }
};

const imageService = {
  uploadProductImages,
  deleteProductImages,
};

export default imageService;

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";
import imageService from "./image.service.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: 1 },
  rating: { rating: -1, _id: -1 },
  popular: { bestSeller: -1, reviewCount: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const parseInteger = (value, field, { min, max }) => {
  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parsePrice = (value, field) => {
  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed < 0) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be a valid non-negative number.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const parseBoolean = (value, field) => {
  if (value === "true" || value === true) return true;
  if (value === "false" || value === false) return false;

  throwBadRequest(`${field} must be true or false.`);
};

const handleDatabaseError = (error) => {
  if (error?.code === 11000) {
    const duplicateField = Object.keys(error.keyPattern || {})[0];

    const messages = {
      sku: "A product with this SKU already exists.",
      slug: "A product with this slug already exists.",
    };

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      messages[duplicateField] ||
        "A product with these details already exists."
    );
  }

  throw error;
};

// Resolve a category while preserving legacy string compatibility.
const resolveCategory = async ({ categoryId, category }) => {
  if (categoryId !== undefined) {
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(categoryId)) {
      throwBadRequest("Invalid category ID.");
    }

    const categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
      _id: categoryId,
      isActive: true,
    }).select("_id name");

    if (!categoryDocument) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Selected category was not found or is inactive."
      );
    }

    return {
      categoryId: categoryDocument._id,
      category: categoryDocument.name,
    };
  }

  if (category !== undefined) {
    const categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
      name: category,
      isActive: true,
    }).select("_id name");

    if (categoryDocument) {
      return {
        categoryId: categoryDocument._id,
        category: categoryDocument.name,
      };
    }

    // Existing legacy products and clients remain compatible.
    return {
      category,
      categoryId: null,
    };
  }

  return {};
};

const normalizeProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
    "isNewArrival",
    "bestSeller",
    "inStock",
    "minPrice",
    "maxPrice",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (query.search !== undefined && typeof query.search !== "string") {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && typeof query.category !== "string") {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort || "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", {
          min: 1,
          max: 1000000,
        });

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", {
          min: 1,
          max: MAX_LIMIT,
        });

  const minPrice =
    query.minPrice === undefined
      ? undefined
      : parsePrice(query.minPrice, "Minimum price");

  const maxPrice =
    query.maxPrice === undefined
      ? undefined
      : parsePrice(query.maxPrice, "Maximum price");

  if (
    minPrice !== undefined &&
    maxPrice !== undefined &&
    minPrice > maxPrice
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Minimum price cannot exceed maximum price."
    );
  }

  return {
    search,
    category,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
    isNewArrival:
      query.isNewArrival === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.isNewArrival, "isNewArrival"),
    bestSeller:
      query.bestSeller === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.bestSeller, "bestSeller"),
    inStock:
      query.inStock === undefined
        ? undefined
        : parseBoolean(query.inStock, "inStock"),
    minPrice,
    maxPrice,
  };
};

const getProducts = async (query) => {
  const filters = normalizeProductQuery(query);

  const {
    search,
    category,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
    isNewArrival,
    bestSeller,
    inStock,
    minPrice,
    maxPrice,
  } = filters;

  const filter = { isActive: true };

  if (search) {
    filter.$text = { $search: search };
  }

  if (category) {
    let categoryDocument = null;

    if (mongoose.isValidObjectId(category)) {
      categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
        _id: category,
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name");
    } else {
      categoryDocument = await Category.findOne({
        slug: category,
        isActive: true,
      }).select("_id name");
    }

    if (categoryDocument) {
      filter.$or = [
        { categoryId: categoryDocument._id },
        {
          category: categoryDocument.name,
          categoryId: null,
        },
      ];
    } else {
      // Backward compatibility for legacy category-name filters.
      filter.category = category;
    }
  }

  if (isNewArrival !== undefined) {
    filter.isNewArrival = isNewArrival;
  }

  if (bestSeller !== undefined) {
    filter.bestSeller = bestSeller;
  }

  if (inStock === true) filter.stock = { $gt: 0 };
  if (inStock === false) filter.stock = 0;

  if (minPrice !== undefined || maxPrice !== undefined) {
    filter.price = {};

    if (minPrice !== undefined) {
      filter.price.$gte = minPrice;
    }

    if (maxPrice !== undefined) {
      filter.price.$lte = maxPrice;
    }
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [products, total] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  return {
    products,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getProductBySlug = async (slug) => {
  const product = await Product.findOne({
    slug,
    isActive: true,
  }).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const getCategories = async () =>
  Product.distinct("category", { isActive: true });

const createProduct = async (values) => {
  try {
    const categoryValues = await resolveCategory(values);

    return await Product.create({
      ...values,
      ...categoryValues,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    handleDatabaseError(error);
  }
};

const updateProduct = async (productId, values) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId);

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  const previousImages = (product.images || []).map((image) => ({
    url: image.url,
    publicId: image.publicId,
  }));

  const updatedPrice =
    values.price !== undefined ? values.price : product.price;

  const updatedCompareAtPrice =
    values.compareAtPrice !== undefined
      ? values.compareAtPrice
      : product.compareAtPrice;

  if (
    updatedCompareAtPrice !== null &&
    updatedCompareAtPrice !== undefined &&
    updatedCompareAtPrice <= updatedPrice
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      "Compare-at price must be greater than the selling price."
    );
  }

  const updateValues = { ...values };

  if (
    values.categoryId !== undefined ||
    values.category !== undefined
  ) {
    const categoryValues = await resolveCategory(values);
    Object.assign(updateValues, categoryValues);
  }

  if (updateValues.images?.length > 0) {
    updateValues.image = updateValues.images[0].url;
  }

  try {
    Object.assign(product, updateValues);

    await product.save();

    if (values.images !== undefined) {
      const currentPublicIds = new Set(
        (product.images || []).map((image) => image.publicId)
      );

      const removedImages = previousImages.filter(
        (image) => !currentPublicIds.has(image.publicId)
      );

      if (removedImages.length > 0) {
        await imageService.deleteProductImages(removedImages);
      }
    }

    return product;
  } catch (error) {
    handleDatabaseError(error);
  }
};

const deleteProduct = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: true },
    { $set: { isActive: false } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  );

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const productService = {
  getProducts,
  getProductBySlug,
  getCategories,
  createProduct,
  updateProduct,
  deleteProduct,
};

export default productService;

class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    statusCode,
    message = "Something went wrong",
    errors = [],
    stack = ""
  ) {
    super(message);

    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.success = false;
    this.errors = errors;

    if (stack) {
      this.stack = stack;
    } else {
      Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
    }
  }
}

export default ApiError;

class ApiResponse {
  constructor(statusCode, data, message = "Success") {
    this.success = true;
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.message = message;
    this.data = data;
  }
}

export default ApiResponse;

    .min(1, "Phone number is required.")

      (value) => value.replace(/\D/g, "").length >= 10,

    ),

  password: passwordSchema,

  confirmPassword: z.string().min(1, "Confirm your password."),
}).refine(
  (values) => values.password === values.confirmPassword,
  {
    message: "Passwords do not match.",
    path: ["confirmPassword"],
  }
);

});

import { z } from "zod";

const slugSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(2)
  .max(100)
  .regex(/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/);

const categoryFields = {
  name: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  slug: slugSchema.optional(),
  description: z.string().trim().max(500).optional(),

  phone: z.string().trim().min(7).max(20),
  addressLine1: z.string().trim().min(5).max(200),
  addressLine2: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().default(""),
  city: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),

  postalCode: z.string().trim().min(2).max(20),
}).strict();

  sku: z.string().trim().min(3).max(40).transform((value) =>

  ),
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(100),
}).strict();

import { z } from "zod";

const productSchema = z.object({
  sku: z.string().trim().min(3).max(40)
    .transform((value) => value.toUpperCase()),

  slug: z.string().trim().min(3).max(180)
    .regex(/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/),

  name: z.string().trim().min(2).max(160),

  categoryId: z.string()
    .regex(/^[a-f\d]{24}$/i, "Invalid category ID.")
    .optional(),

  category: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80).optional(),

  image: z.string().trim().url(),

  images: z.array(
    z.object({
      url: z.string().trim().url(),
      publicId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(255),
    })
  ).max(8).optional(),

  price: z.number().finite().min(0),
  compareAtPrice: z.number().finite().min(0).nullable().optional(),
  badge: z.string().trim().max(60).nullable().optional(),
  description: z.string().trim().min(10).max(3000),
  stock: z.number().int().min(0),
  isNewArrival: z.boolean().default(false),
  bestSeller: z.boolean().default(false),
  isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
});

export const createProductSchema = productSchema
  .refine(
    (data) => Boolean(data.categoryId || data.category),
    {
      message: "Please select a product category.",
      path: ["categoryId"],
    }
  )
  .refine(
    (data) =>
      data.compareAtPrice == null ||
      data.compareAtPrice > data.price,
    {
      message: "Compare-at price must be greater than the selling price.",
      path: ["compareAtPrice"],
    }
  );

export const updateProductSchema = productSchema
  .partial()
  .omit({ sku: true })
  .refine((data) => Object.keys(data).length > 0, {
    message: "At least one field is required.",
  })
  .refine(
    (data) =>
      data.compareAtPrice === undefined ||
      data.compareAtPrice === null ||
      data.price === undefined ||
      data.compareAtPrice > data.price,
    {
      message: "Compare-at price must be greater than the selling price.",
      path: ["compareAtPrice"],
    }
  );

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  Boxes,
  ChevronLeft,
  LayoutDashboard,
  LogOut,
  Menu,
  Package,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShoppingBag,
  Users,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  NavLink,
  Outlet,
  useLocation,
  useNavigate,
} from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../../account/hooks/useAccount";

import "./admin-layout.css";

const NAVIGATION_ITEMS = [
  {
    label: "Dashboard",
    path: "/admin",
    icon: LayoutDashboard,
    end: true,
  },
  {
    label: "Products",
    path: "/admin/products",
    icon: Package,
  },
  {
    label: "Categories",
    path: "/admin/categories",
    icon: Boxes,
  },
  {
    label: "Orders",
    path: "/admin/orders",
    icon: ShoppingBag,
  },
  {
    label: "Customers",
    path: "/admin/customers",
    icon: Users,
  },
];

const AdminLayout = () => {
  const { currentUser, logout } = useAccount();

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const [isMobileOpen, setIsMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoggingOut, setIsLoggingOut] = useState(false);

  const administratorName =
    currentUser?.fullName ||
    currentUser?.name ||
    "Administrator";

  const administratorEmail = currentUser?.email || "";

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMobileOpen(false);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobileOpen) return undefined;

    const handleEscape = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setIsMobileOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
    };
  }, [isMobileOpen]);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    if (isLoggingOut) return;

    try {
      setIsLoggingOut(true);
      await logout();

      navigate("/login", { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setIsLoggingOut(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="admin-layout">
      {isMobileOpen && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="admin-layout__overlay"
          onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(false)}
          aria-label="Close navigation"
        />
      )}

      <aside
        className={`admin-sidebar ${
          isMobileOpen ? "is-open" : ""
        }`}
        aria-label="Admin sidebar"
      >
        <div className="admin-sidebar__brand">
          <div className="admin-sidebar__logo">
            <ShoppingBag size={23} />
          </div>

          <div className="admin-sidebar__brand-text">
            <strong>NEXAMART</strong>
            <span>ADMINISTRATION</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="admin-sidebar__close"
            onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(false)}
            aria-label="Close sidebar"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="admin-sidebar__workspace">
          <span className="admin-sidebar__workspace-icon">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
          </span>

          <div>
            <strong>Admin Workspace</strong>
            <span>Secure environment</span>
          </div>

          <span className="admin-sidebar__online" />
        </div>

        <nav className="admin-sidebar__navigation">
          <span className="admin-sidebar__section-label">
            WORKSPACE
          </span>

          {NAVIGATION_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;

            return (
              <NavLink
                key={item.path}
                to={item.path}
                end={item.end}
                className={({ isActive }) =>
                  `admin-sidebar__link ${
                    isActive ? "is-active" : ""
                  }`
                }
              >
                <Icon size={19} />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <ChevronLeft
                  size={15}
                  className="admin-sidebar__active-indicator"
                />
              </NavLink>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="admin-sidebar__bottom">
          <div className="admin-sidebar__administrator">
            <span className="admin-sidebar__avatar">
              {administratorName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </span>

            <div className="admin-sidebar__administrator-info">
              <strong>{administratorName}</strong>
              <span>{administratorEmail || "Administrator"}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="admin-sidebar__logout"
            onClick={handleLogout}
            disabled={isLoggingOut}
          >
            <LogOut size={17} />
            <span>
              {isLoggingOut ? "Signing out..." : "Sign out"}
            </span>
          </button>

          <div className="admin-sidebar__version">
            <Activity size={13} />
            NexaMart Administration
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <div className="admin-layout__main">
        <header className="admin-topbar">
          <div className="admin-topbar__left">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-topbar__menu"
              onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(true)}
              aria-label="Open navigation"
              aria-expanded={isMobileOpen}
            >
              <Menu size={21} />
            </button>

            <div className="admin-topbar__breadcrumb">
              <span>Workspace</span>
              <span>/</span>
              <strong>
                {NAVIGATION_ITEMS.find(
                  (item) =>
                    item.end
                      ? location.pathname === item.path
                      : location.pathname.startsWith(item.path)
                )?.label || "Administration"}
              </strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-topbar__right">
            <span className="admin-topbar__status">
              <span />
              System workspace
            </span>

            <div className="admin-topbar__identity">
              <span className="admin-topbar__avatar">
                {administratorName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </span>
              <span>{administratorName}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div className="admin-layout__content">
          <Outlet />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminLayout;

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Edit3,
  LoaderCircle,
  Package,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatCurrency = (value = 0) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value);

const getStockStatus = (stock) => {
  if (stock === 0) {
    return { label: "Out of stock", className: "out" };
  }

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };
  }

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };
};

const AdminProductTable = ({
  products,
  isLoading,
  actionLoading,
  onToggleStatus,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={30} />
        <span>Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={34} />
        <strong>No products found</strong>
        <span>Try changing your search or filters.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="admin-products__table-wrap">
      <table className="admin-products__table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Product</th>
            <th>SKU</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Price</th>
            <th>Inventory</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const stock = getStockStatus(product.stock);
            const isUpdating = actionLoading === product._id;

            return (
              <tr key={product._id}>
                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__product">
                    <img
                      src={product.image}
                      alt={product.name}
                      loading="lazy"
                    />

                    <div>
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.slug}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="admin-products__sku">
                  {product.sku}
                </td>

                <td>{product.category}</td>

                <td className="admin-products__price">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__stock admin-products__stock--${stock.className}`}
                  >
                    {stock.className === "out" && (
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} />
                    )}
                    {product.stock} Â· {stock.label}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__status ${
                      product.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span />
                    {product.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__actions">
                    <Link
                      to={`/admin/products/${product._id}/edit`}
                      className="admin-products__edit"
                      aria-label={`Edit ${product.name}`}
                      title="Edit product"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={17} />
                    </Link>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`admin-products__action ${
                        product.isActive
                          ? "is-deactivate"
                          : "is-activate"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => onToggleStatus(product)}
                      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
                      aria-label={
                        product.isActive
                          ? `Deactivate ${product.name}`
                          : `Activate ${product.name}`
                      }
                      title={
                        product.isActive
                          ? "Deactivate product"
                          : "Activate product"
                      }
                    >
                      {isUpdating ? (
                        <LoaderCircle
                          size={17}
                          className="is-spinning"
                        />
                      ) : product.isActive ? (
                        <PowerOff size={17} />
                      ) : (
                        <Power size={17} />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};
