              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__table-wrap">
                <table className="admin-dashboard__table">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Order</th>
                      <th>Customer</th>
                      <th>Amount</th>
                      <th>Status</th>
                      <th>Date</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody>
                    {recentOrders.map((order) => (
                      <tr key={order._id}>
                        <td className="admin-dashboard__order-number">
                          {order.orderNumber}
                        </td>

                        <td>{order.customer?.fullName || "Customer"}</td>

                        <td className="admin-dashboard__amount">
                          {formatCurrency(order.total)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={`admin-status admin-status--${order.status}`}
                          >
                            {formatStatus(order.status)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>{formatDate(order.createdAt)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="admin-dashboard__panel">
            <div className="admin-dashboard__panel-header">
              <div>
                <h2>Inventory Alerts</h2>
                <p>Products requiring restocking.</p>
              </div>

              <Boxes size={20} />
            </div>

            {isLoading && !dashboard ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                Loading inventory...
              </div>
            ) : lowStockProducts.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                <Package size={28} />
                <span>All inventory levels look healthy.</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-inventory">
                {lowStockProducts.map((product) => (
                  <div
                    className="admin-inventory__item"
                    key={product._id}
                  >
                    <div className="admin-inventory__details">
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.sku}</span>
                    </div>

                    <span
                      className={`admin-inventory__stock ${
                        product.stock === 0 ? "is-out" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      {product.stock === 0
                        ? "Out of stock"
                        : `${product.stock} left`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer className="admin-dashboard__footer">
          <ShieldCheck size={16} />
          <span>NexaMart secure administration workspace</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminDashboard;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\pages\AdminProductForm.jsx ==========

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  LoaderCircle,
  Save,
  ShieldCheck,
  Upload,
  X,
  Star,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  Link,
  useNavigate,
  useParams,
} from "react-router-dom";

import adminProductService from "../services/adminProductService";

import "./admin-product-form.css";

const INITIAL_FORM = {
  sku: "",
  slug: "",
  name: "",
  category: "",
  categoryId: "",
  price: "",
  compareAtPrice: "",
  badge: "",
  description: "",
  stock: "0",
  isNewArrival: false,
  bestSeller: false,
  isActive: true,
};

const MAX_IMAGES = 8;
const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES = [
  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
  "image/avif",
];

const slugify = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Something went wrong. Please try again.";

const createImageId = (file, index) =>
  `${Date.now()}-${index}-${file.name}`;

const AdminProductForm = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isEditMode = Boolean(id);

  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const objectUrlsRef = useRef(new Set());

  const [form, setForm] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]);
  const [mainImageId, setMainImageId] = useState(null);

  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [categoriesLoading, setCategoriesLoading] = useState(true);

  const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEditMode);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Load active categories.
  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const loadCategories = async () => {
      try {
        setCategoriesLoading(true);

        const data = await adminProductService.getCategories({
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setCategoriesLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    loadCategories();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  // Release temporary image previews.
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      objectUrlsRef.current.forEach((url) => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      });

      objectUrlsRef.current.clear();
    };
  }, []);

  // Load existing product in edit mode.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditMode) return undefined;

    const controller = new AbortController();

    const loadProduct = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        const product = await adminProductService.getProductById(
          id,
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );

        setForm({
          sku: product.sku ?? "",
          slug: product.slug ?? "",
          name: product.name ?? "",
          category: product.category ?? "",
          categoryId: product.categoryId ?? "",
          price: String(product.price ?? ""),
          compareAtPrice:
            product.compareAtPrice == null
              ? ""
              : String(product.compareAtPrice),
          badge: product.badge ?? "",
          description: product.description ?? "",
          stock: String(product.stock ?? 0),
          isNewArrival: Boolean(product.isNewArrival),
          bestSeller: Boolean(product.bestSeller),
          isActive: Boolean(product.isActive),
        });

        const existingImages = Array.isArray(product.images)
          ? product.images.map((image, index) => ({
              id: image.publicId || `existing-${index}`,
              url: image.url,
              publicId: image.publicId,
              file: null,
              previewUrl: image.url,
              isExisting: true,
            }))
          : [];

        const initialImages = existingImages.length
          ? existingImages
          : product.image
            ? [
                {
                  id: "legacy-image",
                  url: product.image,
                  publicId: null,
                  file: null,
                  previewUrl: product.image,
                  isExisting: true,
                  isLegacy: true,
                },
              ]
            : [];

        setImages(initialImages);
        setMainImageId(initialImages[0]?.id ?? null);
        setSlugTouched(true);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    loadProduct();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [id, isEditMode]);

  const updateField = (name, value) => {
    setForm((current) => {
      const updated = { ...current, [name]: value };

      if (name === "name" && !slugTouched) {
        updated.slug = slugify(value);
      }

      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (event) => {
    const categoryId = event.target.value;

    const selectedCategory = categories.find(
      (category) => category._id === categoryId
    );

    if (selectedCategory) {
      setForm((current) => ({
        ...current,
        categoryId: selectedCategory._id,
        category: selectedCategory.name,
      }));

      return;
    }

    // Preserve an existing legacy category.
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      categoryId: "",
    }));
  };

  const releaseImagePreview = (url) => {
    if (!url || !objectUrlsRef.current.has(url)) return;

    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    objectUrlsRef.current.delete(url);
  };

  const handleImageSelection = (event) => {
    const selectedFiles = Array.from(event.target.files || []);

    event.target.value = "";

    if (!selectedFiles.length) return;

    setError("");

    const availableSlots = MAX_IMAGES - images.length;

    if (availableSlots <= 0) {
      setError(`Maximum ${MAX_IMAGES} images allowed hain.`);
      return;
    }

    const acceptedFiles = [];
    const validationErrors = [];

    selectedFiles.forEach((file) => {
      if (!ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
        validationErrors.push(
          `${file.name}: Unsupported image format.`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
        validationErrors.push(
          `${file.name}: Image size 5MB se zyada hai.`
        );
        return;
      }

      acceptedFiles.push(file);
    });

    const filesToAdd = acceptedFiles.slice(0, availableSlots);

    if (acceptedFiles.length > availableSlots) {
      validationErrors.push(
        `Sirf ${availableSlots} additional images add ho sakti hain.`
      );
    }

    if (validationErrors.length) {
      setError(validationErrors.join(" "));
    }

    if (!filesToAdd.length) return;

    const newImages = filesToAdd.map((file, index) => {
      const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

      objectUrlsRef.current.add(previewUrl);

      return {
        id: createImageId(file, index),
        url: "",
        publicId: null,
        file,
        previewUrl,
        isExisting: false,
      };
    });

    if (!images.some((image) => !image.isLegacy)) {
      setMainImageId(newImages[0].id);
    }

    setImages((current) => [...current, ...newImages]);
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = (imageId) => {
    const targetImage = images.find(
      (image) => image.id === imageId
    );

    if (!targetImage) return;

    releaseImagePreview(targetImage.previewUrl);

    const updatedImages = images.filter(
      (image) => image.id !== imageId
    );

    setImages(updatedImages);

    if (mainImageId === imageId) {
      setMainImageId(updatedImages[0]?.id ?? null);
    }
  };

  const handleSetMainImage = (imageId) => {
    const targetImage = images.find(
      (image) => image.id === imageId
    );

    if (!targetImage) return;

    if (
      targetImage.isLegacy &&
      images.some((image) => !image.isLegacy)
    ) {
      setError(
        "Cloudinary images mein se main image select karein."
      );
      return;
    }

    setMainImageId(imageId);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");

    const mainImage =
      images.find((image) => image.id === mainImageId) ??
      images[0] ??
      null;

    if (!mainImage) {
      setError("Kam az kam aik product image select karein.");
      return;
    }

    if (mainImage.id !== mainImageId) {
      setMainImageId(mainImage.id);
    }

    const payload = {
      ...form,
      sku: form.sku.trim().toUpperCase(),
      slug: form.slug.trim(),
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category.trim(),
      price: Number(form.price),
      compareAtPrice:
        form.compareAtPrice.trim() === ""
          ? null
          : Number(form.compareAtPrice),
      badge: form.badge.trim() || null,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      stock: Number(form.stock),
      isNewArrival: Boolean(form.isNewArrival),
      bestSeller: Boolean(form.bestSeller),
      isActive: Boolean(form.isActive),
    };

    const selectedCategory = categories.find(
      (category) =>
        category._id === form.categoryId ||
        category.name === form.category
    );

    if (selectedCategory) {
      payload.categoryId = selectedCategory._id;
      payload.category = selectedCategory.name;
    } else if (form.categoryId) {
      setError(
        "Selected category available nahi hai. Dobara select karein."
      );
      return;
    } else {
      delete payload.categoryId;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(payload.price) ||
      payload.price < 0 ||
      !Number.isInteger(payload.stock) ||
      payload.stock < 0
    ) {
      setError(
        "Price aur stock valid non-negative numbers hone chahiye."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      payload.compareAtPrice !== null &&
      (!Number.isFinite(payload.compareAtPrice) ||
        payload.compareAtPrice <= payload.price)
    ) {
      setError(
        "Compare-at price selling price se zyada honi chahiye."
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);

      const newImages = images.filter(
        (image) => image.file
      );

      let uploadedImages = [];

      if (newImages.length) {
        uploadedImages =
          await adminProductService.uploadProductImages(
            newImages.map((image) => image.file)
          );
      }

      let uploadIndex = 0;

      const resolvedImages = images.map((image) => {
        if (!image.file) return image;

        const uploadedImage = uploadedImages[uploadIndex];

        uploadIndex += 1;

        if (!uploadedImage?.url || !uploadedImage?.publicId) {
          throw new Error(
            "Image upload response invalid hai. Dobara try karein."
          );
        }

        return {
          ...image,
          url: uploadedImage.url,
          publicId: uploadedImage.publicId,
        };
      });

      const orderedImages = [
        ...resolvedImages.filter(
          (image) => image.id === mainImageId
        ),
        ...resolvedImages.filter(
          (image) => image.id !== mainImageId
        ),
      ];

      const primaryImage = orderedImages[0];

      payload.image = primaryImage.url;

      const cloudinaryImages = orderedImages
        .filter((image) => image.publicId)
        .map(({ url, publicId }) => ({
          url,
          publicId,
        }));

      payload.images = cloudinaryImages;

      if (isEditMode) {
        delete payload.sku;

        await adminProductService.updateProduct(
          id,
          payload
        );
      } else {
        await adminProductService.createProduct(payload);
      }

      navigate("/admin/products", {
        replace: true,
        state: {
          message: isEditMode
            ? "Product updated successfully."
            : "Product created successfully.",
        },
      });
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-product-form">
        <div className="admin-product-form__state">
          <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
          <span>Loading product details...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-product-form">
      <div className="admin-product-form__container">
        <header className="admin-product-form__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/products"
              className="admin-product-form__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to products
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-product-form__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>
              {isEditMode ? "Edit Product" : "Create Product"}
            </h1>

            <p>
              {isEditMode
                ? "Update your product information and catalog settings."
                : "Add a new product to your NexaMart catalog."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-product-form__security">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
            Authorized Administrator
          </div>
        </header>

        {error && (
          <div className="admin-product-form__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form
          className="admin-product-form__layout"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Product Information</h2>
              <p>Basic details displayed in your store catalog.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__grid">
              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Name *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("name", event.target.value)
                  }
                  minLength={2}
                  maxLength={160}
                  required
                  placeholder="Enter product name"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>SKU *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.sku}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField(
                      "sku",
                      event.target.value.toUpperCase()
                    )
                  }
                  minLength={3}
                  maxLength={40}
                  required
                  readOnly={isEditMode}
                  placeholder="e.g. NM-009"
                />
                {isEditMode && (
                  <small>SKU cannot be changed after creation.</small>
                )}
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Slug *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.slug}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setSlugTouched(true);
                    updateField("slug", slugify(event.target.value));
                  }}
                  minLength={3}
                  maxLength={180}
                  pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
                  required
                  placeholder="product-url-slug"
                />
                <small>Used in the product URL.</small>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Category *</span>
                <select
                  value={
                    form.categoryId ||
                    (form.category ? `legacy:${form.category}` : "")
                  }
                  onChange={handleCategoryChange}
                  required
                  disabled={categoriesLoading || saving}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {categoriesLoading
                      ? "Loading categories..."
                      : "Select a category"}
                  </option>

                  {categories.map((category) => (
                    <option
                      key={category._id}
                      value={category._id}
                    >
                      {category.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}

                  {form.category &&
                    !categories.some(
                      (category) =>
                        category._id === form.categoryId ||
                        category.name === form.category
                    ) && (
                      <option value={`legacy:${form.category}`}>
                        {form.category} (Legacy)
                      </option>
                    )}
                </select>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Badge</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.badge}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("badge", event.target.value)
                  }
                  maxLength={60}
                  placeholder="e.g. Best Value"
                />
              </label>
            </div>

            <label className="admin-product-form__field admin-product-form__description">
              <span>Description *</span>
              <textarea
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  updateField("description", event.target.value)
                }
                minLength={10}
                maxLength={3000}
                rows={6}
                required
                placeholder="Write a detailed product description..."
              />
              <small>
                {form.description.length}/3000 characters
              </small>
            </label>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Product Images</h2>
              <p>
                Computer se images select karein. Main image
                storefront par primary image hogi.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__upload">
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif"
                multiple
                hidden
                onChange={handleImageSelection}
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                className="admin-product-form__upload-button"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                disabled={saving || images.length >= MAX_IMAGES}
              >
                <Upload size={19} />
                <span>
                  {images.length >= MAX_IMAGES
                    ? "Image limit reached"
                    : "Choose images from computer"}
                </span>
              </button>

              <p className="admin-product-form__upload-hint">
                JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF Â· Maximum 5MB each Â·
                Maximum 8 images
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__image-count">
              <span>Selected images</span>
              <strong>
                {images.length}/{MAX_IMAGES}
              </strong>
            </div>

            {images.length ? (
              <div className="admin-product-form__image-grid">
                {images.map((image) => {
                  const isMain = image.id === mainImageId;

                  return (
                    <article
                      className={`admin-product-form__image-card ${
                        isMain ? "is-main" : ""
                      }`}
                      key={image.id}
                    >
                      <div className="admin-product-form__image-frame">
                        <img
                          src={image.previewUrl}
                          alt="Product"
                        />

                        {isMain && (
                          <span className="admin-product-form__main-badge">
                            <Star size={12} fill="currentColor" />
                            Main Image
                          </span>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="admin-product-form__image-remove"
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveImage(image.id)}
                          disabled={saving}
                          aria-label="Remove image"
                          title="Remove image"
                        >
                          <X size={15} />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <div className="admin-product-form__image-meta">
                        {!isMain && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="admin-product-form__main-action"
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleSetMainImage(image.id)
                            }
                            disabled={saving}
                          >
                            Set as main
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {image.file && (
                          <small>
                            {(image.file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB
                          </small>
                        )}

                        {image.isLegacy && (
                          <small>Existing legacy image</small>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </article>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-product-form__empty-images">
                <ImageIcon size={34} />
                <span>No product images selected.</span>
                <small>At least one image is required.</small>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Pricing & Inventory</h2>
              <p>Configure product pricing and stock availability.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__grid">
              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Selling Price (PKR) *</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={form.price}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("price", event.target.value)
                  }
                  required
                  placeholder="0"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Compare-at Price (PKR)</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={form.compareAtPrice}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("compareAtPrice", event.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="Optional"
                />
                <small>Must be higher than selling price.</small>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Stock Quantity *</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="1"
                  value={form.stock}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("stock", event.target.value)
                  }
                  required
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Catalog Settings</h2>
              <p>Control product visibility and merchandising.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__toggles">
              <label>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.isNewArrival}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("isNewArrival", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>New Arrival</strong>
                  <small>Display this product in new arrivals.</small>
                </span>
              </label>

              <label>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.bestSeller}
                  onChange={(event) =>

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Edit3,
  LoaderCircle,
  Package,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatCurrency = (value = 0) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value);

const getStockStatus = (stock) => {
  if (stock === 0) {
    return { label: "Out of stock", className: "out" };
  }

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };
  }

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };
};

const AdminProductTable = ({
  products,
  isLoading,
  actionLoading,
  onToggleStatus,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={30} />
        <span>Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={34} />
        <strong>No products found</strong>
        <span>Try changing your search or filters.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="admin-products__table-wrap">
      <table className="admin-products__table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Product</th>
            <th>SKU</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Price</th>
            <th>Inventory</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const stock = getStockStatus(product.stock);
            const isUpdating = actionLoading === product._id;

            return (
              <tr key={product._id}>
                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__product">
                    <img
                      src={product.image}
                      alt={product.name}
                      loading="lazy"
                    />

                    <div>
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.slug}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="admin-products__sku">
                  {product.sku}
                </td>

                <td>{product.category}</td>

                <td className="admin-products__price">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__stock admin-products__stock--${stock.className}`}
                  >
                    {stock.className === "out" && (
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} />
                    )}
                    {product.stock} Â· {stock.label}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__status ${
                      product.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span />
                    {product.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__actions">
                    <Link
                      to={`/admin/products/${product._id}/edit`}
                      className="admin-products__edit"
                      aria-label={`Edit ${product.name}`}
                      title="Edit product"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={17} />
                    </Link>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`admin-products__action ${
                        product.isActive
                          ? "is-deactivate"
                          : "is-activate"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => onToggleStatus(product)}
                      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
                      aria-label={
                        product.isActive
                          ? `Deactivate ${product.name}`
                          : `Activate ${product.name}`
                      }
                      title={
                        product.isActive
                          ? "Deactivate product"
                          : "Activate product"
                      }
                    >
                      {isUpdating ? (
                        <LoaderCircle
                          size={17}
                          className="is-spinning"
                        />
                      ) : product.isActive ? (
                        <PowerOff size={17} />
                      ) : (
                        <Power size={17} />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminProductTable;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\components\ProtectedAdminRoute.jsx ==========
import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../../account/hooks/useAccount";

const ProtectedAdminRoute = () => {
  const {
    currentUser,
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
  } = useAccount();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-auth-loading" role="status">
        Verifying administrator access...
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (currentUser?.role !== "admin") {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedAdminRoute;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\services\adminProductService.js ==========

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

const adminProductService = {
  async getProducts(params = {}, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get("/admin/products", {
      params,
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data;
  },

  async getCategories({ signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get("/categories", {
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data.categories;
  },

  async getProductById(productId, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get(
      `/admin/products/${productId}`,
      { signal }
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async uploadProductImages(files) {
    if (!Array.isArray(files) || files.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Kam az kam aik image select karein.");
    }

    const formData = new FormData();

    files.forEach((file) => {
      formData.append("images", file);
    });

    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/products/images",
      formData
    );

    return response.data.data.images;
  },

  async createProduct(payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.post("/products", payload);

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async updateProduct(productId, payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/products/${productId}`,
      payload
    );

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async activateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/activate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async deactivateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/deactivate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },
};

export default adminProductService;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminDashboard.js ==========

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import adminService from "../services/adminService";

const useAdminDashboard = () => {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const data = await adminService.getDashboard({ signal });

      setDashboard(data);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code === "ERR_CANCELED") {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        error.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load dashboard data. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    fetchDashboard(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const refreshDashboard = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchDashboard();
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  return {
    dashboard,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refreshDashboard,
  };
};

export default useAdminDashboard;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminProducts.js ==========

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import adminProductService from "../services/adminProductService";

const INITIAL_FILTERS = {
  search: "",
  category: "",
  status: "all",
  stockStatus: "all",
  sort: "newest",
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
};

const useAdminProducts = () => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState(null);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchProducts = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const params = {
        ...filters,
        category: filters.category || undefined,
      };

      const data = await adminProductService.getProducts(
        params,
        { signal }
      );

      setProducts(data.products);
      setCategories(data.categories);
      setPagination(data.pagination);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load products. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setFilters((current) => {
        if (current.search === searchInput.trim()) {
          return current;
        }

        return {
          ...current,
          search: searchInput.trim(),
          page: 1,
        };
      });
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const updateFilter = useCallback((name, value) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [name]: value,
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, []);

  const changePage = useCallback((page) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page,
    }));
  }, []);

  const refreshProducts = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  const toggleProductStatus = useCallback(async (product) => {
    const productId = product._id;

    try {
      setActionLoading(productId);
      setError("");

      if (product.isActive) {
        await adminProductService.deactivateProduct(productId);
      } else {
        await adminProductService.activateProduct(productId);
      }

      await fetchProducts();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to update product status. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  return {
    products,
    categories,
    pagination,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    updateFilter,
    changePage,
    refreshProducts,
    toggleProductStatus,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
  };
};

export default useAdminProducts;

          path="/account/orders/:orderId"

        />

      <Route element={<ProtectedAdminRoute />}>

        <Route path="/admin/products" element={<AdminProducts />} />

        <Route
          path="/admin/products/new"
          element={<AdminProductForm />}
        />

        <Route
          path="/admin/products/:id/edit"
          element={<AdminProductForm />}
        />
        <Route
  path="/admin/categories"
  element={<AdminCategories />}
/>

<Route
  path="/admin/categories/new"
  element={<AdminCategoryForm />}
/>

<Route
  path="/admin/categories/:id/edit"
  element={<AdminCategoryForm />}
/>
      </Route>

      <Route
        path="*"
        element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}
      />
    </Routes>
  );
}

export default App;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\components\ProfileForm.jsx ==========

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Save } from "lucide-react";
import { validateProfile } from "../utils/accountValidation";

const ProfileForm = ({ user, onSave }) => {
  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    fullName: user.fullName || "",
    phone: user.phone || "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues({
      fullName: user.fullName || "",
      phone: user.phone || "",
    });
  }, [user]);

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    setErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: "" }));
    setMessage("");
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationErrors = validateProfile(values);
    setErrors(validationErrors);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length) return;

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      await onSave(values);
      setMessage("Profile updated successfully.");
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message || "Unable to update profile.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className="account-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-name">Full Name</label>
        <input
          id="profile-name"
          name="fullName"
          value={values.fullName}
          onChange={handleChange}
          autoComplete="name"
          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.fullName)}
        />
        {errors.fullName && (
          <span className="account-error">{errors.fullName}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-email">Email Address</label>
        <input
          id="profile-email"
          type="email"
          value={user.email}
          disabled
        />
        <small className="account-field-note">
          Email changes require backend verification.
        </small>
      </div>

      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-phone">Phone Number</label>
        <input
          id="profile-phone"
          name="phone"
          type="tel"
          value={values.phone}
          onChange={handleChange}
          autoComplete="tel"
          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.phone)}
        />
        {errors.phone && (
          <span className="account-error">{errors.phone}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      {message && (
        <p className="account-form-message" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}

      <button
        type="submit"
        className="account-primary-button"
        disabled={saving}
      >
        <Save size={17} />
        {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Changes"}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};

export default ProfileForm;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\components\ProtectedAccountRoute.jsx ==========

import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";

const ProtectedAccountRoute = () => {
  const {
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
  } = useAccount();

  if (isLoading) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedAccountRoute;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\hooks\useAccount.js ==========

import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

import accountService from "../services/accountService";

const useAccount = () => {
  const account = useSyncExternalStore(
    accountService.subscribe,
    accountService.getSnapshot,
    accountService.getSnapshot
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    accountService.initialize();
  }, []);

  return {
    currentUser: account.currentUser,

    isAuthenticated: Boolean(account.currentUser),

    isLoading: !account.isInitialized,

    login: accountService.login,
    register: accountService.register,
    logout: accountService.logout,
    updateProfile: accountService.updateProfile,
    requestPasswordReset: accountService.requestPasswordReset,
  };
};

export default useAccount;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\pages\ForgotPasswordPage.jsx ==========

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, Mail, Send } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";
import { validateEmail } from "../utils/accountValidation";
import "../account.css";

const ForgotPasswordPage = () => {
  const { requestPasswordReset } = useAccount();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationError = validateEmail(email);
    setError(validationError);

    if (validationError) return;

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await requestPasswordReset(email);
      setSuccess(true);
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to process your request.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="auth-page">
        <section className="auth-card">
          <div className="auth-brand-mark">N</div>

          <span className="account-eyebrow">ACCOUNT RECOVERY</span>
          <h1>Forgot Password?</h1>
          <p className="auth-description">
            Enter your registered email address to begin account recovery.
          </p>

          {success ? (
            <div className="auth-success-message" role="status">
              Password recovery is not connected yet. Email delivery will
              be available after backend integration.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
              <div className="account-form-field">
                <label htmlFor="recovery-email">Email Address</label>
                <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                  <Mail size={18} />
                  <input
                    id="recovery-email"
                    type="email"
                    placeholder="you@example.com"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setEmail(event.target.value);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                {error && (
                  <span className="account-error">{error}</span>
                )}
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="account-primary-button auth-submit"
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                <Send size={17} />
                {submitting ? "Processing..." : "Continue"}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          <Link to="/login" className="auth-back-link">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} />
            Back to Sign In
          </Link>
        </section>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default ForgotPasswordPage;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\pages\LoginPage.jsx ==========

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate,  Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { LockKeyhole, Mail, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";
import { validateLogin } from "../utils/accountValidation";
import "../account.css";

const LoginPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login, isAuthenticated } = useAccount();

  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    email: "",
    password: "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
if (isAuthenticated) {
  return <Navigate to="/account" replace />;
}

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    setErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: "" }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationErrors = validateLogin(values);
    setErrors(validationErrors);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length) return;

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await login(values);
      navigate("/account", { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setErrors({ general: "Unable to sign in. Please try again." });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="auth-page">
        <section className="auth-card">
          <div className="auth-brand-mark">N</div>

          <span className="account-eyebrow">WELCOME BACK</span>
          <h1>Sign In</h1>
          <p className="auth-description">
            Access your NexaMart account and manage your orders.
          </p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
            <div className="account-form-field">
              <label htmlFor="login-email">Email Address</label>
              <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                <Mail size={18} />
                <input
                  id="login-email"
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={values.email}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.email && (
                <span className="account-error">{errors.email}</span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="account-form-field">
              <div className="auth-label-row">
                <label htmlFor="login-password">Password</label>
                <Link to="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</Link>
              </div>

              <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                <LockKeyhole size={18} />
                <input
                  id="login-password"
                  name="password"
                  type="password"
                  placeholder="Enter your password"
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={values.password}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.password && (
                <span className="account-error">{errors.password}</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {errors.general && (
              <p className="account-error">{errors.general}</p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="account-primary-button auth-submit"
              disabled={submitting}
            >
              {submitting ? "Signing In..." : "Sign In"}
              <ArrowRight size={18} />
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="auth-footer">
            Don't have an account? <Link to="/register">Create Account</Link>
          </p>

          <p className="auth-demo-note">
            Demo mode: any valid email and password of at least 8 characters
            will create a demo session. No real authentication is performed.
          </p>
        </section>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import {
  formatOrderPrice,
  formatOrderDate,
  getOrderStatusLabel,
} from "../../orders/utils/orderUtils";

import "../account.css";

const getOrderId = (order) => order._id || order.id;

const MyOrdersPage = () => {
  const { currentUser } = useAccount();

  const {
    orders,
    loading,
    error,
    refreshOrders,
  } = useOrders();

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="account-page">
        <div className="account-container">
          <AccountHeader
            title="My Orders"
            description="View and manage your purchases."
            user={currentUser}
          />

          <div className="account-layout">
            <AccountSidebar />

            <section className="account-content">
              <div className="account-panel">
                <div className="account-panel-heading">
                  <h2>Order History</h2>

                  <p>
                    {loading
                      ? "Loading your orders..."
                      : `${orders.length} order(s) found.`}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {loading ? (
                  <div className="account-empty-state">
                    <Package size={32} />
                    <h3>Loading Orders</h3>
                    <p>Please wait while we retrieve your purchases.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : error ? (
                  <div
                    className="account-empty-state"

                    <Package size={32} />

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="account-primary-button"
                      onClick={refreshOrders}
                    >
                      Try Again
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : orders.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="account-orders-list">
                    {orders.map((order) => {
                      const orderId = getOrderId(order);

                      return (
                        <article
                          className="account-order-card"
                          key={orderId}
                        >
                          <div className="account-order-header">
                            <div>
                              <span>Order Reference</span>
                              <strong>
                                {order.orderNumber || orderId}
                              </strong>
                            </div>

                            <span
                              className={`order-status order-status-${order.status}`}
                            >
                              {getOrderStatusLabel(order.status)}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="account-order-meta">
                            <span>
                              {formatOrderDate(order.createdAt)}
                            </span>

                            <span>
                              {(order.items || []).length} product(s)
                            </span>

                            <strong>
                              {formatOrderPrice(order.total)}
                            </strong>
                          </div>

                          <Link
                            to={`/account/orders/${orderId}`}
                            className="account-order-link"
                          >
                            View Order Details
                            <ArrowRight size={16} />
                          </Link>
                        </article>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="account-empty-state">
                    <span className="account-empty-icon">
                      <Package size={32} />
                    </span>

                    <h3>No orders yet</h3>

                    <p>
                      Your purchases will appear here after you
                      successfully place an order.
                    </p>

                    <Link
                      to="/shop"
                      className="account-primary-button"
                    >
                      <ShoppingBag size={17} />
                      Explore Products
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\services\accountService.js ==========

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

let snapshot = {
  currentUser: null,
  isInitialized: false,
};

const listeners = new Set();
let initializationPromise = null;

const notify = () => {
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
};

const updateSnapshot = (updates) => {
  snapshot = {
    ...snapshot,
    ...updates,
  };

  notify();
};

const getUser = (response) => response.data.data.user;

const accountService = {
  getSnapshot: () => snapshot,

  subscribe: (listener) => {
    listeners.add(listener);

    return () => listeners.delete(listener);
  },

  async initialize() {
    if (snapshot.isInitialized) {
      return snapshot.currentUser;
    }

    if (initializationPromise) {
      return initializationPromise;
    }

    initializationPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const response = await apiClient.get("/auth/me");

        updateSnapshot({
          currentUser: getUser(response),
          isInitialized: true,
        });
      } catch {
        updateSnapshot({
          currentUser: null,
          isInitialized: true,
        });
      } finally {
        initializationPromise = null;
      }

      return snapshot.currentUser;
    })();

    return initializationPromise;
  },

  async register(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/auth/register",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
      isInitialized: true,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async login(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/auth/login",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
      isInitialized: true,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async logout() {
    try {
      await apiClient.post("/auth/logout");
    } finally {
      updateSnapshot({
        currentUser: null,
        isInitialized: true,
      });
    }
  },

  async updateProfile(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      "/auth/profile",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async requestPasswordReset(email) {
    if (!email?.trim()) {
      throw new Error("Email address is required.");
    }

    throw new Error(
      "Password reset is not available yet."
    );
  },
};

export default accountService;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\account\utils\accountValidation.js ==========

const isValidEmail = (email) =>
  /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email.trim());

export const validateLogin = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!isValidEmail(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (!values.password) {
    errors.password = "Password is required.";
  } else if (values.password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = "Password must contain at least 8 characters.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateRegistration = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Name must contain at least 3 characters.";
  }

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!isValidEmail(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").length < 10) {
    errors.phone = "Enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (!values.password) {
    errors.password = "Password is required.";
  } else if (values.password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = "Use at least 8 characters.";
  }

  if (values.password !== values.confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = "Passwords do not match.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateProfile = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Name must contain at least 3 characters.";
  }

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").length < 10) {
    errors.phone = "Enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateEmail = (email) => {
  if (!email.trim()) return "Email address is required.";
  if (!isValidEmail(email)) return "Enter a valid email address.";
  return "";
};

import {

const formatCurrency = (value = 0) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(value);

const getStockStatus = (stock) => {
  if (stock === 0) {
    return { label: "Out of stock", className: "out" };
  }

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };
  }

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };
};

const AdminProductTable = ({
  products,
  isLoading,
  actionLoading,
  onToggleStatus,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={30} />
        <span>Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={34} />
        <strong>No products found</strong>
        <span>Try changing your search or filters.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="admin-products__table-wrap">
      <table className="admin-products__table">

            <th>SKU</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Price</th>
            <th>Inventory</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const stock = getStockStatus(product.stock);
            const isUpdating = actionLoading === product._id;

            return (
              <tr key={product._id}>
                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__product">
                    <img
                      src={product.image}
                      alt={product.name}
                      loading="lazy"
                    />

                    <div>
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.slug}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="admin-products__sku">
                  {product.sku}
                </td>

                <td>{product.category}</td>

                <td className="admin-products__price">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__stock admin-products__stock--${stock.className}`}
                  >
                    {stock.className === "out" && (
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} />
                    )}
                    {product.stock} Â· {stock.label}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__status ${
                      product.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"

                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__actions">

                      to={`/admin/products/${product._id}/edit`}
                      className="admin-products__edit"

                      title="Edit product"
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={17} />

                    <button
                      type="button"

                        product.isActive
                          ? "is-deactivate"
                          : "is-activate"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => onToggleStatus(product)}
                      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
                      aria-label={
                        product.isActive
                          ? `Deactivate ${product.name}`
                          : `Activate ${product.name}`
                      }

import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../../account/hooks/useAccount";

const ProtectedAdminRoute = () => {
  const {
    currentUser,
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
  } = useAccount();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-auth-loading" role="status">
        Verifying administrator access...
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (currentUser?.role !== "admin") {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedAdminRoute;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import adminCategoryService from "../services/adminCategoryService";

const useAdminCategories = () => {
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchCategories = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const data = await adminCategoryService.getCategories({ signal });

      setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Categories load nahi ho sakin."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    fetchCategories(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  const refreshCategories = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchCategories();
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  const toggleCategoryStatus = useCallback(async (category) => {
    try {
      setActionLoading(category._id);
      setError("");

      if (category.isActive) {
        await adminCategoryService.deactivateCategory(category._id);
      } else {
        await adminCategoryService.activateCategory(category._id);
      }

      await fetchCategories();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Category status update nahi ho saka."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  return {
    categories,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
    refreshCategories,
    toggleCategoryStatus,
  };
};

export default useAdminCategories;

const useAdminDashboard = () => {

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const data = await adminService.getDashboard({ signal });

      setDashboard(data);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code === "ERR_CANCELED") {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        error.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load dashboard data. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    fetchDashboard(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const refreshDashboard = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchDashboard();
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  return {
    dashboard,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refreshDashboard,
  };
};

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminProducts.js ==========

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import adminProductService from "../services/adminProductService";

const INITIAL_FILTERS = {
  search: "",
  category: "",
  status: "all",
  stockStatus: "all",
  sort: "newest",
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
};

const useAdminProducts = () => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState(null);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchProducts = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const params = {
        ...filters,
        category: filters.category || undefined,
      };

      const data = await adminProductService.getProducts(
        params,
        { signal }
      );

      setProducts(data.products);
      setCategories(data.categories);
      setPagination(data.pagination);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load products. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setFilters((current) => {
        if (current.search === searchInput.trim()) {
          return current;
        }

        return {
          ...current,
          search: searchInput.trim(),
          page: 1,
        };
      });
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const updateFilter = useCallback((name, value) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [name]: value,
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, []);

  const changePage = useCallback((page) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page,
    }));
  }, []);

  const refreshProducts = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  const toggleProductStatus = useCallback(async (product) => {
    const productId = product._id;

    try {
      setActionLoading(productId);
      setError("");

      if (product.isActive) {
        await adminProductService.deactivateProduct(productId);
      } else {
        await adminProductService.activateProduct(productId);
      }

      await fetchProducts();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to update product status. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  return {
    products,
    categories,
    pagination,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    updateFilter,
    changePage,
    refreshProducts,
    toggleProductStatus,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
  };
};

export default useAdminProducts;
