import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  LoaderCircle,
  Save,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";

import adminCategoryService from "../services/adminCategoryService";

import "./admin-categories.css";

const INITIAL_FORM = {
  name: "",
  slug: "",
  description: "",
  image: "",
};

const slugify = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Something went wrong. Please try again.";

const AdminCategoryForm = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isEditMode = Boolean(id);

  const [form, setForm] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEditMode);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditMode) return undefined;

    const controller = new AbortController();

    const loadCategory = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        const categories = await adminCategoryService.getCategories({
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const category = categories.find(
          (item) => item._id === id
        );

        if (!category) {
          throw new Error("Requested category nahi mili.");
        }

        setForm({
          name: category.name ?? "",
          slug: category.slug ?? "",
          description: category.description ?? "",
          image: category.image ?? "",
        });

        setSlugTouched(true);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    loadCategory();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [id, isEditMode]);

  const updateField = (name, value) => {
    setForm((current) => {
      const updated = { ...current, [name]: value };

      if (name === "name" && !slugTouched) {
        updated.slug = slugify(value);
      }

      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      slug: form.slug.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      image: form.image.trim() || null,
    };

    if (!payload.name || !payload.slug) {
      setError("Category name aur slug required hain.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);

      if (isEditMode) {
        await adminCategoryService.updateCategory(id, payload);
      } else {
        await adminCategoryService.createCategory(payload);
      }

      navigate("/admin/categories", {
        replace: true,
        state: {
          message: isEditMode
            ? "Category updated successfully."
            : "Category created successfully.",
        },
      });
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-category-form">
        <div className="admin-category-form__state">
          <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
          <span>Loading category...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-category-form">
      <div className="admin-category-form__container">
        <header className="admin-category-form__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/categories"
              className="admin-category-form__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to categories
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-category-form__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>{isEditMode ? "Edit Category" : "Create Category"}</h1>

            <p>
              {isEditMode
                ? "Update your category information."
                : "Add a new category to your store catalog."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-category-form__security">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
            Authorized Administrator
          </div>
        </header>

        {error && (
          <div className="admin-category-form__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form
          className="admin-category-form__panel"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <div className="admin-category-form__section-heading">
            <h2>Category Information</h2>
            <p>Enter the details used in your store catalog.</p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-category-form__grid">
            <label className="admin-category-form__field">
              <span>Category Name *</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  updateField("name", event.target.value)
                }
                minLength={2}
                maxLength={80}
                required
                disabled={saving}
                placeholder="e.g. Men Shoes"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="admin-category-form__field">
              <span>Category Slug *</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.slug}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setSlugTouched(true);
                  updateField("slug", slugify(event.target.value));
                }}
                minLength={2}
                maxLength={100}
                pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
                required
                disabled={saving}
                placeholder="men-shoes"
              />
              <small>Category URL identifier.</small>
            </label>
          </div>

          <label className="admin-category-form__field">
            <span>Description</span>
            <textarea
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateField("description", event.target.value)
              }
              maxLength={500}
              rows={5}
              disabled={saving}
              placeholder="Write a short category description..."
            />
            <small>{form.description.length}/500 characters</small>
          </label>

          <label className="admin-category-form__field">
            <span>Category Image URL</span>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={form.image}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateField("image", event.target.value)
              }
              maxLength={2048}
              disabled={saving}
              placeholder="https://example.com/category-image.jpg"
            />
            <small>
              Secure HTTPS image URL use karein.
            </small>
          </label>

          {form.image && (
            <div className="admin-category-form__preview">
              <img
                src={form.image}
                alt="Category preview"
                onError={(event) => {
                  event.currentTarget.style.display = "none";
                }}
              />
              <span>
                <ImageIcon size={15} />
                Image preview
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="admin-category-form__actions">
            <Link
              to="/admin/categories"
              className="admin-category-form__cancel"
            >
              Cancel
            </Link>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="admin-category-form__submit"
              disabled={saving}
            >
              {saving ? (
                <LoaderCircle size={17} className="is-spinning" />
              ) : (
                <Save size={17} />
              )}

              {saving
                ? "Saving..."
                : isEditMode
                  ? "Save Changes"
                  : "Create Category"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCategoryForm;

import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Image as ImageIcon,

  X,
  Star,
} from "lucide-react";

  sku: "",
  slug: "",
  name: "",
  category: "",
  categoryId: "",
  price: "",
  compareAtPrice: "",
  badge: "",
  description: "",
  stock: "0",
  isNewArrival: false,
  bestSeller: false,
  isActive: true,
};

const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

  "image/jpeg",
  "image/png",
  "image/webp",
  "image/avif",
];

const slugify = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

const AdminProductForm = () => {

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isEditMode = Boolean(id);

  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const objectUrlsRef = useRef(new Set());

  const [images, setImages] = useState([]);
  const [mainImageId, setMainImageId] = useState(null);

  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);

  const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEditMode);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Load active categories.
  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const loadCategories = async () => {
      try {
        setCategoriesLoading(true);

        const data = await adminProductService.getCategories({
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));

        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

      objectUrlsRef.current.clear();
    };
  }, []);

  // Load existing product in edit mode.

    if (!isEditMode) return undefined;

        const product = await adminProductService.getProductById(

        );

        setForm({
          sku: product.sku ?? "",
          slug: product.slug ?? "",
          name: product.name ?? "",
          category: product.category ?? "",
          categoryId: product.categoryId ?? "",
          price: String(product.price ?? ""),
          compareAtPrice:
            product.compareAtPrice == null
              ? ""
              : String(product.compareAtPrice),
          badge: product.badge ?? "",
          description: product.description ?? "",
          stock: String(product.stock ?? 0),
          isNewArrival: Boolean(product.isNewArrival),
          bestSeller: Boolean(product.bestSeller),
          isActive: Boolean(product.isActive),
        });

        const existingImages = Array.isArray(product.images)
          ? product.images.map((image, index) => ({
              id: image.publicId || `existing-${index}`,
              url: image.url,
              publicId: image.publicId,
              file: null,
              previewUrl: image.url,
              isExisting: true,
            }))
          : [];

        const initialImages = existingImages.length
          ? existingImages
          : product.image
            ? [
                {
                  id: "legacy-image",
                  url: product.image,
                  publicId: null,
                  file: null,
                  previewUrl: product.image,
                  isExisting: true,
                  isLegacy: true,
                },
              ]
            : [];

        setImages(initialImages);
        setMainImageId(initialImages[0]?.id ?? null);
        setSlugTouched(true);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    loadProduct();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [id, isEditMode]);

  const updateField = (name, value) => {
    setForm((current) => {
      const updated = { ...current, [name]: value };

      if (name === "name" && !slugTouched) {
        updated.slug = slugify(value);
      }

      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (event) => {
    const categoryId = event.target.value;

    const selectedCategory = categories.find(
      (category) => category._id === categoryId
    );

    if (selectedCategory) {
      setForm((current) => ({
        ...current,
        categoryId: selectedCategory._id,
        category: selectedCategory.name,
      }));

      return;
    }

    // Preserve an existing legacy category.
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      categoryId: "",
    }));
  };

  const releaseImagePreview = (url) => {
    if (!url || !objectUrlsRef.current.has(url)) return;

    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    objectUrlsRef.current.delete(url);
  };

  const handleImageSelection = (event) => {
    const selectedFiles = Array.from(event.target.files || []);

    event.target.value = "";

    if (!selectedFiles.length) return;

    setError("");

    const availableSlots = MAX_IMAGES - images.length;

    if (availableSlots <= 0) {
      setError(`Maximum ${MAX_IMAGES} images allowed hain.`);
      return;
    }

    const acceptedFiles = [];
    const validationErrors = [];

    selectedFiles.forEach((file) => {
      if (!ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
        validationErrors.push(
          `${file.name}: Unsupported image format.`
        );
        return;
      }

      if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
        validationErrors.push(
          `${file.name}: Image size 5MB se zyada hai.`
        );
        return;
      }

      acceptedFiles.push(file);
    });

    const filesToAdd = acceptedFiles.slice(0, availableSlots);

    if (acceptedFiles.length > availableSlots) {
      validationErrors.push(
        `Sirf ${availableSlots} additional images add ho sakti hain.`
      );
    }

    if (validationErrors.length) {
      setError(validationErrors.join(" "));
    }

    if (!filesToAdd.length) return;

    const newImages = filesToAdd.map((file, index) => {
      const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

      objectUrlsRef.current.add(previewUrl);

      return {
        id: createImageId(file, index),
        url: "",
        publicId: null,
        file,
        previewUrl,
        isExisting: false,
      };
    });

    if (!images.some((image) => !image.isLegacy)) {
      setMainImageId(newImages[0].id);
    }

    setImages((current) => [...current, ...newImages]);
  };

  const handleRemoveImage = (imageId) => {
    const targetImage = images.find(
      (image) => image.id === imageId
    );

    if (!targetImage) return;

    releaseImagePreview(targetImage.previewUrl);

    const updatedImages = images.filter(
      (image) => image.id !== imageId
    );

    setImages(updatedImages);

    if (mainImageId === imageId) {
      setMainImageId(updatedImages[0]?.id ?? null);
    }
  };

  const handleSetMainImage = (imageId) => {
    const targetImage = images.find(
      (image) => image.id === imageId
    );

    if (!targetImage) return;

    if (
      targetImage.isLegacy &&
      images.some((image) => !image.isLegacy)
    ) {
      setError(
        "Cloudinary images mein se main image select karein."
      );
      return;
    }

    setMainImageId(imageId);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    setError("");

    const mainImage =
      images.find((image) => image.id === mainImageId) ??
      images[0] ??
      null;

    if (!mainImage) {
      setError("Kam az kam aik product image select karein.");
      return;
    }

    if (mainImage.id !== mainImageId) {
      setMainImageId(mainImage.id);
    }

    const payload = {
      ...form,
      sku: form.sku.trim().toUpperCase(),
      slug: form.slug.trim(),
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category.trim(),
      price: Number(form.price),
      compareAtPrice:
        form.compareAtPrice.trim() === ""
          ? null
          : Number(form.compareAtPrice),
      badge: form.badge.trim() || null,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      stock: Number(form.stock),
      isNewArrival: Boolean(form.isNewArrival),
      bestSeller: Boolean(form.bestSeller),
      isActive: Boolean(form.isActive),
    };

    const selectedCategory = categories.find(
      (category) =>
        category._id === form.categoryId ||
        category.name === form.category
    );

    if (selectedCategory) {
      payload.categoryId = selectedCategory._id;
      payload.category = selectedCategory.name;
    } else if (form.categoryId) {
      setError(
        "Selected category available nahi hai. Dobara select karein."
      );
      return;
    } else {
      delete payload.categoryId;
    }

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(payload.price) ||
      payload.price < 0 ||
      !Number.isInteger(payload.stock) ||
      payload.stock < 0
    ) {
      setError(
        "Price aur stock valid non-negative numbers hone chahiye."
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      payload.compareAtPrice !== null &&
      (!Number.isFinite(payload.compareAtPrice) ||
        payload.compareAtPrice <= payload.price)
    ) {
      setError(
        "Compare-at price selling price se zyada honi chahiye."
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);

      const newImages = images.filter(
        (image) => image.file
      );

      let uploadedImages = [];

      if (newImages.length) {
        uploadedImages =
          await adminProductService.uploadProductImages(
            newImages.map((image) => image.file)
          );
      }

      let uploadIndex = 0;

      const resolvedImages = images.map((image) => {
        if (!image.file) return image;

        const uploadedImage = uploadedImages[uploadIndex];

        uploadIndex += 1;

        if (!uploadedImage?.url || !uploadedImage?.publicId) {
          throw new Error(
            "Image upload response invalid hai. Dobara try karein."
          );
        }

        return {
          ...image,
          url: uploadedImage.url,
          publicId: uploadedImage.publicId,
        };
      });

      const orderedImages = [
        ...resolvedImages.filter(
          (image) => image.id === mainImageId
        ),
        ...resolvedImages.filter(
          (image) => image.id !== mainImageId
        ),
      ];

      const primaryImage = orderedImages[0];

      payload.image = primaryImage.url;

      const cloudinaryImages = orderedImages
        .filter((image) => image.publicId)
        .map(({ url, publicId }) => ({
          url,
          publicId,
        }));

      payload.images = cloudinaryImages;

      if (isEditMode) {
        delete payload.sku;

        await adminProductService.updateProduct(
          id,
          payload
        );
      } else {
        await adminProductService.createProduct(payload);
      }

      navigate("/admin/products", {
        replace: true,
        state: {
          message: isEditMode
            ? "Product updated successfully."
            : "Product created successfully.",
        },
      });
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-product-form">
        <div className="admin-product-form__state">
          <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
          <span>Loading product details...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-product-form">
      <div className="admin-product-form__container">
        <header className="admin-product-form__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/products"
              className="admin-product-form__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to products
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-product-form__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>
              {isEditMode ? "Edit Product" : "Create Product"}
            </h1>

            <p>
              {isEditMode
                ? "Update your product information and catalog settings."
                : "Add a new product to your NexaMart catalog."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-product-form__security">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
            Authorized Administrator
          </div>
        </header>

        {error && (
          <div className="admin-product-form__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form
          className="admin-product-form__layout"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Product Information</h2>
              <p>Basic details displayed in your store catalog.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__grid">
              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Name *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("name", event.target.value)
                  }
                  minLength={2}
                  maxLength={160}
                  required
                  placeholder="Enter product name"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>SKU *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.sku}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField(
                      "sku",
                      event.target.value.toUpperCase()
                    )
                  }
                  minLength={3}
                  maxLength={40}
                  required
                  readOnly={isEditMode}
                  placeholder="e.g. NM-009"
                />
                {isEditMode && (
                  <small>SKU cannot be changed after creation.</small>
                )}
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Slug *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.slug}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setSlugTouched(true);
                    updateField("slug", slugify(event.target.value));
                  }}
                  minLength={3}
                  maxLength={180}
                  pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
                  required
                  placeholder="product-url-slug"
                />
                <small>Used in the product URL.</small>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Category *</span>
                <select
                  value={
                    form.categoryId ||
                    (form.category ? `legacy:${form.category}` : "")
                  }
                  onChange={handleCategoryChange}
                  required
                  disabled={categoriesLoading || saving}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {categoriesLoading
                      ? "Loading categories..."
                      : "Select a category"}
                  </option>

                  {categories.map((category) => (
                    <option
                      key={category._id}
                      value={category._id}
                    >
                      {category.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}

                  {form.category &&
                    !categories.some(
                      (category) =>
                        category._id === form.categoryId ||
                        category.name === form.category
                    ) && (
                      <option value={`legacy:${form.category}`}>
                        {form.category} (Legacy)
                      </option>
                    )}
                </select>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Badge</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.badge}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("badge", event.target.value)
                  }
                  maxLength={60}
                  placeholder="e.g. Best Value"
                />
              </label>
            </div>

            <label className="admin-product-form__field admin-product-form__description">
              <span>Description *</span>
              <textarea
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  updateField("description", event.target.value)
                }
                minLength={10}
                maxLength={3000}
                rows={6}
                required
                placeholder="Write a detailed product description..."
              />
              <small>
                {form.description.length}/3000 characters
              </small>
            </label>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Product Images</h2>
              <p>
                Computer se images select karein. Main image
                storefront par primary image hogi.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__upload">
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/avif"
                multiple
                hidden
                onChange={handleImageSelection}
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                className="admin-product-form__upload-button"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                disabled={saving || images.length >= MAX_IMAGES}
              >
                <Upload size={19} />
                <span>
                  {images.length >= MAX_IMAGES
                    ? "Image limit reached"
                    : "Choose images from computer"}
                </span>
              </button>

              <p className="admin-product-form__upload-hint">
                JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF Â· Maximum 5MB each Â·
                Maximum 8 images
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__image-count">
              <span>Selected images</span>
              <strong>
                {images.length}/{MAX_IMAGES}
              </strong>
            </div>

            {images.length ? (
              <div className="admin-product-form__image-grid">
                {images.map((image) => {
                  const isMain = image.id === mainImageId;

                  return (
                    <article
                      className={`admin-product-form__image-card ${
                        isMain ? "is-main" : ""
                      }`}
                      key={image.id}
                    >
                      <div className="admin-product-form__image-frame">
                        <img
                          src={image.previewUrl}
                          alt="Product"
                        />

                        {isMain && (
                          <span className="admin-product-form__main-badge">
                            <Star size={12} fill="currentColor" />
                            Main Image
                          </span>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="admin-product-form__image-remove"
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveImage(image.id)}
                          disabled={saving}
                          aria-label="Remove image"
                          title="Remove image"
                        >
                          <X size={15} />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <div className="admin-product-form__image-meta">
                        {!isMain && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="admin-product-form__main-action"
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleSetMainImage(image.id)
                            }
                            disabled={saving}
                          >
                            Set as main
                          </button>
                        )}

                        {image.file && (
                          <small>
                            {(image.file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB
                          </small>
                        )}

                        {image.isLegacy && (
                          <small>Existing legacy image</small>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </article>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-product-form__empty-images">
                <ImageIcon size={34} />
                <span>No product images selected.</span>
                <small>At least one image is required.</small>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Pricing & Inventory</h2>
              <p>Configure product pricing and stock availability.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__grid">
              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Selling Price (PKR) *</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={form.price}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("price", event.target.value)
                  }
                  required
                  placeholder="0"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Compare-at Price (PKR)</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="0.01"
                  value={form.compareAtPrice}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("compareAtPrice", event.target.value)
                  }
                  placeholder="Optional"
                />
                <small>Must be higher than selling price.</small>
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Stock Quantity *</span>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="1"
                  value={form.stock}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("stock", event.target.value)
                  }
                  required
                />
              </label>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Catalog Settings</h2>
              <p>Control product visibility and merchandising.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__toggles">
              <label>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.isNewArrival}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("isNewArrival", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>New Arrival</strong>
                  <small>Display this product in new arrivals.</small>
                </span>
              </label>

              <label>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.bestSeller}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("bestSeller", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>Best Seller</strong>
                  <small>Mark this product as a best seller.</small>
                </span>
              </label>

              <label>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={form.isActive}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("isActive", event.target.checked)
                  }
                />
                <span>
                  <strong>Active Product</strong>
                  <small>Make this product available in the store.</small>
                </span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </section>

          <div className="admin-product-form__actions">
            <Link
              to="/admin/products"
              className="admin-product-form__cancel"
            >
              Cancel
            </Link>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="admin-product-form__submit"
              disabled={saving || categoriesLoading}
            >
              {saving ? (
                <LoaderCircle size={17} className="is-spinning" />
              ) : (
                <Save size={17} />
              )}

              {saving
                ? "Saving..."
                : isEditMode
                  ? "Save Changes"
                  : "Create Product"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminProductForm;

  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowLeft,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Package,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  SlidersHorizontal,
} from "lucide-react";

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import useAdminProducts from "../hooks/useAdminProducts";
import AdminProductTable from "../components/AdminProductTable";

import "./admin-products.css";

const AdminProducts = () => {
  const {
    products,
    categories,
    pagination,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    updateFilter,
    changePage,
    refreshProducts,
    toggleProductStatus,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
  } = useAdminProducts();

  return (
    <main className="admin-products">

              <ArrowLeft size={15} />
              Back to dashboard

            <span className="admin-products__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION

              product availability.

          <div className="admin-products__header-actions">

              <ShieldCheck size={17} />
              Authorized Administrator

            <button

              onClick={refreshProducts}
              disabled={isLoading}

              <RefreshCw
                size={16}
                className={isLoading ? "is-spinning" : ""}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>

            <Link
              to="/admin/products/new"
              className="admin-products__add"
            >
              <Plus size={17} />
              Add Product
            </Link>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-products__overview">
          <div>
            <span>Catalog overview</span>
            <strong>{pagination?.total ?? 0}</strong>
            <small>Total matching products</small>
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Current page</span>
            <strong>{pagination?.page ?? 1}</strong>
            <small>Of {pagination?.pages ?? 0} pages</small>
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Page size</span>
            <strong>{pagination?.limit ?? 12}</strong>
            <small>Products per page</small>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="admin-products__panel">
          <div className="admin-products__panel-heading">
            <div>
              <h2>Product Catalog</h2>
              <p>
                Search, filter and manage your store products.
              </p>
            </div>

            <SlidersHorizontal size={20} />
          </div>

          <div className="admin-products__filters">
            <div className="admin-products__search">
              <Search size={18} />

              <input
                type="search"
                placeholder="Search by product name or SKU..."
                value={searchInput}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setSearchInput(event.target.value)
                }
                aria-label="Search products"
              />
            </div>

            <select
              value={filters.category}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateFilter("category", event.target.value)
              }
              aria-label="Filter by category"
            >
              <option value="">All categories</option>

              {categories.map((category) => (
                <option key={category} value={category}>
                  {category}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>

            <select
              value={filters.status}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateFilter("status", event.target.value)
              }
              aria-label="Filter by product status"
            >
              <option value="all">All statuses</option>
              <option value="active">Active</option>
              <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={filters.stockStatus}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateFilter("stockStatus", event.target.value)
              }
              aria-label="Filter by stock status"
            >
              <option value="all">All inventory</option>
              <option value="in_stock">In stock</option>
              <option value="low_stock">Low stock</option>
              <option value="out_of_stock">Out of stock</option>
            </select>

            <select
              value={filters.sort}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateFilter("sort", event.target.value)
              }
              aria-label="Sort products"
            >
              <option value="newest">Newest first</option>
              <option value="oldest">Oldest first</option>
              <option value="price_asc">Price: Low to high</option>
              <option value="price_desc">Price: High to low</option>
              <option value="name_asc">Name: A to Z</option>
              <option value="name_desc">Name: Z to A</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="admin-products__error" role="alert">
              <AlertTriangle size={18} />
              <span>{error}</span>

              <button type="button" onClick={refreshProducts}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <AdminProductTable
            products={products}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            actionLoading={actionLoading}
            onToggleStatus={toggleProductStatus}
          />

          <footer className="admin-products__pagination">
            <span>
              Showing {products.length} of {pagination?.total ?? 0} products
            </span>

            <div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(filters.page - 1)}
                disabled={
                  !pagination?.hasPreviousPage || isLoading
                }
                aria-label="Previous page"
              >
                <ChevronLeft size={17} />
              </button>

              <strong>
                {pagination?.page ?? 1}
                <span> / </span>
                {pagination?.pages ?? 0}
              </strong>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(filters.page + 1)}
                disabled={
                  !pagination?.hasNextPage || isLoading
                }
                aria-label="Next page"
              >
                <ChevronRight size={17} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </footer>
        </section>

        <footer className="admin-products__footer">
          <Package size={16} />
          <span>NexaMart secure product management workspace</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminProducts;

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

const ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT = "/admin/categories";

const adminCategoryService = {
  async getCategories({ signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get(ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT, {
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data.categories;
  },

  async createCategory(payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.post(
      ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT,
      payload
    );

    return response.data.data.category;
  },

  async updateCategory(categoryId, payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `${ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT}/${categoryId}`,
      payload
    );

    return response.data.data.category;
  },

  async activateCategory(categoryId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `${ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT}/${categoryId}/activate`
    );

    return response.data.data.category;
  },

  async deactivateCategory(categoryId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `${ADMIN_CATEGORIES_ENDPOINT}/${categoryId}/deactivate`
    );

    return response.data.data.category;
  },
};

export default adminCategoryService;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\services\adminProductService.js ==========

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

const adminProductService = {
  async getProducts(params = {}, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get("/admin/products", {
      params,
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data;
  },

  async getCategories({ signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get("/categories", {
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data.categories;
  },

  async getProductById(productId, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get(
      `/admin/products/${productId}`,
      { signal }
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async uploadProductImages(files) {
    if (!Array.isArray(files) || files.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Kam az kam aik image select karein.");
    }

    const formData = new FormData();

    files.forEach((file) => {
      formData.append("images", file);
    });

    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/products/images",
      formData
    );

    return response.data.data.images;
  },

  async createProduct(payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.post("/products", payload);

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async updateProduct(productId, payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/products/${productId}`,
      payload
    );

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async activateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/activate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async deactivateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/deactivate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },
};

export default adminProductService;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\cart\components\CartItem.jsx ==========

import { Minus, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount);

export default function CartItem({
  item,
  onUpdateQuantity,
  onRemove,
}) {
  const { product, quantity } = item;

  return (
    <article className="cart-item">
      <Link
        to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
        className="cart-item__image-link"
      >
        <img
          src={product.image}
          alt={product.name}
          className="cart-item__image"
          loading="lazy"
        />
      </Link>

      <div className="cart-item__details">
        <div>
          <span className="cart-item__category">
            {product.category}
          </span>

          <Link
            to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
            className="cart-item__name"
          >
            {product.name}
          </Link>

          <p className="cart-item__price">
            {formatPrice(product.price)}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="cart-item__actions">
          <div
            className="quantity-control"
            aria-label={`Quantity for ${product.name}`}
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Decrease quantity"
              disabled={quantity <= 1}
              onClick={() =>
                onUpdateQuantity(product.id, quantity - 1)
              }
            >
              <Minus size={15} />
            </button>

            <span aria-live="polite">{quantity}</span>

            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Increase quantity"
              disabled={quantity >= product.stock}
              onClick={() =>
                onUpdateQuantity(product.id, quantity + 1)
              }
            >
              <Plus size={15} />
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="cart-item__remove"
            onClick={() => onRemove(product.id)}
          >
            <Trash2 size={16} />
            Remove
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="cart-item__total">
        {formatPrice(product.price * quantity)}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\cart\pages\CartPage.jsx ==========

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useShopStore from "../../../store/useShopStore";

import CartItem from "../components/CartItem";
import CartSummary from "../components/CartSummary";

import "../cart.css";

export default function CartPage() {
  const cartItems = useShopStore((state) => state.cartItems);
  const updateQuantity = useShopStore(
    (state) => state.updateQuantity
  );
  const removeFromCart = useShopStore(
    (state) => state.removeFromCart
  );

  const totalItems = cartItems.reduce(
    (total, item) => total + item.quantity,
    0
  );

  const subtotal = cartItems.reduce(
    (total, item) =>
      total + Number(item.product.price || 0) * item.quantity,
    0
  );

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <section className="cart-page">
        <div className="cart-page__container">
          <div className="cart-page__heading">
            <div>
              <span className="cart-page__eyebrow">
                YOUR SHOPPING BAG
              </span>

              <h1>Shopping Cart</h1>

              <p>
                Review your selected products before checkout.
              </p>
            </div>

            <Link to="/shop" className="cart-page__back">
              Continue Shopping
            </Link>
          </div>

          {cartItems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="cart-empty">
              <div className="cart-empty__icon">
                <ShoppingBag size={34} />
              </div>

              <h2>Your cart is empty</h2>

              <p>
                Discover something you love and add it to your bag.
              </p>

              <Link to="/shop" className="cart-empty__button">
                Explore Products
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="cart-layout">
              <div className="cart-items">
                <div className="cart-items__header">
                  <h2>Your Items</h2>
                  <span>{totalItems} items</span>
                </div>

                {cartItems.map((item) => (
                  <CartItem
                    key={item.product.id}
                    item={item}
                    onUpdateQuantity={updateQuantity}
                    onRemove={removeFromCart}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              <CartSummary
                subtotal={subtotal}
                totalItems={totalItems}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\checkout\components\CheckoutSteps.jsx ==========

import { Check } from "lucide-react";

const steps = ["Information", "Delivery", "Payment"];

const CheckoutSteps = ({ activeStep = 1 }) => {
  return (
    <div className="checkout-steps">
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const stepNumber = index + 1;
        const isCompleted = stepNumber < activeStep;
        const isActive = stepNumber === activeStep;

        return (
          <div
            className={`checkout-step ${
              isActive ? "active" : ""
            } ${isCompleted ? "completed" : ""}`}
            key={step}
          >
            <div className="checkout-step-indicator">
              {isCompleted ? <Check size={16} /> : stepNumber}
            </div>

            <span>{step}</span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CheckoutSteps;

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount);

const OrderSummary = ({ items, subtotal, submitting }) => {
  const totalItems = items.reduce(
    (total, item) => total + item.quantity,
    0
  );

  return (
    <aside className="checkout-summary">
      <div className="checkout-summary-heading">
        <h2>Order Summary</h2>
        <span>{totalItems} items</span>
      </div>

      <div className="checkout-summary-products">
        {items.map(({ product, quantity }) => (
          <div className="checkout-summary-product" key={product.id}>
            <div className="checkout-product-image">
              <img src={product.image} alt={product.name} />
              <span>{quantity}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="checkout-product-info">
              <strong>{product.name}</strong>
              <small>{formatPrice(product.price)}</small>
            </div>

            <strong className="checkout-product-total">
              {formatPrice(Number(product.price) * quantity)}
            </strong>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="checkout-summary-divider" />

      <div className="checkout-summary-row">
        <span>Subtotal</span>
        <strong>{formatPrice(subtotal)}</strong>
      </div>

      <div className="checkout-summary-row">
        <span>Delivery</span>
        <span>To be confirmed</span>
      </div>

      <div className="checkout-summary-total">
        <span>Order Total</span>
        <strong>{formatPrice(subtotal)}</strong>
      </div>

      <p className="checkout-summary-note">
        Delivery charges will be confirmed before dispatch. The amount
        shown above is the product subtotal only.
      </p>

      <button
        type="submit"

      </div>

  );

const CHECKOUT_FORM_ID = "nexamart-checkout-form";
const GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX = "nexamart-guest-order:";

const INITIAL_FORM_VALUES = {
  fullName: "",
  email: "",
  phone: "",
  addressLine1: "",
  addressLine2: "",
  city: "",
  province: "",
  postalCode: "",
};

const validateForm = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Please enter your full name.";
  }

  if (
    !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email.trim())
  ) {
    errors.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (values.phone.trim().length < 7) {
    errors.phone = "Please enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (values.addressLine1.trim().length < 5) {
    errors.addressLine1 = "Please enter your complete street address.";
  }

  if (values.city.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.city = "Please enter your city.";
  }

  if (values.province.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.province = "Please enter your province.";
  }

  if (values.postalCode.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.postalCode = "Please enter your postal code.";
  }

  return errors;
};

const getOrderId = (order) => order?._id || order?.id;

const CheckoutPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const cartItems = useShopStore((state) => state.cartItems);
  const clearCart = useShopStore((state) => state.clearCart);

  const { currentUser } = useAccount();

  const [formValues, setFormValues] = useState(() => ({
    ...INITIAL_FORM_VALUES,
  }));

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [deliveryMethod, setDeliveryMethod] = useState("standard");
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState("cod");

  const subtotal = useMemo(
    () =>
      cartItems.reduce(
        (total, item) =>
          total + Number(item.product?.price || 0) * item.quantity,
        0
      ),
    [cartItems]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser) return;

    setFormValues((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      fullName:
        previous.fullName ||
        currentUser.fullName ||
        currentUser.name ||
        "",
      email: previous.email || currentUser.email || "",
      phone: previous.phone || currentUser.phone || "",
    }));
  }, [currentUser]);

  const handleFieldChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormValues((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [field]: value,
    }));

    setErrors((previous) => {
      if (!previous[field]) return previous;

      const updated = { ...previous };
      delete updated[field];

      return updated;
    });

    setSubmitError("");
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (submitting) return;

    if (!cartItems.length) {
      setSubmitError("Your cart is empty.");
      return;
    }

    const validationErrors = validateForm(formValues);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(validationErrors);
      setSubmitError("Please correct the highlighted fields.");
      return;
    }

    setErrors({});
    setSubmitError("");
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const result = await orderService.createOrder({
        customer: {
          fullName: formValues.fullName.trim(),
          email: formValues.email.trim(),
          phone: formValues.phone.trim(),
          addressLine1: formValues.addressLine1.trim(),
          addressLine2: formValues.addressLine2.trim(),
          city: formValues.city.trim(),
          province: formValues.province.trim(),
          postalCode: formValues.postalCode.trim(),
        },
        items: cartItems,
        deliveryMethod,
        paymentMethod,
      });

      const orderId = getOrderId(result.order);

      if (!orderId) {
        throw new Error(
          "Order was created, but its confirmation ID is missing."
        );
      }

      if (result.guestAccessToken) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(
            `${GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX}${orderId}`,
            result.guestAccessToken
          );
        } catch {
          // Order creation remains successful if browser storage is unavailable.
        }
      }

      clearCart();

      navigate(`/order-confirmation/${orderId}`, {
        replace: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setSubmitError(
        error.response?.data?.message ||
          error.message ||
          "Unable to place your order. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!cartItems.length) {
    return (
      <MainLayout>
        <div className="checkout-page">
          <div className="checkout-container">
            <div className="checkout-empty">
              <ShoppingBag size={42} />

              <h2>Your cart is empty</h2>

              <p>
                Add products to your cart before proceeding to checkout.
              </p>

              <Link to="/shop" className="checkout-submit-button">
                Explore Products
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </MainLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="checkout-page">
        <div className="checkout-container">
          <Link to="/cart" className="checkout-back-link">
            <ArrowLeft size={17} />
            Back to Cart
          </Link>

          <div className="checkout-header">
            <div>
              <span className="checkout-eyebrow">SECURE CHECKOUT</span>
              <h1>Complete Your Order</h1>
              <p>
                Provide your details to place your NexaMart order.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="checkout-layout">
            <main className="checkout-main">
              <form
                id={CHECKOUT_FORM_ID}
                className="checkout-form"
                onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                noValidate
              >
                <CustomerInformation
                  values={formValues}
                  errors={errors}
                  onChange={handleFieldChange}
                />

                <ShippingAddressForm
                  values={formValues}
                  errors={errors}
                  onChange={handleFieldChange}
                />

                <DeliveryMethod
                  value={deliveryMethod}
                  onChange={setDeliveryMethod}
                />

                <PaymentMethod
                  value={paymentMethod}
                  onChange={setPaymentMethod}
                />

                {submitError && (
                  <div className="checkout-error-message" role="alert">
                    {submitError}
                  </div>
                )}
              </form>
            </main>

            <aside className="checkout-sidebar">
              <OrderSummary
                items={cartItems}
                subtotal={subtotal}
                submitting={submitting}
              />
            </aside>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default CheckoutPage;

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\checkout\utils\checkoutValidation.js ==========

const validateCheckoutForm = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Please enter a valid full name.";
  }

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
  }

  const phone = values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "");

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (phone.length < 10 || phone.length > 15) {
    errors.phone = "Please enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (!values.addressLine1.trim()) {
    errors.addressLine1 = "Street address is required.";
  }

  if (!values.city.trim()) {
    errors.city = "City is required.";
  }

  if (!values.province.trim()) {
    errors.province = "Province is required.";
  }

  if (!values.postalCode.trim()) {
    errors.postalCode = "Postal code is required.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export default validateCheckoutForm;

import { useState } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

const CancelOrderDialog = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  loading = false,
}) => {
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  if (!open) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (reason.trim().length < 5) {
      setError("Please enter at least 5 characters.");
      return;
    }

    onConfirm(reason.trim());
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setReason("");
    setError("");
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="cancel-dialog-overlay">
      <section
        className="cancel-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="cancel-dialog-title"
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="cancel-dialog-close"
          onClick={handleClose}
          aria-label="Close dialog"
          disabled={loading}
        >
          <X size={20} />
        </button>

        <h2 id="cancel-dialog-title">Cancel Order</h2>

        <p>Please tell us why you want to cancel this order.</p>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <textarea
            value={reason}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setReason(event.target.value);
              setError("");
            }}
            placeholder="Enter cancellation reason..."
            rows={4}
            maxLength={500}
            disabled={loading}
          />

          {error && <span className="cancel-dialog-error">{error}</span>}

          <div className="cancel-dialog-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              disabled={loading}
            >
              Keep Order
            </button>

            <button type="submit" disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? "Cancelling..." : "Confirm Cancellation"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CancelOrderDialog;

import {
  Check,
  Package,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Truck,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  formatOrderDate,
  getOrderStatusLabel,
} from "../utils/orderUtils";

const statusSteps = [
  { status: "placed", icon: Package },
  { status: "confirmed", icon: ClipboardCheck },
  { status: "processing", icon: Package },
  { status: "shipped", icon: Truck },
  { status: "delivered", icon: CheckCircle2 },
];

const OrderStatusTimeline = ({ order }) => {
  const history = order.statusHistory || [];
  const cancelled = order.status === "cancelled";

  const getHistoryEntry = (status) =>
    history.find((entry) => entry.status === status);

  return (
    <section className="order-timeline">
      <h3>Order Tracking</h3>

      {cancelled ? (
        <div className="order-timeline-cancelled">
          <XCircle size={22} />
          <div>
            <strong>Order Cancelled</strong>
            <p>{order.cancellationReason || "This order was cancelled."}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="order-timeline-steps">
          {statusSteps.map((step, index) => {
            const entry = getHistoryEntry(step.status);
            const completed = Boolean(entry);
            const active = order.status === step.status;
            const Icon = step.icon;

            return (
              <div
                className={`order-timeline-step ${
                  completed ? "completed" : ""
                } ${active ? "active" : ""}`}
                key={step.status}
              >
                <div className="order-timeline-marker">
                  {completed ? <Check size={16} /> : <Icon size={17} />}
                </div>

                <div className="order-timeline-content">
                  <strong>{getOrderStatusLabel(step.status)}</strong>

                  {entry && (
                    <>
                      <span>{formatOrderDate(entry.timestamp)}</span>
                      {entry.note && <p>{entry.note}</p>}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>

                {index !== statusSteps.length - 1 && (
                  <div className="order-timeline-line" />
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default OrderStatusTimeline;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import orderService from "../services/orderService";

const useOrders = () => {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const refreshOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result = await orderService.getMyOrders();

      setOrders(Array.isArray(result) ? result : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.message ||
          err.message ||
          "Unable to load your orders."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshOrders();
  }, [refreshOrders]);

  return {
    orders,
    loading,
    error,
    refreshOrders,
  };
};

                  <p className="order-details-note">

                    from NexaMart's backend.
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>

      <CancelOrderDialog
        open={showCancelDialog}
        onClose={() => {
          if (!cancelling) {
            setShowCancelDialog(false);
          }
        }}
        onConfirm={handleCancelOrder}
        loading={cancelling}
      />
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default OrderDetailsPage;


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\orders\services\orderService.js ==========
import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient.js";

const getResponseData = (response) => response.data?.data;

const getMyOrders = async () => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/orders/my-orders");

  return getResponseData(response)?.orders ?? [];
};

const getMyOrderById = async (orderId) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/orders/${orderId}`);

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const getGuestOrderConfirmation = async (orderId, accessToken) => {
  const response = await apiClient.post(
    `/orders/guest/${orderId}/confirmation`,
    { accessToken }
  );

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const createOrder = async ({
  customer,
  items,
  deliveryMethod = "standard",
  paymentMethod = "cod",
}) => {
  const payload = {
    customer,
    items: items.map(({ product, quantity }) => ({
      sku: product.sku || product.id,
      quantity,
    })),
    deliveryMethod,
    paymentMethod,
  };

  const response = await apiClient.post("/orders", payload);

  const result = getResponseData(response);

  if (!result?.order) {
    throw new Error("Order could not be created. Please try again.");
  }

  return result;
};

const cancelOrder = async (orderId, reason) => {
  const response = await apiClient.patch(
    `/orders/${orderId}/cancel`,
    { reason }
  );

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const orderService = {
  createOrder,
  getMyOrders,
  getMyOrderById,
  getGuestOrderConfirmation,
  cancelOrder,
};

export default orderService;

export const formatOrderPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number(amount) || 0);

export const formatOrderDate = (date) =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PK", {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
  }).format(new Date(date));

export const getOrderStatusLabel = (status) => {
  const labels = {
    placed: "Order Placed",
    confirmed: "Confirmed",
    processing: "Processing",
    shipped: "Shipped",
    delivered: "Delivered",
    cancelled: "Cancelled",
  };

  return labels[status] || "Pending";
};

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\products\hooks\useproducts.js ==========

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { productService } from "../services/productService";
import {
  filterProducts,
  sortProducts,
} from "../utils/productUtils";

export default function useProducts({
  search = "",
  category = "all",
  maxPrice = 100000,
  minRating = 0,
  inStockOnly = false,
  sortBy = "featured",
  collection = "all",
} = {}) {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadProducts() {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        const data = await productService.getProducts();

        if (isMounted) {
          setProducts(data);
        }
      } catch {
        if (isMounted) {
          setError("Products load nahi ho sake. Dobara try karein.");
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadProducts();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = filterProducts(products, {
      search,
      category,
      maxPrice,
      minRating,
      inStockOnly,
      collection,
    });

    return sortProducts(filtered, sortBy);
  }, [
    products,
    search,
    category,
    maxPrice,
    minRating,
    inStockOnly,
    sortBy,
    collection,
  ]);

  return {
    products: filteredProducts,
    totalProducts: products.length,
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

export default function ProductDetailsPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();

  const [product, setProduct] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);

  const toggleWishlist = useShopStore((state) => state.toggleWishlist);

const navigate = useNavigate();

    ? wishlistItems.includes(product.id)
    : false;

    let isMounted = true;

      setQuantity(1);

      try {
        const result = await productService.getProductBySlug(slug);

        if (isMounted) {
          setProduct(result);
        }
      } catch {

          setProduct(null);

        if (isMounted) {

                  <del>{formatPrice(product.compareAtPrice)}</del>

            </div>

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\products\services\productService.js ==========

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient.js";

const normalizeProduct = (product) => ({
  ...product,
  id: product.sku,
  rating: Number(product.rating ?? 0),
  reviewCount: Number(product.reviewCount ?? 0),
  stock: Number(product.stock ?? 0),
  isNew: product.isNewArrival ?? false,
});;

const getProductsPage = async (params = {}) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/products", {
    params,
  });

  const result = response.data.data;

  return {
    ...result,
    products: result.products.map(normalizeProduct),
  };
};

const getProducts = async (params = {}) => {
  const result = await getProductsPage(params);

  return result.products;
};


const getProductBySlug = async (slug) => {
  try {
    const response = await apiClient.get(
      `/products/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`
    );

    return normalizeProduct(response.data.data.product);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 404) {
      return null;
    }

    throw error;
  }
};



const getProductById = async (id) => {
  const products = await getProducts({ limit: 100 });

  return products.find((product) => product.id === id) ?? null;
};

const getCategories = async () => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/products/categories");

  return response.data.data;
};

export const productService = {
  getProducts,
  getProductsPage,
  getProductBySlug,
  getProductById,
  getCategories,
};


========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\products\utils\productUtils.js ==========

export function formatPrice(price) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(price);
}

export function getDiscountPercentage(price, compareAtPrice) {
  if (!compareAtPrice || compareAtPrice <= price) {
    return 0;
  }

  return Math.round(
    ((compareAtPrice - price) / compareAtPrice) * 100
  );
}

export function getProductCategories(products) {
  return [...new Set(products.map((product) => product.category))];
}

export function filterProducts(products, filters = {}) {
  const {
    search = "",
    category = "all",
    maxPrice = Infinity,
    minRating = 0,
    inStockOnly = false,
    collection = "all",
  } = filters;

  const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  return products.filter((product) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !normalizedSearch ||
      product.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
      product.category.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

    const matchesCategory =
      category === "all" || product.category === category;

    const matchesPrice = product.price <= maxPrice;

    const matchesRating = product.rating >= minRating;

    const matchesStock =
      !inStockOnly || product.stock > 0;

    const matchesCollection =
      collection === "all" ||
      (collection === "new-arrivals" && product.isNew) ||
      (collection === "best-sellers" && product.bestSeller);

    return (
      matchesSearch &&
      matchesCategory &&
      matchesPrice &&
      matchesRating &&
      matchesStock &&
      matchesCollection
    );
  });
}

export function sortProducts(products, sortBy = "featured") {
  const sorted = [...products];

  switch (sortBy) {
    case "price-low":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);

    case "price-high":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);

    case "rating":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating);

    case "newest":
      return sorted.sort(
        (a, b) => Number(b.isNew) - Number(a.isNew)
      );

    default:
      return sorted.sort(
        (a, b) => Number(b.bestSeller) - Number(a.bestSeller)
      );
  }
}
