import { Heart, ShoppingBag, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount);

export default function WishlistItem({
  product,
  onRemove,
  onAddToCart,
}) {
  const isOutOfStock = Number(product.stock) <= 0;

  return (
    <article className="wishlist-item">
      <Link
        to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
        className="wishlist-item__image-link"
      >
        <img
          src={product.image}
          alt={product.name}
          className="wishlist-item__image"
          loading="lazy"
        />
      </Link>

      <div className="wishlist-item__content">
        <span className="wishlist-item__category">
          {product.category}
        </span>

        <Link
          to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
          className="wishlist-item__name"
        >
          {product.name}
        </Link>

        <strong className="wishlist-item__price">
          {formatPrice(product.price)}
        </strong>

        <span
          className={
            isOutOfStock
              ? "wishlist-item__stock is-out"
              : "wishlist-item__stock"
          }
        >
          {isOutOfStock ? "Out of stock" : "In stock"}
        </span>

        <div className="wishlist-item__actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="wishlist-item__add"
            disabled={isOutOfStock}
            onClick={() => onAddToCart(product)}
          >
            <ShoppingBag size={16} />
            Add to Cart
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="wishlist-item__remove"
            aria-label={`Remove ${product.name} from wishlist`}
            onClick={() => onRemove(product.id)}
          >
            <Trash2 size={17} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Heart
        className="wishlist-item__heart"
        size={19}
        fill="currentColor"
      />
    </article>
  );
}

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminProducts.js ==========

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import adminProductService from "../services/adminProductService";

const INITIAL_FILTERS = {
  search: "",
  category: "",
  status: "all",
  stockStatus: "all",
  sort: "newest",
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
};

const useAdminProducts = () => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState(null);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchProducts = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const params = {
        ...filters,
        category: filters.category || undefined,
      };

      const data = await adminProductService.getProducts(
        params,
        { signal }
      );

      setProducts(data.products);
      setCategories(data.categories);
      setPagination(data.pagination);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load products. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setFilters((current) => {
        if (current.search === searchInput.trim()) {
          return current;
        }

        return {
          ...current,
          search: searchInput.trim(),
          page: 1,
        };
      });
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const updateFilter = useCallback((name, value) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [name]: value,
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, []);

  const changePage = useCallback((page) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page,
    }));
  }, []);

  const refreshProducts = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  const toggleProductStatus = useCallback(async (product) => {
    const productId = product._id;

    try {
      setActionLoading(productId);
      setError("");

      if (product.isActive) {
        await adminProductService.deactivateProduct(productId);
      } else {
        await adminProductService.activateProduct(productId);
      }

      await fetchProducts();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to update product status. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  return {
    products,
    categories,
    pagination,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    updateFilter,
    changePage,
    refreshProducts,
    toggleProductStatus,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
  };
};

export default useAdminProducts;

const AdminProductForm = () => {

        });

          ? product.images.map((image, index) => ({

  const releaseImagePreview = (url) => {

  const handleImageSelection = (event) => {
    const selectedFiles = Array.from(event.target.files || []);

    // Same file ko dobara select karne ki permission.
    event.target.value = "";

    if (!selectedFiles.length) return;

    setError("");

    const availableSlots = MAX_IMAGES - images.length;

    if (availableSlots <= 0) {

    }

    const acceptedFiles = [];

    selectedFiles.forEach((file) => {
      if (!ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {

        validationErrors.push(

      }

    });

setImages((current) => [...current, ...newImages]);

}

if (mainImage.id !== mainImageId) {

}

    const payload = {

    };

      );

    }

          );

        .map(({ url, publicId }) => ({
          url,
          publicId,
        }));

      payload.images = cloudinaryImages;

      if (isEditMode) {
        delete payload.sku;

        await adminProductService.updateProduct(
          id,
          payload
        );
      } else {
        await adminProductService.createProduct(payload);
      }

      navigate("/admin/products", {
        replace: true,
        state: {
          message: isEditMode
            ? "Product updated successfully."
            : "Product created successfully.",
        },
      });
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-product-form">
        <div className="admin-product-form__state">
          <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
          <span>Loading product details...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-product-form">
      <div className="admin-product-form__container">
        <header className="admin-product-form__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/products"
              className="admin-product-form__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to products
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-product-form__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>
              {isEditMode ? "Edit Product" : "Create Product"}
            </h1>

            <p>
              {isEditMode
                ? "Update your product information and catalog settings."
                : "Add a new product to your NexaMart catalog."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-product-form__security">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
            Authorized Administrator
          </div>
        </header>

        {error && (
          <div className="admin-product-form__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form
          className="admin-product-form__layout"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <section className="admin-product-form__panel">
            <div className="admin-product-form__section-heading">
              <h2>Product Information</h2>
              <p>Basic details displayed in your store catalog.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-product-form__grid">
              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Name *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateField("name", event.target.value)
                  }
                  minLength={2}
                  maxLength={160}
                  required
                  placeholder="Enter product name"
                />
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">

                {isEditMode && (

                )}
              </label>

              <label className="admin-product-form__field">
                <span>Product Slug *</span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.slug}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setSlugTouched(true);
                    updateField("slug", slugify(event.target.value));
                  }}
                  minLength={3}
                  maxLength={180}
                  pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
                  required
                  placeholder="product-url-slug"

========== E:\NexMart\frontend\src\features\admin\services\adminProductService.js ==========

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

const adminProductService = {
  async getProducts(params = {}, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get("/admin/products", {
      params,
      signal,
    });

    return response.data.data;
  },

  async getProductById(productId, { signal } = {}) {
    const response = await apiClient.get(
      `/admin/products/${productId}`,
      { signal }
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async uploadProductImages(files) {
    if (!Array.isArray(files) || files.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Kam az kam aik image select karein.");
    }

    const formData = new FormData();

    files.forEach((file) => {
      formData.append("images", file);
    });

    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/products/images",
      formData
    );

    return response.data.data.images;
  },

  async createProduct(payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.post("/products", payload);

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async updateProduct(productId, payload) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/products/${productId}`,
      payload
    );

    return response.data.data.product ?? response.data.data;
  },

  async activateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/activate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },

  async deactivateProduct(productId) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      `/admin/products/${productId}/deactivate`
    );

    return response.data.data.product;
  },
};

export default adminProductService;

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and [`typescript-eslint`](https://typescript-eslint.io) in your project.
#␀ ␀n␀e␀x␀␀
␀

FILE: frontend\src\App.jsx

import {
  
  Navigate,
  Route,
  Routes,
} from "react-router-dom";

import HomePage from "./pages/HomePage";
import ShopPage from "./features/products/pages/ShopPage";
import ProductDetailsPage from "./features/products/pages/ProductDetailsPage";
import CartPage from "./features/cart/pages/CartPage";
import WishlistPage from "./features/wishlist/pages/WishlistPage";
import CheckoutPage from "./features/checkout/pages/CheckoutPage";
import OrderConfirmationPage from "./features/checkout/pages/OrderConfirmationPage";

import LoginPage from "./features/account/pages/LoginPage";
import RegisterPage from "./features/account/pages/RegisterPage";
import ForgotPasswordPage from "./features/account/pages/ForgotPasswordPage";
import AccountDashboard from "./features/account/pages/AccountDashboard";
import ProfilePage from "./features/account/pages/ProfilePage";
import MyOrdersPage from "./features/account/pages/MyOrdersPage";
import ProtectedAccountRoute from "./features/account/components/ProtectedAccountRoute";

import OrderDetailsPage from "./features/orders/pages/OrderDetailsPage";

import ProtectedAdminRoute from "./features/admin/components/ProtectedAdminRoute";
import AdminDashboard from "./features/admin/pages/AdminDashboard";
import AdminProducts from "./features/admin/pages/AdminProducts";
import AdminProductForm from "./features/admin/pages/AdminProductForm";
import AdminCategories from "./features/admin/pages/AdminCategories";
import AdminCategoryForm from "./features/admin/pages/AdminCategoryForm";
import AdminOrders from "./features/admin/pages/AdminOrders";
import AdminOrderDetails from "./features/admin/pages/AdminOrderDetails";
import AdminCustomers from "./features/admin/pages/AdminCustomers";
import AdminCustomerDetails from "./features/admin/pages/AdminCustomerDetails";
import AdminLayout from "./features/admin/components/AdminLayout";

function App() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route path="/" element={<HomePage />} />

      <Route path="/shop" element={<ShopPage />} />
      <Route path="/categories" element={<ShopPage />} />

      <Route
        path="/new-arrivals"
        element={<ShopPage collection="new-arrivals" />}
      />

      <Route
        path="/best-sellers"
        element={<ShopPage collection="best-sellers" />}
      />

      <Route
        path="/product/:slug"
        element={<ProductDetailsPage />}
      />

      <Route path="/cart" element={<CartPage />} />
      <Route path="/wishlist" element={<WishlistPage />} />
      <Route path="/checkout" element={<CheckoutPage />} />

      <Route
        path="/order-confirmation/:orderId"
        element={<OrderConfirmationPage />}
      />

      <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
      <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />
      <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<ForgotPasswordPage />} />

      <Route element={<ProtectedAccountRoute />}>
        <Route path="/account" element={<AccountDashboard />} />
        <Route path="/account/profile" element={<ProfilePage />} />
        <Route path="/account/orders" element={<MyOrdersPage />} />

        <Route
          path="/account/orders/:orderId"
          element={<OrderDetailsPage />}
        />
      </Route>

      
<Route element={<ProtectedAdminRoute />}>
  <Route element={<AdminLayout />}>
    <Route path="/admin" element={<AdminDashboard />} />

    <Route path="/admin/products" element={<AdminProducts />} />

    <Route
      path="/admin/products/new"
      element={<AdminProductForm />}
    />

    <Route
      path="/admin/products/:id/edit"
      element={<AdminProductForm />}
    />

    <Route
      path="/admin/categories"
      element={<AdminCategories />}
    />

    <Route
      path="/admin/categories/new"
      element={<AdminCategoryForm />}
    />

    <Route
      path="/admin/categories/:id/edit"
      element={<AdminCategoryForm />}
    />

    <Route path="/admin/orders" element={<AdminOrders />} />

    <Route
      path="/admin/orders/:orderId"
      element={<AdminOrderDetails />}
    />

    <Route path="/admin/customers" element={<AdminCustomers />} />

    <Route
      path="/admin/customers/:customerId"
      element={<AdminCustomerDetails />}
    />
  </Route>
</Route>


      <Route
        path="*"
        element={<Navigate to="/" replace />}
      />
    </Routes>
  );
}

export default App;

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";

function CategoryCard({
  category,
}) {
  const { name, image, itemCount, href = "/products" } = category;

  return (
    <Link
      to={href}
      className="group block overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-outline bg-white transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-panel"
    >
      <div className="aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden bg-slate-50">
        <img
          src={image}
          alt={name}
          loading="lazy"
          className="h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
            {name}
          </h3>

          {typeof itemCount === "number" && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
              {itemCount} Products
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <ArrowUpRight
          size={20}
          className="shrink-0 text-slate-400 transition-colors group-hover:text-brand"
        />
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
}

export default CategoryCard;

import { useState } from "react";

export default function NewsletterSection() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!email.trim()) return;

    // Newsletter API integration will be added later.
    setEmail("");
  };

  return (
    <section className="newsletter-section">
      <div className="home-container">

        <div className="newsletter-content">
          <span className="section-eyebrow">
            STAY CONNECTED
          </span>

          <h2>
            A little more inspiration
            <br />
            in your inbox.
          </h2>

          <p>
            Stay connected with NexaMart for
            updates and future announcements.
          </p>

          <form
            className="newsletter-form"
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          >
            <label
              className="visually-hidden"
              htmlFor="newsletter-email"
            >
              Email address
            </label>

            <input
              id="newsletter-email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="Enter your email address"
              value={email}
              onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
              autoComplete="email"
              required
            />

            <button type="submit" disabled>
              Coming Soon
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="newsletter-note">
            Newsletter subscriptions will be available
            after backend integration.
          </p>
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

          </a>
        </div>

        {hasProducts ? (
          <div className="products-grid">
            {products.map((product) => (

            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="products-empty-state">

              âœ¦

            <p>

              as soon as products are available.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\components\product\ProductCard.jsx

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Heart, ShoppingBag, Star } from "lucide-react";
import { formatPrice, getDiscountPercentage } from "../../features/products/utils/productUtils";

function ProductCard({
  product,
  onAddToCart,
  onToggleWishlist,
  isWishlisted = false,
}) {
  const {
    name,
    slug,
    image,
    price,
    compareAtPrice,
    rating,
    reviewCount,
    badge,
    stock,
  } = product;

  const discount = getDiscountPercentage(price, compareAtPrice);

  return (
    <article className="product-card">

      <div className="product-card-image">
        <Link
          to={`/product/${slug}`}
          aria-label={`View ${name}`}
        >
          <img
            src={image}
            alt={name}
            loading="lazy"
          />
        </Link>

        {badge && (
          <span className="product-card-badge">
            {badge}
          </span>
        )}

        {discount > 0 && (
          <span className="product-discount">
            -{discount}%
          </span>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          className={`product-wishlist ${isWishlisted ? "is-active" : ""}`}
          onClick={() => onToggleWishlist?.(product)}
          aria-label={
            isWishlisted
              ? "Remove from wishlist"
              : "Add to wishlist"
          }
          aria-pressed={isWishlisted}
        >
          <Heart
            size={19}
            fill={isWishlisted ? "currentColor" : "none"}
          />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="product-card-content">

        <span className="product-category">
          {product.category}
        </span>

        <Link
          to={`/product/${slug}`}
          className="product-name"
        >
          {name}
        </Link>

        <div className="product-rating">
          <Star
            size={14}
            fill="currentColor"
          />

          <span>{rating.toFixed(1)}</span>

          <span className="product-review-count">
            ({reviewCount})
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="product-pricing">
          <strong>{formatPrice(price)}</strong>

          {compareAtPrice > price && (
            <del>{formatPrice(compareAtPrice)}</del>
          )}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="product-add-button"
          onClick={() => onAddToCart?.(product)}
          disabled={stock <= 0}
        >
          <ShoppingBag size={17} />

          {stock > 0 ? "Add to Cart" : "Out of Stock"}
        </button>

      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

export default ProductCard;

import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";

function SearchBar({
  value,
  onChange,
  onSubmit,
  placeholder = "Search products...",
  className = "",
}) {
  function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    onSubmit?.(value.trim());
  }

  function handleClear() {
    onChange?.("");
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      role="search"
      className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-outline bg-white px-4 py-2 transition-colors focus-within:border-brand focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-brand/20 ${className}`}
    >
      <Search size={20} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" />

      <input
        type="search"
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange?.(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        aria-label="Search products"
        className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent py-2 text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-slate-400"
      />

      {value && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleClear}
          aria-label="Clear search"
          className="rounded-full p-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700"
        >
          <X size={17} />
        </button>
      )}

      <button
        type="submit"
        className="rounded-full bg-brand px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-brand-hover"
      >
        Search
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

export default SearchBar;

function Badge({
  children,
  variant = "default",
  size = "md",
  className = "",
}) {
  const variants = {
    default: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",
    primary: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700",
    success: "bg-green-100 text-green-700",
    warning: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700",
    danger: "bg-red-100 text-red-700",
  };

  const sizes = {
    sm: "px-2 py-0.5 text-xs",
    md: "px-2.5 py-1 text-sm",
  };

  return (
    <span
      className={`
        inline-flex items-center rounded-full font-medium
        ${variants[variant] ?? variants.default}
        ${sizes[size] ?? sizes.md}
        ${className}
      `}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

export default Badge;

FILE: frontend\src\components\ui\Button.jsx

import { forwardRef } from "react";

const variants = {
  primary:
    "bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand-hover",
  secondary:
    "bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200",
  outline:
    "border border-outline bg-transparent text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50",
  ghost:
    "bg-transparent text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100",
  danger:
    "bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700",
};

const sizes = {
  sm: "px-3 py-2 text-sm",
  md: "px-5 py-2.5 text-base",
  lg: "px-7 py-3 text-lg",
};

const Button = forwardRef(function Button(
  {
    children,
    variant = "primary",
    size = "md",
    type = "button",
    disabled = false,
    className = "",
    ...props
  },
  ref
) {
  const baseStyles =
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-control font-semibold transition-colors duration-200 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50";

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type={type}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`${baseStyles} ${variants[variant] ?? variants.primary} ${sizes[size] ?? sizes.md} ${className}`}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

export default Button;

import { forwardRef } from "react";

const Input = forwardRef(function Input(
  {
    label,
    error,
    helperText,
    id,
    type = "text",
    className = "",
    ...props
  },
  ref
) {
  const inputId = id || props.name;

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2">
      {label && (
        <label
          htmlFor={inputId}
          className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700"
        >
          {label}
        </label>
      )}

      <input
        ref={ref}
        id={inputId}
        type={type}
        aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        aria-describedby={
          error ? `${inputId}-error` : undefined
        }
        className={`
          w-full rounded-control border bg-white px-4 py-3
          text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400
          transition-colors duration-200
          focus:border-brand focus:outline-none focus:ring-2
          focus:ring-brand/20
          ${error ? "border-red-500" : "border-outline"}
          ${className}
        `}
        {...props}
      />

      {error && (
        <p
          id={`${inputId}-error`}
          role="alert"
          className="text-xs text-red-600"
        >
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {!error && helperText && (
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          {helperText}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

export default Input;



================================================================================
FILE: frontend\src\components\ui\Modal.jsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

function Modal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  size = "md",
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    function handleKeyDown(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        onClose?.();
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const sizes = {
    sm: "max-w-sm",
    md: "max-w-lg",
    lg: "max-w-2xl",
  };

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4"
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (event.target === event.currentTarget) onClose?.();
      }}
    >
      <section
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        className={`w-full ${sizes[size] ?? sizes.md} rounded-xl bg-white p-6 shadow-panel`}
      >
        <header className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-xl font-bold">
            {title}
          </h2>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
            className="rounded-control p-2 hover:bg-slate-100"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </header>

        {children}
      </section>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
}

export default Modal;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\components\ProfileForm.jsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Save } from "lucide-react";
import { validateProfile } from "../utils/accountValidation";

const ProfileForm = ({ user, onSave }) => {
  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    fullName: user.fullName || "",
    phone: user.phone || "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setValues({
      fullName: user.fullName || "",
      phone: user.phone || "",
    });
  }, [user]);

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    setErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: "" }));
    setMessage("");
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationErrors = validateProfile(values);
    setErrors(validationErrors);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length) return;

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      await onSave(values);
      setMessage("Profile updated successfully.");
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message || "Unable to update profile.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className="account-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-name">Full Name</label>
        <input
          id="profile-name"
          name="fullName"
          value={values.fullName}
          onChange={handleChange}
          autoComplete="name"
          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.fullName)}
        />
        {errors.fullName && (
          <span className="account-error">{errors.fullName}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-email">Email Address</label>
        <input
          id="profile-email"
          type="email"
          value={user.email}
          disabled
        />
        <small className="account-field-note">
          Email changes require backend verification.
        </small>
      </div>

      <div className="account-form-field">
        <label htmlFor="profile-phone">Phone Number</label>
        <input
          id="profile-phone"
          name="phone"
          type="tel"
          value={values.phone}
          onChange={handleChange}
          autoComplete="tel"
          aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.phone)}
        />
        {errors.phone && (
          <span className="account-error">{errors.phone}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      {message && (
        <p className="account-form-message" role="status">
          {message}
        </p>
      )}

      <button
        type="submit"
        className="account-primary-button"
        disabled={saving}
      >
        <Save size={17} />
        {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save Changes"}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};

export default ProfileForm;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\components\ProtectedAccountRoute.jsx

import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";

const ProtectedAccountRoute = () => {
  const {
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
  } = useAccount();

  if (isLoading) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedAccountRoute;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\hooks\useAccount.js
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

import accountService from "../services/accountService";

const useAccount = () => {
  const account = useSyncExternalStore(
    accountService.subscribe,
    accountService.getSnapshot,
    accountService.getSnapshot
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    accountService.initialize();
  }, []);

  return {
    currentUser: account.currentUser,

    isAuthenticated: Boolean(account.currentUser),

    isLoading: !account.isInitialized,

    login: accountService.login,
    register: accountService.register,
    logout: accountService.logout,
    updateProfile: accountService.updateProfile,
    requestPasswordReset: accountService.requestPasswordReset,
  };
};

export default useAccount;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\pages\ForgotPasswordPage.jsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, Mail, Send } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";
import { validateEmail } from "../utils/accountValidation";
import "../account.css";

const ForgotPasswordPage = () => {
  const { requestPasswordReset } = useAccount();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationError = validateEmail(email);
    setError(validationError);

    if (validationError) return;

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await requestPasswordReset(email);
      setSuccess(true);
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to process your request.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="auth-page">
        <section className="auth-card">
          <div className="auth-brand-mark">N</div>

          <span className="account-eyebrow">ACCOUNT RECOVERY</span>
          <h1>Forgot Password?</h1>
          <p className="auth-description">
            Enter your registered email address to begin account recovery.
          </p>

          {success ? (
            <div className="auth-success-message" role="status">
              Password recovery is not connected yet. Email delivery will
              be available after backend integration.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
              <div className="account-form-field">
                <label htmlFor="recovery-email">Email Address</label>
                <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                  <Mail size={18} />
                  <input
                    id="recovery-email"
                    type="email"
                    placeholder="you@example.com"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      setEmail(event.target.value);
                      setError("");
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                {error && (
                  <span className="account-error">{error}</span>
                )}
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="account-primary-button auth-submit"
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                <Send size={17} />
                {submitting ? "Processing..." : "Continue"}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          <Link to="/login" className="auth-back-link">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} />
            Back to Sign In
          </Link>
        </section>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default ForgotPasswordPage;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\pages\LoginPage.jsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate,  Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { LockKeyhole, Mail, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";
import { validateLogin } from "../utils/accountValidation";
import "../account.css";

const LoginPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login, isAuthenticated } = useAccount();

  const [values, setValues] = useState({
    email: "",
    password: "",
  });

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
if (isAuthenticated) {
  return <Navigate to="/account" replace />;
}

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    setErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: "" }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationErrors = validateLogin(values);
    setErrors(validationErrors);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length) return;

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await login(values);
      navigate("/account", { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setErrors({ general: "Unable to sign in. Please try again." });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="auth-page">
        <section className="auth-card">
          <div className="auth-brand-mark">N</div>

          <span className="account-eyebrow">WELCOME BACK</span>
          <h1>Sign In</h1>
          <p className="auth-description">
            Access your NexaMart account and manage your orders.
          </p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
            <div className="account-form-field">
              <label htmlFor="login-email">Email Address</label>
              <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                <Mail size={18} />
                <input
                  id="login-email"
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={values.email}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.email && (
                <span className="account-error">{errors.email}</span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="account-form-field">
              <div className="auth-label-row">
                <label htmlFor="login-password">Password</label>
                <Link to="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</Link>
              </div>

              <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                <LockKeyhole size={18} />
                <input
                  id="login-password"
                  name="password"
                  type="password"
                  placeholder="Enter your password"
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={values.password}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)}
                />
              </div>
              {errors.password && (
                <span className="account-error">{errors.password}</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {errors.general && (
              <p className="account-error">{errors.general}</p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="account-primary-button auth-submit"
              disabled={submitting}
            >
              {submitting ? "Signing In..." : "Sign In"}

const getOrderId = (order) => order._id || order.id;

const MyOrdersPage = () => {

    error,
    refreshOrders,
  } = useOrders();

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\pages\RegisterPage.jsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate,  Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { UserRound, Mail, Phone, LockKeyhole, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useAccount from "../hooks/useAccount";
import { validateRegistration } from "../utils/accountValidation";
import "../account.css";

const initialValues = {
  fullName: "",
  email: "",
  phone: "",
  password: "",
  confirmPassword: "",
};

const RegisterPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { register, isAuthenticated } = useAccount();

  const [values, setValues] = useState(initialValues);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  if (isAuthenticated) {
  return <Navigate to="/account" replace />;
}

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setValues((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: value }));
    setErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [name]: "" }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const validationErrors = validateRegistration(values);
    setErrors(validationErrors);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length) return;

    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await register(values);
      navigate("/account", { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setErrors({ general: "Unable to create your account." });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="auth-page">
        <section className="auth-card auth-card-wide">
          <div className="auth-brand-mark">N</div>

          <span className="account-eyebrow">JOIN NEXAMART</span>
          <h1>Create Account</h1>
          <p className="auth-description">
            Create your account for a better shopping experience.
          </p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
            {[
              {
                name: "fullName",
                label: "Full Name",
                type: "text",
                placeholder: "Your full name",
                icon: UserRound,
                autoComplete: "name",
              },
              {
                name: "email",
                label: "Email Address",
                type: "email",
                placeholder: "you@example.com",
                icon: Mail,
                autoComplete: "email",
              },
              {
                name: "phone",
                label: "Phone Number",
                type: "tel",
                placeholder: "+92 300 1234567",
                icon: Phone,
                autoComplete: "tel",
              },
              {
                name: "password",
                label: "Password",
                type: "password",
                placeholder: "Minimum 8 characters",
                icon: LockKeyhole,
                autoComplete: "new-password",
              },
              {
                name: "confirmPassword",
                label: "Confirm Password",
                type: "password",
                placeholder: "Repeat your password",
                icon: LockKeyhole,
                autoComplete: "new-password",
              },
            ].map((field) => {
              const Icon = field.icon;

              return (
                <div className="account-form-field" key={field.name}>
                  <label htmlFor={`register-${field.name}`}>
                    {field.label}
                  </label>

                  <div className="auth-input-wrapper">
                    <Icon size={18} />
                    <input
                      id={`register-${field.name}`}
                      name={field.name}
                      type={field.type}
                      placeholder={field.placeholder}
                      autoComplete={field.autoComplete}
                      value={values[field.name]}
                      onChange={handleChange}
                      aria-invalid={Boolean(errors[field.name])}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {errors[field.name] && (
                    <span className="account-error">
                      {errors[field.name]}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {errors.general && (
              <p className="account-error">{errors.general}</p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="account-primary-button auth-submit"
              disabled={submitting}
            >
              {submitting ? "Creating Account..." : "Create Account"}
              <ArrowRight size={18} />
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="auth-footer">
            Already have an account? <Link to="/login">Sign In</Link>
          </p>

          <p className="auth-demo-note">
            Demo mode only. Passwords are not stored. Connect a secure
            backend before using real customer accounts.
          </p>
        </section>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default RegisterPage;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\services\accountService.js
================================================================================

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient";

let snapshot = {
  currentUser: null,
  isInitialized: false,
};

const listeners = new Set();
let initializationPromise = null;

const notify = () => {
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
};

const updateSnapshot = (updates) => {
  snapshot = {
    ...snapshot,
    ...updates,
  };

  notify();
};

const getUser = (response) => response.data.data.user;

const accountService = {
  getSnapshot: () => snapshot,

  subscribe: (listener) => {
    listeners.add(listener);

    return () => listeners.delete(listener);
  },

  async initialize() {
    if (snapshot.isInitialized) {
      return snapshot.currentUser;
    }

    if (initializationPromise) {
      return initializationPromise;
    }

    initializationPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const response = await apiClient.get("/auth/me");

        updateSnapshot({
          currentUser: getUser(response),
          isInitialized: true,
        });
      } catch {
        updateSnapshot({
          currentUser: null,
          isInitialized: true,
        });
      } finally {
        initializationPromise = null;
      }

      return snapshot.currentUser;
    })();

    return initializationPromise;
  },

  async register(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/auth/register",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
      isInitialized: true,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async login(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.post(
      "/auth/login",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
      isInitialized: true,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async logout() {
    try {
      await apiClient.post("/auth/logout");
    } finally {
      updateSnapshot({
        currentUser: null,
        isInitialized: true,
      });
    }
  },

  async updateProfile(values) {
    const response = await apiClient.patch(
      "/auth/profile",
      values
    );

    const user = getUser(response);

    updateSnapshot({
      currentUser: user,
    });

    return user;
  },

  async requestPasswordReset(email) {
    if (!email?.trim()) {
      throw new Error("Email address is required.");
    }

    throw new Error(
      "Password reset is not available yet."
    );
  },
};

export default accountService;

FILE: frontend\src\features\account\utils\accountValidation.js

const isValidEmail = (email) =>
  /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email.trim());

export const validateLogin = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!isValidEmail(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (!values.password) {
    errors.password = "Password is required.";
  } else if (values.password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = "Password must contain at least 8 characters.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateRegistration = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Name must contain at least 3 characters.";
  }

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!isValidEmail(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").length < 10) {
    errors.phone = "Enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (!values.password) {
    errors.password = "Password is required.";
  } else if (values.password.length < 8) {
    errors.password = "Use at least 8 characters.";
  }

  if (values.password !== values.confirmPassword) {
    errors.confirmPassword = "Passwords do not match.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateProfile = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Name must contain at least 3 characters.";
  }

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").length < 10) {
    errors.phone = "Enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export const validateEmail = (email) => {
  if (!email.trim()) return "Email address is required.";
  if (!isValidEmail(email)) return "Enter a valid email address.";
  return "";
};

const AdminLayout = () => {
  const { currentUser, logout } = useAccount();

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const [isMobileOpen, setIsMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoggingOut, setIsLoggingOut] = useState(false);

  const administratorName =
    currentUser?.fullName ||
    currentUser?.name ||
    "Administrator";

  const administratorEmail = currentUser?.email || "";

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsMobileOpen(false);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobileOpen) return undefined;

    const handleEscape = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setIsMobileOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
    };
  }, [isMobileOpen]);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    if (isLoggingOut) return;

    try {
      setIsLoggingOut(true);
      await logout();

      navigate("/login", { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setIsLoggingOut(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="admin-layout">
      {isMobileOpen && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="admin-layout__overlay"
          onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(false)}
          aria-label="Close navigation"
        />
      )}

      <aside
        className={`admin-sidebar ${
          isMobileOpen ? "is-open" : ""
        }`}
        aria-label="Admin sidebar"
      >
        <div className="admin-sidebar__brand">
          <div className="admin-sidebar__logo">
            <ShoppingBag size={23} />
          </div>

          <div className="admin-sidebar__brand-text">
            <strong>NEXAMART</strong>
            <span>ADMINISTRATION</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="admin-sidebar__close"
            onClick={() => setIsMobileOpen(false)}
            aria-label="Close sidebar"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="admin-sidebar__workspace">
          <span className="admin-sidebar__workspace-icon">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
          </span>

          <div>
            <strong>Admin Workspace</strong>
            <span>Secure environment</span>
          </div>

          <span className="admin-sidebar__online" />
        </div>

        <nav className="admin-sidebar__navigation">
          <span className="admin-sidebar__section-label">
            WORKSPACE
          </span>

          {NAVIGATION_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;

            return (
              <NavLink
                key={item.path}
                to={item.path}
                end={item.end}
                className={({ isActive }) =>
                  `admin-sidebar__link ${
                    isActive ? "is-active" : ""
                  }`
                }
              >
                <Icon size={19} />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <ChevronLeft

                  className="admin-sidebar__active-indicator"
                />
              </NavLink>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="admin-sidebar__bottom">
          <div className="admin-sidebar__administrator">
            <span className="admin-sidebar__avatar">
              {administratorName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </span>

            <div className="admin-sidebar__administrator-info">
              <strong>{administratorName}</strong>
              <span>{administratorEmail || "Administrator"}</span>

          <button

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Edit3,
  LoaderCircle,
  Package,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatCurrency = (value = 0) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number(value) || 0);

const getStockStatus = (value) => {
  const stock = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);

  if (stock === 0) {
    return { label: "Out of stock", className: "out" };
  }

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };
  }

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };
};

const AdminProductTable = ({
  products = [],
  isLoading,
  actionLoading,
  onToggleStatus,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state" role="status">
        <LoaderCircle size={28} className="is-spinning" />
        <span>Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={34} />
        <strong>No products found</strong>
        <span>Try changing your search or filters.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="admin-products__table-wrap">
      <table className="admin-products__table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Product</th>
            <th>SKU</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Price</th>
            <th>Inventory</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const stock = getStockStatus(product.stock);
            const isUpdating = actionLoading === product._id;

            return (
              <tr key={product._id}>
                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__product">
                    {product.image ? (
                      <img
                        src={product.image}
                        alt={product.name}
                        loading="lazy"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="admin-products__image-placeholder">
                        <Package size={19} />
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <div>
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.slug}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="admin-products__sku">
                  {product.sku || "â€”"}
                </td>

                <td>{product.category || "Uncategorized"}</td>

                <td className="admin-products__price">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__stock admin-products__stock--${stock.className}`}
                  >
                    {stock.className === "out" && (
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} />
                    )}
                    {Number(product.stock) || 0} Â· {stock.label}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__status ${
                      product.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span />
                    {product.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__actions">
                    <Link
                      to={`/admin/products/${product._id}/edit`}
                      className="admin-products__edit"
                      aria-label={`Edit ${product.name}`}
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={15} />
                      <span>Edit</span>
                    </Link>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`admin-products__action ${
                        product.isActive
                          ? "is-deactivate"
                          : "is-activate"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => onToggleStatus(product)}
                      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
                      aria-busy={isUpdating}
                    >
                      {isUpdating ? (
                        <LoaderCircle
                          size={15}
                          className="is-spinning"
                        />
                      ) : product.isActive ? (
                        <PowerOff size={15} />
                      ) : (
                        <Power size={15} />
                      )}

                      <span>
                        {product.isActive ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\components\ProtectedAdminRoute.jsx

import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";

import useAccount from "../../account/hooks/useAccount";

const ProtectedAdminRoute = () => {
  const {
    currentUser,
    isAuthenticated,
    isLoading,
  } = useAccount();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-auth-loading" role="status">
        Verifying administrator access...
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (currentUser?.role !== "admin") {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
};

export default ProtectedAdminRoute;

FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminCategories.js

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import adminCategoryService from "../services/adminCategoryService";

const useAdminCategories = () => {
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchCategories = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const data = await adminCategoryService.getCategories({ signal });

      setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Categories load nahi ho sakin."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    fetchCategories(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  const refreshCategories = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchCategories();
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  const toggleCategoryStatus = useCallback(async (category) => {
    try {
      setActionLoading(category._id);
      setError("");

      if (category.isActive) {
        await adminCategoryService.deactivateCategory(category._id);
      } else {
        await adminCategoryService.activateCategory(category._id);
      }

      await fetchCategories();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Category status update nahi ho saka."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchCategories]);

  return {
    categories,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
    refreshCategories,
    toggleCategoryStatus,
  };
};

export default useAdminCategories;

FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminCustomers.js

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import adminCustomerService from "../services/adminCustomerService";

const INITIAL_FILTERS = {
  search: "",
  status: "",
  sort: "newest",
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
};

const INITIAL_PAGINATION = {
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
  total: 0,
  pages: 0,
  hasNextPage: false,
  hasPreviousPage: false,
};

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Customers load nahi ho sakay. Dobara koshish karein.";

const useAdminCustomers = () => {
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState(INITIAL_PAGINATION);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    const fetchCustomers = async () => {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const result = await adminCustomerService.getCustomers(
          filters,
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setCustomers(result.customers || []);
        setPagination({
          ...INITIAL_PAGINATION,
          ...result.pagination,
        });
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    fetchCustomers();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [filters, refreshKey]);

  const updateFilter = useCallback((key, value) => {
    setFilters((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [key]: value,
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, []);

  const applySearch = useCallback((event) => {
    event?.preventDefault();

    setFilters((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      search: searchInput.trim(),
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, [searchInput]);

  const changePage = useCallback((page) => {
    setFilters((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      page,
    }));
  }, []);

  const refreshCustomers = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshKey((previous) => previous + 1);
  }, []);

  return {
    customers,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    pagination,
    isLoading,
    error,
    updateFilter,
    applySearch,
    changePage,
    refreshCustomers,
  };
};

export default useAdminCustomers;

FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminDashboard.js

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

import adminService from "../services/adminService";

const useAdminDashboard = () => {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const controllerRef = useRef(null);

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    setError("");

    try {
      const data = await adminService.getDashboard({ signal });

      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setDashboard(data);
      }
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        !signal?.aborted &&
        requestError.code !== "ERR_CANCELED"
      ) {
        setError(
          requestError.response?.data?.message ||
            "Unable to load dashboard data. Please try again."
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    controllerRef.current = controller;

    fetchDashboard(controller.signal);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      controllerRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const refreshDashboard = useCallback(() => {
    controllerRef.current?.abort();

    const controller = new AbortController();
    controllerRef.current = controller;

    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchDashboard(controller.signal);
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  return {
    dashboard,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refreshDashboard,
  };
};

export default useAdminDashboard;

FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\hooks\useAdminProducts.js
================================================================================

import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import adminProductService from "../services/adminProductService";

const INITIAL_FILTERS = {
  search: "",
  category: "",
  status: "all",
  stockStatus: "all",
  sort: "newest",
  page: 1,
  limit: 12,
};

const useAdminProducts = () => {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState(null);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(INITIAL_FILTERS);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState("");

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const fetchProducts = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    try {
      setError("");

      const params = {
        ...filters,
        category: filters.category || undefined,
      };

      const data = await adminProductService.getProducts(
        params,
        { signal }
      );

      setProducts(data.products);
      setCategories(data.categories);
      setPagination(data.pagination);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (
        requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
        signal?.aborted
      ) {
        return;
      }

      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to load products. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setFilters((current) => {
        if (current.search === searchInput.trim()) {
          return current;
        }

        return {
          ...current,
          search: searchInput.trim(),
          page: 1,
        };
      });
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [searchInput]);

  const updateFilter = useCallback((name, value) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [name]: value,
      page: 1,
    }));
  }, []);

  const changePage = useCallback((page) => {
    setFilters((current) => ({
      ...current,
      page,
    }));
  }, []);

  const refreshProducts = useCallback(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    fetchProducts();
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  const toggleProductStatus = useCallback(async (product) => {
    const productId = product._id;

    try {
      setActionLoading(productId);
      setError("");

      if (product.isActive) {
        await adminProductService.deactivateProduct(productId);
      } else {
        await adminProductService.activateProduct(productId);
      }

      await fetchProducts();
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(
        requestError.response?.data?.message ||
          "Unable to update product status. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setActionLoading("");
    }
  }, [fetchProducts]);

  return {
    products,
    categories,
    pagination,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    updateFilter,
    changePage,
    refreshProducts,
    toggleProductStatus,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
  };
};

export default useAdminProducts;
