import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowLeft,
  Edit3,
  FolderOpen,
  LoaderCircle,
  Plus,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import useAdminCategories from "../hooks/useAdminCategories";

import "./admin-categories.css";

const AdminCategories = () => {
  const {
    categories,
    isLoading,
    actionLoading,
    error,
    refreshCategories,
    toggleCategoryStatus,
  } = useAdminCategories();

  const activeCount = categories.filter(
    (category) => category.isActive
  ).length;

  return (
    <main className="admin-categories">
      <div className="admin-categories__container">
        <header className="admin-categories__header">
          <div>
            <Link to="/admin" className="admin-categories__back">
              <ArrowLeft size={15} />
              Back to dashboard
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-categories__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>Category Management</h1>

            <p>
              Organize your catalog and manage product categories.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-categories__header-actions">
            <div className="admin-categories__security">
              <ShieldCheck size={17} />
              Authorized Administrator
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-categories__refresh"
              onClick={refreshCategories}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={16}
                className={isLoading ? "is-spinning" : ""}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>

            <Link
              to="/admin/categories/new"
              className="admin-categories__add"
            >
              <Plus size={17} />
              Add Category
            </Link>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-categories__overview">
          <div>
            <span>Total categories</span>
            <strong>{categories.length}</strong>
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Active categories</span>
            <strong>{activeCount}</strong>
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Inactive categories</span>
            <strong>{categories.length - activeCount}</strong>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="admin-categories__panel">
          <div className="admin-categories__panel-heading">
            <div>
              <h2>Store Categories</h2>
              <p>Manage category information and visibility.</p>
            </div>

            <FolderOpen size={21} />
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="admin-categories__error" role="alert">
              <AlertTriangle size={18} />
              <span>{error}</span>

              <button type="button" onClick={refreshCategories}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {isLoading && categories.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="admin-categories__state">
              <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
              <span>Loading categories...</span>
            </div>
          ) : categories.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="admin-categories__state">
              <FolderOpen size={34} />
              <strong>No categories found</strong>
              <span>Create your first store category.</span>

              <Link to="/admin/categories/new">
                <Plus size={16} />
                Create Category
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="admin-categories__table-wrap">
              <table className="admin-categories__table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Category</th>
                    <th>Slug</th>
                    <th>Description</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                    <th>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody>
                  {categories.map((category) => {
                    const isUpdating = actionLoading === category._id;

                    return (
                      <tr key={category._id}>
                        <td>
                          <div className="admin-categories__category">
                            {category.image ? (
                              <img
                                src={category.image}
                                alt={category.name}
                                loading="lazy"
                              />
                            ) : (
                              <div className="admin-categories__placeholder">
                                <FolderOpen size={20} />
                              </div>
                            )}

                            <strong>{category.name}</strong>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        <td className="admin-categories__slug">
                          {category.slug}
                        </td>

                        <td className="admin-categories__description">
                          {category.description || "â€”"}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={`admin-categories__status ${
                              category.isActive
                                ? "is-active"
                                : "is-inactive"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span />
                            {category.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        
<td>
  <div className="admin-categories__actions">
    <Link
      to={`/admin/categories/${category._id}/edit`}
      className="admin-categories__edit"
    >
      <Edit3 size={15} />
      <span>Edit</span>
    </Link>

    <button
      type="button"
      className={`admin-categories__action ${
        category.isActive
          ? "is-deactivate"
          : "is-activate"
      }`}
      onClick={() => toggleCategoryStatus(category)}
      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
      aria-busy={isUpdating}
    >
      {isUpdating ? (
        <LoaderCircle size={15} className="is-spinning" />
      ) : category.isActive ? (
        <PowerOff size={15} />
      ) : (
        <Power size={15} />
      )}

      <span>
        {category.isActive ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
      </span>
    </button>
  </div>
</td>

                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        <footer className="admin-categories__footer">
          <FolderOpen size={16} />
          <span>NexaMart secure category management workspace</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCategories;



================================================================================
FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\pages\AdminCategoryForm.jsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  LoaderCircle,
  Save,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";

import adminCategoryService from "../services/adminCategoryService";

import "./admin-categories.css";

const INITIAL_FORM = {
  name: "",
  slug: "",
  description: "",
  image: "",
};

const slugify = (value) =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Something went wrong. Please try again.";

const AdminCategoryForm = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isEditMode = Boolean(id);

  const [form, setForm] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [slugTouched, setSlugTouched] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(isEditMode);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditMode) return undefined;

    const controller = new AbortController();

    const loadCategory = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        const categories = await adminCategoryService.getCategories({
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const category = categories.find(
          (item) => item._id === id
        );

        if (!category) {
          throw new Error("Requested category nahi mili.");
        }

        setForm({
          name: category.name ?? "",
          slug: category.slug ?? "",
          description: category.description ?? "",
          image: category.image ?? "",
        });

        setSlugTouched(true);
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (
          requestError.code === "ERR_CANCELED" ||
          controller.signal.aborted
        ) {
          return;
        }

        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    loadCategory();

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [id, isEditMode]);

  const updateField = (name, value) => {
    setForm((current) => {
      const updated = { ...current, [name]: value };

      if (name === "name" && !slugTouched) {
        updated.slug = slugify(value);
      }

      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      slug: form.slug.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      image: form.image.trim() || null,
    };

    if (!payload.name || !payload.slug) {
      setError("Category name aur slug required hain.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSaving(true);

      if (isEditMode) {
        await adminCategoryService.updateCategory(id, payload);
      } else {
        await adminCategoryService.createCategory(payload);
      }

      navigate("/admin/categories", {
        replace: true,
        state: {
          message: isEditMode
            ? "Category updated successfully."
            : "Category created successfully.",
        },
      });
    } catch (requestError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-category-form">
        <div className="admin-category-form__state">
          <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={28} />
          <span>Loading category...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-category-form">
      <div className="admin-category-form__container">
        <header className="admin-category-form__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/categories"
              className="admin-category-form__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to categories
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-category-form__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>{isEditMode ? "Edit Category" : "Create Category"}</h1>

            <p>
              {isEditMode
                ? "Update your category information."
                : "Add a new category to your store catalog."}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-category-form__security">
            <ShieldCheck size={17} />
            Authorized Administrator
          </div>
        </header>

        {error && (
          <div className="admin-category-form__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form
          className="admin-category-form__panel"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        >
          <div className="admin-category-form__section-heading">
            <h2>Category Information</h2>
            <p>Enter the details used in your store catalog.</p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-category-form__grid">
            <label className="admin-category-form__field">
              <span>Category Name *</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  updateField("name", event.target.value)
                }
                minLength={2}
                maxLength={80}
                required
                disabled={saving}
                placeholder="e.g. Men Shoes"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="admin-category-form__field">
              <span>Category Slug *</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.slug}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setSlugTouched(true);
                  updateField("slug", slugify(event.target.value));
                }}
                minLength={2}
                maxLength={100}
                pattern="[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
                required
                disabled={saving}
                placeholder="men-shoes"
              />
              <small>Category URL identifier.</small>
            </label>
          </div>

          <label className="admin-category-form__field">
            <span>Description</span>
            <textarea
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateField("description", event.target.value)
              }
              maxLength={500}
              rows={5}
              disabled={saving}
              placeholder="Write a short category description..."
            />
            <small>{form.description.length}/500 characters</small>
          </label>

          <label className="admin-category-form__field">
            <span>Category Image URL</span>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={form.image}
              onChange={(event) =>
                updateField("image", event.target.value)
              }
              maxLength={2048}
              disabled={saving}
              placeholder="https://example.com/category-image.jpg"
            />
            <small>
              Secure HTTPS image URL use karein.
            </small>
          </label>

          {form.image && (
            <div className="admin-category-form__preview">
              <img
                src={form.image}
                alt="Category preview"
                onError={(event) => {
                  event.currentTarget.style.display = "none";
                }}
              />
              <span>
                <ImageIcon size={15} />
                Image preview
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="admin-category-form__actions">
            <Link
              to="/admin/categories"
              className="admin-category-form__cancel"
            >
              Cancel
            </Link>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="admin-category-form__submit"
              disabled={saving}
            >
              {saving ? (
                <LoaderCircle size={17} className="is-spinning" />
              ) : (
                <Save size={17} />
              )}

              {saving
                ? "Saving..."
                : isEditMode
                  ? "Save Changes"
                  : "Create Category"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCategoryForm;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  LoaderCircle,
  Mail,
  Package,
  Phone,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldCheck,
  ShoppingBag,
  UserRound,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import adminCustomerService from "../services/adminCustomerService";
import {
  formatOrderDate,
  formatOrderPrice,
  getOrderStatusLabel,
} from "../../orders/utils/orderUtils";

import "./admin-customer-details.css";

const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? "â€”"
    : formatOrderDate(date);
};

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Customer details load nahi ho sakin.";

const AdminCustomerDetails = () => {
  const { customerId } = useParams();

  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState({});
  const [recentOrders, setRecentOrders] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState("");
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState("");

  const loadCustomer = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result = await adminCustomerService.getCustomerById(
        customerId,
        { signal }
      );

      if (signal?.aborted) return;

      setCustomer(result.customer);
      setSummary(result.summary || {});
      setRecentOrders(result.recentOrders || []);
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [customerId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    loadCustomer(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [loadCustomer]);

  const handleStatusToggle = async () => {
    if (!customer || actionLoading) return;

    const nextStatus = !customer.isActive;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      nextStatus
        ? "Is customer account ko activate karna chahte hain?"
        : "Is customer account ko deactivate karna chahte hain?"
    );

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setActionLoading(true);
    setActionError("");
    setSuccessMessage("");

    try {
      const updatedCustomer =
        await adminCustomerService.updateCustomerStatus(
          customerId,
          nextStatus
        );

      setCustomer(updatedCustomer);

      setSuccessMessage(
        nextStatus
          ? "Customer account successfully activated."
          : "Customer account successfully deactivated."
      );
    } catch (requestError) {
      setActionError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-customer-details">
        <div className="admin-customer-details__loading">
          <LoaderCircle size={28} className="is-spinning" />
          Loading customer profile...
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (error || !customer) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-customer-details">
        <div className="admin-customer-details__container">
          <Link to="/admin/customers" className="admin-customer-details__back">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} />
            Back to customers
          </Link>

          <div className="admin-customer-details__error">
            <XCircle size={30} />
            <h2>Unable to load customer</h2>
            <p>{error || "Requested customer nahi mila."}</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => loadCustomer()}
              className="admin-customer-details__primary"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={16} />
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="admin-customer-details">
      <div className="admin-customer-details__container">
        <header className="admin-customer-details__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/customers"
              className="admin-customer-details__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to customers
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-customer-details__eyebrow">
              CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT
            </span>

            <h1>Customer Profile</h1>
            <p>Review account information and customer order activity.</p>
          </div>

          <span className="admin-customer-details__secure">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} />
            Admin access
          </span>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-customer-details__profile">
          <div className="admin-customer-details__identity">
            <div className="admin-customer-details__avatar">
              {(customer.fullName || "C").charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2>{customer.fullName}</h2>
              <p>{customer.email}</p>

              <span
                className={`admin-customer-details__status ${
                  customer.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                }`}
              >
                {customer.isActive ? "Active account" : "Inactive account"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            className={
              customer.isActive
                ? "admin-customer-details__deactivate"
                : "admin-customer-details__activate"
            }
            onClick={handleStatusToggle}
            disabled={actionLoading}
          >
            {actionLoading ? (
              <LoaderCircle size={16} className="is-spinning" />
            ) : customer.isActive ? (
              <XCircle size={16} />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
            )}

            {customer.isActive ? "Deactivate account" : "Activate account"}
          </button>
        </section>

        {actionError && (
          <div className="admin-customer-details__message is-error" role="alert">
            {actionError}
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div className="admin-customer-details__message is-success" role="status">
            {successMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        <section className="admin-customer-details__stats">
          <article>
            <span className="admin-customer-details__stat-icon">
              <ShoppingBag size={20} />
            </span>
            <div>
              <span>Total orders</span>
              <strong>{summary.totalOrders ?? 0}</strong>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article>
            <span className="admin-customer-details__stat-icon">
              <CheckCircle2 size={20} />
            </span>
            <div>
              <span>Delivered</span>
              <strong>{summary.deliveredOrders ?? 0}</strong>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article>
            <span className="admin-customer-details__stat-icon">
              <Clock3 size={20} />
            </span>
            <div>
              <span>Active orders</span>
              <strong>{summary.activeOrders ?? 0}</strong>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article>
            <span className="admin-customer-details__stat-icon">
              <Package size={20} />
            </span>
            <div>
              <span>Total order value</span>
              <strong>{formatOrderPrice(summary.totalOrderValue)}</strong>
            </div>
          </article>
        </section>

        <div className="admin-customer-details__grid">
          <section className="admin-customer-details__card">
            <div className="admin-customer-details__card-heading">
              <UserRound size={19} />
              <h2>Account information</h2>
            </div>

            <div className="admin-customer-details__information">
              <div>
                <span>Full name</span>
                <strong>{customer.fullName}</strong>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span>Email address</span>
                <strong>
                  <Mail size={15} />
                  {customer.email}
                </strong>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span>Phone number</span>
                <strong>
                  <Phone size={15} />
                  {customer.phone || "Not available"}
                </strong>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span>Account role</span>
                <strong>Customer</strong>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span>Registration date</span>
                <strong>{formatDate(customer.createdAt)}</strong>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span>Last updated</span>
                <strong>{formatDate(customer.updatedAt)}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-customer-details__card">
            <div className="admin-customer-details__card-heading">
              <Clock3 size={19} />
              <h2>Order overview</h2>
            </div>

<div className="admin-customer-details__overview">
  <div>
    <span>Cancelled orders</span>
    <strong>{summary.cancelledOrders ?? 0}</strong>
  </div>

  <div>
    <span>Delivered orders</span>
    <strong>{summary.deliveredOrders ?? 0}</strong>
  </div>

  <div>
    <span>Active orders</span>
    <strong>{summary.activeOrders ?? 0}</strong>
  </div>

  <div>
    <span>Total order value</span>
    <strong>
      {formatOrderPrice(summary.totalOrderValue)}
    </strong>
  </div>

  <div>
    <span>Cancelled order value</span>
    <strong>
      {formatOrderPrice(summary.cancelledOrderValue)}
    </strong>
  </div>
</div>
          </section>

          <section className="admin-customer-details__card admin-customer-details__orders">
          <div className="admin-customer-details__card-heading">
            <div>
              <ShoppingBag size={19} />
              <h2>Recent orders</h2>
            </div>

            <span>Latest {recentOrders.length} orders</span>
          </div>

          {recentOrders.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="admin-customer-details__empty">
              <Package size={28} />
              <strong>No orders yet</strong>
              <span>This customer has not placed any registered orders.</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="admin-customer-details__table-wrap">
              <table className="admin-customer-details__table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Order</th>
                    <th>Items</th>
                    <th>Total</th>
                    <th>Payment</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                    <th>Date</th>
                    <th />
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody>
                  {recentOrders.map((order) => (
                    <tr key={order._id}>
                      <td>
                        <strong>{order.orderNumber}</strong>
                      </td>

                      <td>{order.items?.length ?? 0}</td>

                      <td>{formatOrderPrice(order.total)}</td>

                      <td>
                        <span className="admin-customer-details__payment">
                          {order.paymentStatus || "Unknown"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        <span
                          className={`admin-customer-details__order-status status--${order.status}`}
                        >
                          {getOrderStatusLabel(order.status)}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td>{formatDate(order.createdAt)}</td>

                      <td>
                        <Link
                          to={`/admin/orders/${order._id}`}
                          className="admin-customer-details__order-link"
                        >
                          View order
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCustomerDetails;

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  Eye,
  Filter,
  LoaderCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Users,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

import useAdminCustomers from "../hooks/useAdminCustomers";
import "./admin-customers.css";

const SORT_OPTIONS = [
  ["newest", "Newest first"],
  ["oldest", "Oldest first"],
  ["name_asc", "Name A-Z"],
  ["name_desc", "Name Z-A"],
];

const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? "â€”"
    : new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PK", {
        dateStyle: "medium",
      }).format(date);
};

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number(amount) || 0);

const AdminCustomers = () => {
  const {
    customers,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    pagination,
    isLoading,
    error,
    updateFilter,
    applySearch,
    changePage,
    refreshCustomers,
  } = useAdminCustomers();

  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);

  const hasActiveFilters = useMemo(
    () => Boolean(filters.status || filters.search),
    [filters.status, filters.search]
  );

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchInput("");

    updateFilter("search", "");
    updateFilter("status", "");
    updateFilter("sort", "newest");
  };

  return (
    <main className="admin-customers">
      <div className="admin-customers__container">
        <header className="admin-customers__header">
          <div>
            


            <span className="admin-customers__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>Customer Management</h1>

            <p>
              Manage customer accounts, monitor activity and review
              customer relationships.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-customers__header-actions">
            <span className="admin-customers__secure">
              <ShieldCheck size={16} />
              Admin access
            </span>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-customers__button"
              onClick={refreshCustomers}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={16}
                className={isLoading ? "is-spinning" : ""}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-customers__overview">
          <div className="admin-customers__overview-icon">
            <Users size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Total matching customers</span>
            <strong>
              {pagination.total.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
            </strong>
            <small>
              {pagination.pages
                ? `Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.pages}`
                : "No pages available"}
            </small>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="admin-customers__panel">
          <div className="admin-customers__panel-header">
            <div>
              <h2>All customers</h2>
              <p>Search and manage registered customer accounts.</p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-customers__filter-toggle"
              onClick={() => setShowFilters((previous) => !previous)}
              aria-expanded={showFilters}
            >
              <Filter size={16} />
              Filters
            </button>
          </div>

          <form
            className="admin-customers__search"
            onSubmit={applySearch}
          >
            <Search size={18} />

            <input
              type="search"
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(event) => setSearchInput(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search name, email or phone..."
              aria-label="Search customers"
            />

            {searchInput && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchInput("");
                  updateFilter("search", "");
                }}
                aria-label="Clear search"
              >
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            )}

            <button type="submit" className="admin-customers__search-submit">
              Search
            </button>
          </form>

          {showFilters && (
            <div className="admin-customers__filters">
              <label>
                Account status
                <select
                  value={filters.status}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateFilter("status", event.target.value)
                  }
                >
                  <option value="">All customers</option>
                  <option value="active">Active</option>
                  <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label>
                Sort by
                <select
                  value={filters.sort}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateFilter("sort", event.target.value)
                  }
                >
                  {SORT_OPTIONS.map(([value, label]) => (
                    <option key={value} value={value}>
                      {label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>

              {hasActiveFilters && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="admin-customers__reset"
                  onClick={clearFilters}
                >
                  <X size={15} />
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="admin-customers__error" role="alert">
              <span>{error}</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={refreshCustomers}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="admin-customers__table-wrap">
            <table className="admin-customers__table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Customer</th>
                  <th>Phone</th>
                  <th>Orders</th>
                  <th>Order value</th>
                  <th>Account</th>
                  <th>Joined</th>
                  <th aria-label="Actions" />
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {isLoading ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="7" className="admin-customers__state">
                      <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={25} />
                      Loading customers...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : customers.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="7" className="admin-customers__state">
                      <Users size={28} />
                      <strong>No customers found</strong>
                      <span>
                        Try changing your search or filter criteria.
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  customers.map((customer) => (
                    <tr key={customer._id}>
                      <td>
                        <div className="admin-customers__identity">
                          <span className="admin-customers__avatar">
                            {(customer.fullName || "C")
                              .charAt(0)
                              .toUpperCase()}
                          </span>

                          <div>
                            <strong>{customer.fullName}</strong>
                            <span>{customer.email}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td>{customer.phone || "â€”"}</td>

                      <td>
                        <strong>
                          {customer.orderStats?.totalOrders ?? 0}
                        </strong>
                      </td>

                      <td className="admin-customers__amount">
                        {formatPrice(
                          customer.orderStats?.totalOrderValue
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        <span
                          className={`admin-customers__status ${
                            customer.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {customer.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td>{formatDate(customer.createdAt)}</td>

                      <td>
                        <Link
  to={`/admin/customers/${customer._id}`}
  className="admin-customers__view"
  aria-label={`View ${customer.fullName}`}
>
  <Eye size={15} />
  <span>View</span>
</Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <footer className="admin-customers__pagination">
            <span>
              Showing {customers.length} of {pagination.total} customers
            </span>

            <div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(pagination.page - 1)}
                disabled={isLoading || !pagination.hasPreviousPage}
              >
                <ArrowLeft size={16} />
                Previous
              </button>

              <span>
                {pagination.page} / {Math.max(pagination.pages, 1)}
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(pagination.page + 1)}
                disabled={isLoading || !pagination.hasNextPage}
              >
                Next
                <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </footer>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCustomers;

                <p>Latest customer transactions and payment status.</p>
              </div>

              <Link
                to="/admin/orders"
                className="admin-dashboard__panel-link"
              >
                View all
                <ArrowRight size={15} />
              </Link>
            </div>

            {isLoading && !dashboard ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                Loading recent orders...
              </div>
            ) : recentOrders.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                <ShoppingBag size={27} />
                <strong>No orders yet</strong>
                <span>New customer orders will appear here.</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__table-wrap">
                <table className="admin-dashboard__table">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Order</th>
                      <th>Customer</th>
                      <th>Amount</th>
                      <th>Payment</th>
                      <th>Status</th>
                      <th>Date</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>

                  <tbody>
                    {recentOrders.map((order) => (
                      <tr key={order._id}>
                        <td className="admin-dashboard__order-number">
                          <Link to={`/admin/orders/${order._id}`}>
                            {order.orderNumber || "View order"}
                          </Link>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span className="admin-dashboard__customer-name">
                            {order.customer?.fullName || "Guest customer"}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td className="admin-dashboard__amount">
                          {formatCurrency(order.total)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={`admin-payment admin-payment--${order.paymentStatus || "pending"}`}
                          >
                            {PAYMENT_LABELS[order.paymentStatus] ||
                              formatStatus(order.paymentStatus)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                          <span
                            className={`admin-status admin-status--${order.status || "unknown"}`}
                          >
                            {formatStatus(order.status)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        <td className="admin-dashboard__date">
                          {formatDate(order.createdAt)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="admin-dashboard__panel">
            <div className="admin-dashboard__panel-header">
              <div>
                <span className="admin-dashboard__panel-eyebrow">
                  INVENTORY CONTROL
                </span>
                <h2>Inventory Alerts</h2>
                <p>Products that need restocking attention.</p>
              </div>

              <Link
                to="/admin/products"
                className="admin-dashboard__panel-icon-link"
                aria-label="Manage products"
              >
                <Boxes size={19} />
              </Link>
            </div>

            {isLoading && !dashboard ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                Loading inventory...
              </div>
            ) : lowStockProducts.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="admin-dashboard__empty">
                <Package size={27} />
                <strong>Inventory looks healthy</strong>
                <span>No low-stock products require attention.</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="admin-inventory">
                {lowStockProducts.map((product) => (
                  <div
                    className="admin-inventory__item"
                    key={product._id}
                  >
                    <div className="admin-inventory__details">
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.sku}</span>
                    </div>

                    <span
                      className={`admin-inventory__stock ${
                        product.stock === 0 ? "is-out" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      {product.stock === 0
                        ? "Out of stock"
                        : `${product.stock} left`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        <footer className="admin-dashboard__footer">
          <ShieldCheck size={15} />
          <span>NexaMart secure administration workspace</span>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminDashboard;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  LoaderCircle,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldCheck,
  X,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import adminOrderService from "../services/adminOrderService";
import {
  formatOrderDate,
  formatOrderPrice,
  getOrderStatusLabel,
} from "../../orders/utils/orderUtils";

import "./admin-order-details.css";

const STATUS_TRANSITIONS = {
  placed: ["confirmed"],
  confirmed: ["processing"],
  processing: ["shipped"],
  shipped: ["delivered"],
  delivered: [],
  cancelled: [],
};

const CANCELLABLE_STATUSES = ["placed", "confirmed", "processing"];

const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? "â€”"
    : formatOrderDate(date);
};

const getPaymentLabel = (status) =>
  ({
    pending: "Pending",
    paid: "Paid",
    failed: "Failed",
    refunded: "Refunded",
  })[status] || status || "Unknown";

const getPaymentMethodLabel = (method) =>
  ({
    cod: "Cash on Delivery",
  })[method] || method || "â€”";

const getCustomer = (order) => order?.customer || {};

const getItemName = (item) =>
  item.name ||
  item.productName ||
  item.product?.name ||
  item.sku ||
  "Product";

const getItemImage = (item) =>
  item.image || item.product?.image || "";

const getItemQuantity = (item) => Number(item.quantity) || 0;

const getItemPrice = (item) =>
  Number(item.unitPrice ?? item.price) || 0;

const getItemTotal = (item) =>
  Number(item.lineTotal) || getItemPrice(item) * getItemQuantity(item);

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Request complete nahi ho saki. Dobara koshish karein.";

const AdminOrderDetails = () => {
  const { orderId } = useParams();

  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState("");
  const [nextStatus, setNextStatus] = useState("");
  const [showCancelDialog, setShowCancelDialog] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState("");

  const loadOrder = useCallback(async (signal) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result = await adminOrderService.getOrderById(
        orderId,
        { signal }
      );

      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setOrder(result);
        setNextStatus("");
      }
    } catch (requestError) {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!signal?.aborted) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [orderId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    loadOrder(controller.signal);

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [loadOrder]);

  const handleStatusUpdate = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!nextStatus || actionLoading) return;

    setActionLoading(true);
    setActionError("");

    try {
      const updatedOrder = await adminOrderService.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        { status: nextStatus }
      );

      if (updatedOrder) {
        setOrder(updatedOrder);
        setNextStatus("");
      } else {
        await loadOrder();
      }
    } catch (requestError) {
      setActionError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelOrder = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const reason = cancelReason.trim();

    if (reason.length < 5 || reason.length > 500 || actionLoading) {
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading(true);
    setActionError("");

    try {
      const updatedOrder = await adminOrderService.cancelOrder(
        orderId,
        reason
      );

      if (updatedOrder) {
        setOrder(updatedOrder);
      } else {
        await loadOrder();
      }

      setShowCancelDialog(false);
      setCancelReason("");
    } catch (requestError) {
      setActionError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-order-details">
        <div className="admin-order-details__loading">
          <LoaderCircle size={28} />
          <span>Loading order details...</span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (error || !order) {
    return (
      <main className="admin-order-details">
        <div className="admin-order-details__container">
          <Link to="/admin/orders" className="admin-order-details__back">
            <ArrowLeft size={16} />
            Back to orders
          </Link>

          <div className="admin-order-details__error">
            <XCircle size={30} />
            <h2>Unable to load order</h2>
            <p>{error || "Requested order nahi mila."}</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => loadOrder()}
              className="admin-order-details__primary-button"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={16} />
              Try again
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const customer = getCustomer(order);
  const items = Array.isArray(order.items) ? order.items : [];
  const allowedStatuses = STATUS_TRANSITIONS[order.status] || [];
  const canCancel = CANCELLABLE_STATUSES.includes(order.status);

  const addressLines = [
    customer.addressLine1,
    customer.addressLine2,
    customer.city,
    customer.province,
    customer.postalCode,
  ].filter(Boolean);

  const deliveryFee = Number(order.deliveryFee) || 0;
  const subtotal = Number(order.subtotal) || 0;
  const total = Number(order.total) || 0;

  const history = Array.isArray(order.statusHistory)
    ? [...order.statusHistory].reverse()
    : [];

  return (
    <main className="admin-order-details">
      <div className="admin-order-details__container">
        <header className="admin-order-details__header">
          <div>
            <Link
              to="/admin/orders"
              className="admin-order-details__back"
            >
              <ArrowLeft size={16} />
              Back to orders
            </Link>

            <span className="admin-order-details__eyebrow">
              ORDER MANAGEMENT
            </span>

            <h1>Order Details</h1>

            <p>
              Review order information and manage its fulfilment.
            </p>
          </div>

          <span className="admin-order-details__secure">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} />
            Admin access
          </span>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-order-details__order-banner">
          <div>
            <span>ORDER REFERENCE</span>
            <h2>{order.orderNumber || order._id}</h2>
            <p>Placed on {formatDate(order.createdAt)}</p>
          </div>

          <span
            className={`admin-order-details__status admin-order-details__status--${order.status}`}
          >
            {getOrderStatusLabel(order.status)}
          </span>
        </section>

        {actionError && (
          <div className="admin-order-details__action-error" role="alert">
            <span>{actionError}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActionError("")}
              aria-label="Dismiss error"
            >
              <X size={17} />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="admin-order-details__grid">
          <div className="admin-order-details__main">
            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <div>
                  <Package size={19} />
                  <h2>Ordered items</h2>
                </div>

                <span>{items.length} products</span>
              </div>

              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="admin-order-details__muted">
                  No order items available.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="admin-order-details__items">
                  {items.map((item, index) => (
                    <div
                      className="admin-order-details__item"
                      key={item._id || item.productId || `${item.sku}-${index}`}
                    >
                      <div className="admin-order-details__item-image">
                        {getItemImage(item) ? (
                          <img
                            src={getItemImage(item)}
                            alt={getItemName(item)}
                            loading="lazy"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Package size={22} />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="admin-order-details__item-info">
                        <strong>{getItemName(item)}</strong>
                        <span>SKU: {item.sku || "â€”"}</span>
                        <small>
                          {getItemQuantity(item)} Ã—{" "}
                          {formatOrderPrice(getItemPrice(item))}
                        </small>
                      </div>

                      <strong className="admin-order-details__item-total">
                        {formatOrderPrice(getItemTotal(item))}
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>

            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <div>
                  <Clock3 size={19} />
                  <h2>Order history</h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              {history.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="admin-order-details__muted">
                  No status history available.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="admin-order-details__history">
                  {history.map((entry, index) => (
                    <div
                      className="admin-order-details__history-item"
                      key={entry._id || `${entry.status}-${index}`}
                    >
                      <span className="admin-order-details__history-marker">
                        <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                      </span>

                      <div>
                        <strong>
                          {getOrderStatusLabel(entry.status)}
                        </strong>

                        <span>{formatDate(entry.changedAt || entry.createdAt)}</span>

                        {entry.note && <p>{entry.note}</p>}
                        {entry.reason && <p>{entry.reason}</p>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </div>

          <aside className="admin-order-details__sidebar">
            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <h2>Customer information</h2>
              </div>

              <div className="admin-order-details__information">
                <strong>{customer.fullName || "Guest customer"}</strong>
                <span>{customer.email || "No email available"}</span>
                <span>{customer.phone || "No phone available"}</span>
              </div>
            </section>

            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <div>
                  <MapPin size={19} />
                  <h2>Delivery address</h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="admin-order-details__information">
                {addressLines.length > 0 ? (
                  addressLines.map((line, index) => (
                    <span key={`${line}-${index}`}>{line}</span>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <span>Address not available</span>
                )}
              </div>
            </section>

            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <h2>Payment summary</h2>
              </div>

              <div className="admin-order-details__information">
                <span>
                  Method: {getPaymentMethodLabel(order.paymentMethod)}
                </span>

                <span>
                  Payment status:{" "}
                  <strong>{getPaymentLabel(order.paymentStatus)}</strong>
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="admin-order-details__summary">
                <div>
                  <span>Subtotal</span>
                  <strong>{formatOrderPrice(subtotal)}</strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Delivery fee</span>
                  <strong>
                    {order.deliveryFee == null
                      ? "To be confirmed"
                      : formatOrderPrice(deliveryFee)}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div className="admin-order-details__grand-total">
                  <span>Order total</span>
                  <strong>{formatOrderPrice(total)}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            <section className="admin-order-details__card">
              <div className="admin-order-details__card-heading">
                <h2>Manage order</h2>
              </div>

              {allowedStatuses.length > 0 ? (
                <form
                  className="admin-order-details__actions"
                  onSubmit={handleStatusUpdate}
                >
                  <label htmlFor="next-order-status">
                    Update order status
                  </label>

                  <select
                    id="next-order-status"
                    value={nextStatus}
                    onChange={(event) => setNextStatus(event.target.value)}
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    required
                  >
                    <option value="">Select next status</option>

                    {allowedStatuses.map((status) => (
                      <option key={status} value={status}>
                        {getOrderStatusLabel(status)}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="admin-order-details__primary-button"
                    disabled={!nextStatus || actionLoading}
                  >
                    {actionLoading ? (
                      <LoaderCircle size={16} />
                    ) : (
                      <CheckCircle2 size={16} />
                    )}
                    Update status
                  </button>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <p className="admin-order-details__muted">
                  This order has reached its final status.
                </p>
              )}

              {canCancel && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="admin-order-details__cancel-button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActionError("");
                    setShowCancelDialog(true);
                  }}
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                >
                  <XCircle size={16} />
                  Cancel order
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                className="admin-order-details__refresh"
                onClick={() => loadOrder()}
                disabled={actionLoading}
              >
                <RefreshCw size={15} />
                Refresh order
              </button>
            </section>
          </aside>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showCancelDialog && (
        <div
          className="admin-order-details__modal-backdrop"
          role="presentation"
          onMouseDown={(event) => {
            if (
              event.target === event.currentTarget &&
              !actionLoading
            ) {
              setShowCancelDialog(false);
            }
          }}
        >
          <section
            className="admin-order-details__modal"
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="cancel-order-title"
          >
            <div className="admin-order-details__modal-heading">
              <div>
                <span className="admin-order-details__modal-icon">
                  <XCircle size={21} />
                </span>

                <div>
                  <h2 id="cancel-order-title">Cancel this order?</h2>
                  <p>
                    This action will restore the reserved product stock.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowCancelDialog(false)}
                disabled={actionLoading}
                aria-label="Close dialog"
              >
                <X size={19} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form
              className="admin-order-details__cancel-form"
              onSubmit={handleCancelOrder}
            >
              <label htmlFor="admin-cancel-reason">
                Cancellation reason
              </label>

              <textarea
                id="admin-cancel-reason"
                value={cancelReason}
                onChange={(event) => setCancelReason(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Enter a clear reason for cancelling this order..."
                rows={4}
                minLength={5}
                maxLength={500}
                required
                disabled={actionLoading}
              />

              <span className="admin-order-details__character-count">
                {cancelReason.trim().length}/500 characters
              </span>

              <div className="admin-order-details__modal-actions">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="admin-order-details__secondary-button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCancelDialog(false)}
                  disabled={actionLoading}
                >
                  Keep order
                </button>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="admin-order-details__danger-button"
                  disabled={
                    actionLoading ||
                    cancelReason.trim().length < 5 ||
                    cancelReason.trim().length > 500
                  }
                >
                  {actionLoading && (
                    <LoaderCircle size={16} />
                  )}
                  Confirm cancellation
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminOrderDetails;

================================================================================
FILE: frontend\src\features\admin\pages\AdminOrders.jsx
