import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams, useNavigate  } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Heart,
  Minus,
  Plus,
  ShoppingBag,
  Star,
} from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import { productService } from "../services/productService";
import useShopStore from "../../../store/useShopStore";
import {
  formatPrice,
  getDiscountPercentage,
} from "../utils/productUtils";

import "../products.css";

export default function ProductDetailsPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();

  const [product, setProduct] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);

  const addToCart = useShopStore((state) => state.addToCart);
  const toggleWishlist = useShopStore((state) => state.toggleWishlist);
  const wishlistItems = useShopStore((state) => state.wishlistItems);
const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isWishlisted = product
    ? wishlistItems.includes(product.id)
    : false;

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadProduct() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setQuantity(1);

      try {
        const result = await productService.getProductBySlug(slug);

        if (isMounted) {
          setProduct(result);
        }
      } catch {
        if (isMounted) {
          setProduct(null);
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    }

    loadProduct();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [slug]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <MainLayout>
        <div className="product-loading">
          Loading product details...
        </div>
      </MainLayout>
    );
  }

  if (!product) {
    return (
      <MainLayout>
        <div className="product-empty-state">
          <h3>Product not found</h3>
          <p>This product may no longer be available.</p>
          <Link to="/shop" className="product-primary-button">
            Back to Shop
          </Link>
        </div>
      </MainLayout>
    );
  }

  const discount = getDiscountPercentage(
    product.price,
    product.compareAtPrice
  );

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <section className="product-details-page">

        <div className="details-breadcrumb">
          <Link to="/">Home</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <Link to="/shop">Shop</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <span>{product.name}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="product-details-grid">

          <div className="details-image-wrapper">
            {product.badge && (
              <span className="details-badge">
                {product.badge}
              </span>
            )}

            <img
              src={product.image}
              alt={product.name}
              className="details-main-image"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="details-information">

            <span className="details-category">
              {product.category}
            </span>

            <h1>{product.name}</h1>

            <div className="details-rating">
              <Star size={17} fill="currentColor" />
            <strong>{Number(product.rating ?? 0).toFixed(1)}</strong>
              <span>
                ({product.reviewCount} customer reviews)
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="details-price">
              <strong>{formatPrice(product.price)}</strong>

              {product.compareAtPrice > product.price && (
                <>
                  <del>{formatPrice(product.compareAtPrice)}</del>
                  <span>{discount}% OFF</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            <p className="details-description">
              {product.description}
            </p>

            <div className="details-stock">
              <span
                className={
                  product.stock > 0
                    ? "stock-available"
                    : "stock-unavailable"
                }
              >
                {product.stock > 0
                  ? "In Stock"
                  : "Currently Unavailable"}
              </span>
            </div>

            {product.stock > 0 && (
              <>
                <div className="details-quantity">
                  <span>Quantity</span>

                  <div className="quantity-control">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setQuantity((value) => Math.max(1, value - 1))
                      }
                      disabled={quantity <= 1}
                      aria-label="Decrease quantity"
                    >
                      <Minus size={15} />
                    </button>

                    <span>{quantity}</span>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setQuantity((value) =>
                          Math.min(product.stock, value + 1)
                        )
                      }
                      disabled={quantity >= product.stock}
                      aria-label="Increase quantity"
                    >
                      <Plus size={15} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="details-add-button"
                  onClick={() => {
  addToCart(product, quantity);
  navigate("/cart");
}}
                >
                  <ShoppingBag size={19} />
                  Add to Cart
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              className={`details-wishlist-button ${
                isWishlisted ? "is-active" : ""
              }`}
              onClick={() => toggleWishlist(product.id)}
            >
              <Heart
                size={18}
                fill={isWishlisted ? "currentColor" : "none"}
              />

              {isWishlisted
                ? "Remove from Wishlist"
                : "Add to Wishlist"}
            </button>

            <div className="details-trust-note">
              <ArrowLeft size={15} />
              <Link to="/shop">Continue exploring our collection</Link>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useProducts from "../hooks/useproducts";
import ProductGrid from "../components/ProductGrid";
import ProductFilters from "../components/ProductFilters";
import ProductToolbar from "../components/ProductToolbar";
import useShopStore from "../../../store/useShopStore";

import "../products.css";

export default function ShopPage({ collection: initialCollection = "all" }) {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const [category, setCategory] = useState(
    searchParams.get("category") || "all"
  );

  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState(100000);
  const [minRating, setMinRating] = useState(0);
  const [inStockOnly, setInStockOnly] = useState(false);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("featured");
  const [isFilterOpen, setIsFilterOpen] = useState(false);

  const search = searchParams.get("search") || "";
  const collection =
    initialCollection !== "all"
      ? initialCollection
      : searchParams.get("collection") || "all";

  const {
    products,
    totalProducts,
    isLoading,
    error,
  } = useProducts({
    search,
    category,
    maxPrice,
    minRating,
    inStockOnly,
    sortBy,
    collection,
  });

  const addToCart = useShopStore((state) => state.addToCart);
  const toggleWishlist = useShopStore((state) => state.toggleWishlist);
  const wishlistItems = useShopStore((state) => state.wishlistItems);

  function clearFilters() {
    setCategory("all");
    setMaxPrice(100000);
    setMinRating(0);
    setInStockOnly(false);
    setSortBy("featured");
  }

  const pageTitle = {
    "new-arrivals": "New Arrivals",
    "best-sellers": "Best Sellers",
  }[collection] || "Discover Our Collection";

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="shop-page">

        <section className="shop-hero">
          <div className="shop-hero-content">

            <span className="shop-eyebrow">
              THE NEXAMART COLLECTION
            </span>

            <h1>{pageTitle}</h1>

            <p>
              Explore thoughtfully selected products,
              designed to bring more value to everyday living.
            </p>

            <div className="shop-breadcrumb">
              <a href="/">Home</a>
              <ArrowRight size={13} />
              <span>Shop</span>
            </div>

          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="shop-container">

          <div className="shop-section-heading">
            <div>
              <span className="shop-eyebrow">OUR SELECTION</span>
              <h2>Explore Products</h2>
            </div>

            <p>
              Quality products. Thoughtful choices.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="shop-layout">

            {isFilterOpen && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="filter-backdrop"
                onClick={() => setIsFilterOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Close filters"
              />
            )}

            <div
              className={`shop-filter-sidebar ${
                isFilterOpen ? "is-open" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <ProductFilters
                category={category}
                onCategoryChange={setCategory}
                maxPrice={maxPrice}
                onMaxPriceChange={setMaxPrice}
                minRating={minRating}
                onMinRatingChange={setMinRating}
                inStockOnly={inStockOnly}
                onInStockChange={setInStockOnly}
                onClear={clearFilters}
                onClose={() => setIsFilterOpen(false)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="shop-products-area">

              <ProductToolbar
                total={products.length}
                sortBy={sortBy}
                onSortChange={setSortBy}
                onFilterClick={() => setIsFilterOpen(true)}
              />

              {search && (
                <p className="shop-search-info">
                  Search results for: <strong>"{search}"</strong>
                </p>
              )}

              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="product-loading">
                  Loading our collection...
                </div>
              ) : error ? (
                <div className="product-empty-state">
                  <h3>Unable to load products</h3>
                  <p>{error}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <ProductGrid
                  products={products}
                  onAddToCart={addToCart}
                  onToggleWishlist={(product) =>
                    toggleWishlist(product.id)
                  }
                  wishlistItems={wishlistItems}
                />
              )}

              {!isLoading && products.length > 0 && (
                <div className="shop-results-footer">
                  Showing {products.length} of {totalProducts} products
                </div>
              )}

            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient.js";

const normalizeProduct = (product) => ({
  ...product,
  id: product.sku,
  rating: Number(product.rating ?? 0),
  reviewCount: Number(product.reviewCount ?? 0),
  stock: Number(product.stock ?? 0),
  isNew: product.isNewArrival ?? false,
});;

const getProductsPage = async (params = {}) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/products", {
    params,
  });

  const result = response.data.data;

  return {
    ...result,
    products: result.products.map(normalizeProduct),
  };
};

const getProducts = async (params = {}) => {
  const result = await getProductsPage(params);

  return result.products;
};


const getProductBySlug = async (slug) => {
  try {
    const response = await apiClient.get(
      `/products/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`
    );

    return normalizeProduct(response.data.data.product);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.response?.status === 404) {
      return null;
    }

    throw error;
  }
};



const getProductById = async (id) => {
  const products = await getProducts({ limit: 100 });

  return products.find((product) => product.id === id) ?? null;
};

const getCategories = async () => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/products/categories");

  return response.data.data;
};

export const productService = {
  getProducts,
  getProductsPage,
  getProductBySlug,
  getProductById,
  getCategories,
};



================================================================================
FILE: frontend\src\features\products\utils\productUtils.js

export function formatPrice(price) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(price);
}

export function getDiscountPercentage(price, compareAtPrice) {
  if (!compareAtPrice || compareAtPrice <= price) {
    return 0;
  }

  return Math.round(
    ((compareAtPrice - price) / compareAtPrice) * 100
  );
}

export function getProductCategories(products) {
  return [...new Set(products.map((product) => product.category))];
}

export function filterProducts(products, filters = {}) {
  const {
    search = "",
    category = "all",
    maxPrice = Infinity,
    minRating = 0,
    inStockOnly = false,
    collection = "all",
  } = filters;

  const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

  return products.filter((product) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !normalizedSearch ||
      product.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
      product.category.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch);

    const matchesCategory =
      category === "all" || product.category === category;

    const matchesPrice = product.price <= maxPrice;

    const matchesRating = product.rating >= minRating;

    const matchesStock =
      !inStockOnly || product.stock > 0;

    const matchesCollection =
      collection === "all" ||
      (collection === "new-arrivals" && product.isNew) ||
      (collection === "best-sellers" && product.bestSeller);

    return (
      matchesSearch &&
      matchesCategory &&
      matchesPrice &&
      matchesRating &&
      matchesStock &&
      matchesCollection
    );
  });
}

export function sortProducts(products, sortBy = "featured") {
  const sorted = [...products];

  switch (sortBy) {
    case "price-low":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);

    case "price-high":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);

    case "rating":
      return sorted.sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating);

    case "newest":
      return sorted.sort(
        (a, b) => Number(b.isNew) - Number(a.isNew)
      );

    default:
      return sorted.sort(
        (a, b) => Number(b.bestSeller) - Number(a.bestSeller)
      );
  }
}

import { Heart, ShoppingBag, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount);

export default function WishlistItem({
  product,
  onRemove,
  onAddToCart,
}) {
  const isOutOfStock = Number(product.stock) <= 0;

  return (
    <article className="wishlist-item">
      <Link
        to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
        className="wishlist-item__image-link"
      >
        <img
          src={product.image}
          alt={product.name}
          className="wishlist-item__image"
          loading="lazy"
        />
      </Link>

      <div className="wishlist-item__content">
        <span className="wishlist-item__category">
          {product.category}
        </span>

        <Link
          to={`/product/${product.slug}`}
          className="wishlist-item__name"
        >
          {product.name}
        </Link>

        <strong className="wishlist-item__price">
          {formatPrice(product.price)}
        </strong>

        <span
          className={
            isOutOfStock
              ? "wishlist-item__stock is-out"
              : "wishlist-item__stock"
          }
        >
          {isOutOfStock ? "Out of stock" : "In stock"}
        </span>

        <div className="wishlist-item__actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="wishlist-item__add"
            disabled={isOutOfStock}
            onClick={() => onAddToCart(product)}
          >
            <ShoppingBag size={16} />
            Add to Cart
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="wishlist-item__remove"
            aria-label={`Remove ${product.name} from wishlist`}
            onClick={() => onRemove(product.id)}
          >
            <Trash2 size={17} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Heart
        className="wishlist-item__heart"
        size={19}
        fill="currentColor"
      />
    </article>
  );
}

    <MainLayout>
      <section className="wishlist-page">
        <div className="wishlist-page__container">
          <header className="wishlist-page__heading">
            <span className="wishlist-page__eyebrow">
              YOUR PERSONAL COLLECTION
            </span>

            <h1>My Wishlist</h1>

            <p>
              Your favorite products, all in one place.
            </p>
          </header>

          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="wishlist-message">
              Loading your favorites...
            </div>
          ) : error ? (
            <div className="wishlist-message wishlist-message--error">
              Unable to load products. Please try again.
            </div>
          ) : wishlistProducts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="wishlist-empty">
              <div className="wishlist-empty__icon">
                <Heart size={34} />
              </div>

              <h2>Your wishlist is waiting</h2>

              <p>
                Save products you love and find them here anytime.
              </p>

              <Link
                to="/shop"
                className="wishlist-empty__button"
              >
                Discover Products
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="wishlist-page__toolbar">
                <h2>Saved Products</h2>
                <span>
                  {wishlistProducts.length} products
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="wishlist-grid">
                {wishlistProducts.map((product) => (
                  <WishlistItem
                    key={product.id}
                    product={product}
                    onRemove={toggleWishlist}
                    onAddToCart={addToCart}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\layouts\Header.jsx
================================================================================

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Search,
  UserRound,
  Heart,
  ShoppingBag,
} from "lucide-react";

import useShopStore from "../store/useShopStore";
import useAccount from "../features/account/hooks/useAccount";

export default function Header() {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { currentUser, isAuthenticated } = useAccount();

  const cartCount = useShopStore((state) =>
    state.cartItems.reduce(
      (total, item) => total + item.quantity,
      0
    )
  );

  const wishlistCount = useShopStore(
    (state) => state.wishlistItems.length
  );

  const accountLabel = isAuthenticated
    ? currentUser?.fullName?.split(" ")[0] || "My Account"
    : "Sign In";

  function handleSearch(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const query = searchQuery.trim();

    if (!query) return;

    navigate(`/shop?search=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
    setSearchQuery("");
  }

  return (
    <header className="site-header">
      <div className="header-inner">

        <Link
          to="/"
          className="brand"
          aria-label="NexaMart home"
        >
          <span className="brand-mark">N</span>

          <span className="brand-name">
            Nexa<span>Mart</span>
          </span>
        </Link>

        <form
          className="header-search"
          role="search"
          onSubmit={handleSearch}
        >
          <Search size={19} className="search-icon" />

          <input
            type="search"
            name="search"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setSearchQuery(event.target.value)
            }
            placeholder="Search products, brands and more..."
            aria-label="Search products"
          />

          <button
            type="submit"
            aria-label="Submit search"
          >
            <Search size={18} />
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="header-actions">

          <Link
            to={isAuthenticated ? "/account" : "/login"}
            className="header-action"
            aria-label={accountLabel}
          >
            <UserRound size={20} />
            <span>{accountLabel}</span>
          </Link>

          <Link
            to="/wishlist"
            className="header-action"
            aria-label={`Wishlist, ${wishlistCount} items`}
          >
            <span className="header-icon-wrapper">
              <Heart size={20} />

              {wishlistCount > 0 && (
                <span className="header-count">
                  {wishlistCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>

            <span>Wishlist</span>
          </Link>

          <Link
            to="/cart"
            className="header-action"
            aria-label={`Cart, ${cartCount} items`}
          >
            <span className="header-icon-wrapper">
              <ShoppingBag size={20} />

              {cartCount > 0 && (
                <span className="header-count">
                  {cartCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>

            <span>Cart</span>
          </Link>

        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Menu, X, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react";

const navigationItems = [
  { label: "Home", href: "/" },
  { label: "Shop", href: "/shop" },
  { label: "Categories", href: "/categories" },
  { label: "New Arrivals", href: "/new-arrivals" },
  { label: "Best Sellers", href: "/best-sellers" },
  { label: "Contact", href: "/contact" },
];

export default function Navigation() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  function closeMenu() {
    setIsOpen(false);
  }

  return (
    <nav
      className="site-navigation"
      aria-label="Main navigation"
    >
      <div className="navigation-inner">

        <button
          type="button"
          className="mobile-menu-toggle"
          onClick={() => setIsOpen((previous) => !previous)}
          aria-expanded={isOpen}
          aria-controls="primary-navigation"
        >
          <span>Explore NexaMart</span>

          {isOpen ? (
            <X size={21} />
          ) : (
            <Menu size={21} />
          )}
        </button>

        <ul
          id="primary-navigation"
          className={`navigation-list ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}`}
        >
          {navigationItems.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.href}>
              <a href={item.href} onClick={closeMenu}>
                {item.label}
              </a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <span className="navigation-caption">
          Curated for everyday living
          <ChevronDown size={13} />
        </span>

      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

import axios from "axios";

const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL:
    import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
    "http://localhost:5000/api/v1",

  withCredentials: true,
  timeout: 15000,

  headers: {
    Accept: "application/json",
  },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    if (config.data instanceof FormData) {
      config.headers.delete?.("Content-Type");

      if (!config.headers.delete) {
        delete config.headers["Content-Type"];
      }
    } else if (config.data && !config.headers["Content-Type"]) {
      config.headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

export default apiClient;

FILE: frontend\src\store\useShopStore.js
================================================================================

import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist } from "zustand/middleware";

const getValidQuantity = (quantity, stock) => {
  const value = Math.trunc(Number(quantity) || 1);

  return Math.max(1, Math.min(value, stock));
};

const useShopStore = create(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      // State
      cartItems: [],
      wishlistItems: [],

      // Cart Actions
      addToCart: (product, quantity = 1) => {
        if (!product?.id || !Number.isFinite(Number(product.stock))) {
          return;
        }

        const stock = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(product.stock)));

        if (stock <= 0) return;

        const validQuantity = getValidQuantity(quantity, stock);

        set((state) => {
          const existingItem = state.cartItems.find(
            (item) => item.product.id === product.id
          );

          if (existingItem) {
            return {
              cartItems: state.cartItems.map((item) =>
                item.product.id === product.id
                  ? {
                      ...item,
                      product,
                      quantity: getValidQuantity(
                        item.quantity + validQuantity,
                        stock
                      ),
                    }
                  : item
              ),
            };
          }

          return {
            cartItems: [
              ...state.cartItems,
              {
                product,
                quantity: validQuantity,
              },
            ],
          };
        });
      },

      removeFromCart: (productId) =>
        set((state) => ({
          cartItems: state.cartItems.filter(
            (item) => item.product.id !== productId
          ),
        })),

      updateQuantity: (productId, quantity) =>
        set((state) => ({
          cartItems: state.cartItems.map((item) =>
            item.product.id === productId
              ? {
                  ...item,
                  quantity: getValidQuantity(
                    quantity,
                    Math.max(1, Number(item.product.stock) || 1)
                  ),
                }
              : item
          ),
        })),

      clearCart: () => set({ cartItems: [] }),

      // Wishlist Actions
      toggleWishlist: (productId) =>
        set((state) => ({
          wishlistItems: state.wishlistItems.includes(productId)
            ? state.wishlistItems.filter((id) => id !== productId)
            : [...state.wishlistItems, productId],
        })),

      removeFromWishlist: (productId) =>
        set((state) => ({
          wishlistItems: state.wishlistItems.filter(
            (id) => id !== productId
          ),
        })),

      // Cart Calculations
      getCartCount: () =>
        get().cartItems.reduce(
          (total, item) => total + item.quantity,
          0
        ),

      getCartSubtotal: () =>
        get().cartItems.reduce(
          (total, item) =>
            total + Number(item.product.price || 0) * item.quantity,
          0
        ),

      getWishlistCount: () => get().wishlistItems.length,
    }),
    {
      name: "nexamart-shop-v1",

      partialize: (state) => ({
        cartItems: state.cartItems,
        wishlistItems: state.wishlistItems,
      }),
    }
  )
);

export default useShopStore;

==================== frontend\src\features\admin\components\AdminProductTable.jsx ====================

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Edit3,
  LoaderCircle,
  Package,
  Power,
  PowerOff,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

const formatCurrency = (value = 0) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number(value) || 0);

const getStockStatus = (value) => {
  const stock = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0);

  if (stock === 0) {
    return { label: "Out of stock", className: "out" };
  }

  if (stock <= 5) {
    return { label: "Low stock", className: "low" };
  }

  return { label: "In stock", className: "available" };
};

const AdminProductTable = ({
  products = [],
  isLoading,
  actionLoading,
  onToggleStatus,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state" role="status">
        <LoaderCircle size={28} className="is-spinning" />
        <span>Loading products...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoading && products.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="admin-products__state">
        <Package size={34} />
        <strong>No products found</strong>
        <span>Try changing your search or filters.</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="admin-products__table-wrap">
      <table className="admin-products__table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Product</th>
            <th>SKU</th>
            <th>Category</th>
            <th>Price</th>
            <th>Inventory</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {products.map((product) => {
            const stock = getStockStatus(product.stock);
            const isUpdating = actionLoading === product._id;

            return (
              <tr key={product._id}>
                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__product">
                    {product.image ? (
                      <img
                        src={product.image}
                        alt={product.name}
                        loading="lazy"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="admin-products__image-placeholder">
                        <Package size={19} />
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <div>
                      <strong>{product.name}</strong>
                      <span>{product.slug}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </td>

                <td className="admin-products__sku">
                  {product.sku || "â€”"}
                </td>

                <td>{product.category || "Uncategorized"}</td>

                <td className="admin-products__price">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__stock admin-products__stock--${stock.className}`}
                  >
                    {stock.className === "out" && (
                      <AlertTriangle size={13} />
                    )}
                    {Number(product.stock) || 0} Â· {stock.label}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <span
                    className={`admin-products__status ${
                      product.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span />
                    {product.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                  </span>
                </td>

                <td>
                  <div className="admin-products__actions">
                    <Link
                      to={`/admin/products/${product._id}/edit`}
                      className="admin-products__edit"
                      aria-label={`Edit ${product.name}`}
                    >
                      <Edit3 size={15} />
                      <span>Edit</span>
                    </Link>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`admin-products__action ${
                        product.isActive
                          ? "is-deactivate"
                          : "is-activate"
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => onToggleStatus(product)}
                      disabled={Boolean(actionLoading)}
                      aria-busy={isUpdating}
                    >
                      {isUpdating ? (
                        <LoaderCircle
                          size={15}
                          className="is-spinning"
                        />
                      ) : product.isActive ? (
                        <PowerOff size={15} />
                      ) : (
                        <Power size={15} />
                      )}

                      <span>
                        {product.isActive ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminProductTable;

==================== frontend\src\features\admin\pages\AdminCustomers.jsx ====================

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  Eye,
  Filter,
  LoaderCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Users,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

import useAdminCustomers from "../hooks/useAdminCustomers";
import "./admin-customers.css";

const SORT_OPTIONS = [
  ["newest", "Newest first"],
  ["oldest", "Oldest first"],
  ["name_asc", "Name A-Z"],
  ["name_desc", "Name Z-A"],
];

const formatDate = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "â€”";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? "â€”"
    : new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PK", {
        dateStyle: "medium",
      }).format(date);
};

const formatPrice = (amount) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PK", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "PKR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number(amount) || 0);

const AdminCustomers = () => {
  const {
    customers,
    filters,
    searchInput,
    setSearchInput,
    pagination,
    isLoading,
    error,
    updateFilter,
    applySearch,
    changePage,
    refreshCustomers,
  } = useAdminCustomers();

  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);

  const hasActiveFilters = useMemo(
    () => Boolean(filters.status || filters.search),
    [filters.status, filters.search]
  );

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchInput("");

    updateFilter("search", "");
    updateFilter("status", "");
    updateFilter("sort", "newest");
  };

  return (
    <main className="admin-customers">
      <div className="admin-customers__container">
        <header className="admin-customers__header">
          <div>
            
<Link
  to={`/admin/customers/${customer._id}`}
  className="admin-customers__view"
>
  <Eye size={15} />
  <span>View</span>
</Link>

            <span className="admin-customers__eyebrow">
              NEXAMART ADMINISTRATION
            </span>

            <h1>Customer Management</h1>

            <p>
              Manage customer accounts, monitor activity and review
              customer relationships.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="admin-customers__header-actions">
            <span className="admin-customers__secure">
              <ShieldCheck size={16} />
              Admin access
            </span>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-customers__button"
              onClick={refreshCustomers}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              <RefreshCw
                size={16}
                className={isLoading ? "is-spinning" : ""}
              />
              Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <section className="admin-customers__overview">
          <div className="admin-customers__overview-icon">
            <Users size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Total matching customers</span>
            <strong>
              {pagination.total.toLocaleString("en-PK")}
            </strong>
            <small>
              {pagination.pages
                ? `Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.pages}`
                : "No pages available"}
            </small>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="admin-customers__panel">
          <div className="admin-customers__panel-header">
            <div>
              <h2>All customers</h2>
              <p>Search and manage registered customer accounts.</p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="admin-customers__filter-toggle"
              onClick={() => setShowFilters((previous) => !previous)}
              aria-expanded={showFilters}
            >
              <Filter size={16} />
              Filters
            </button>
          </div>

          <form
            className="admin-customers__search"
            onSubmit={applySearch}
          >
            <Search size={18} />

            <input
              type="search"
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(event) => setSearchInput(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search name, email or phone..."
              aria-label="Search customers"
            />

            {searchInput && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearchInput("");
                  updateFilter("search", "");
                }}
                aria-label="Clear search"
              >
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            )}

            <button type="submit" className="admin-customers__search-submit">
              Search
            </button>
          </form>

          {showFilters && (
            <div className="admin-customers__filters">
              <label>
                Account status
                <select
                  value={filters.status}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateFilter("status", event.target.value)
                  }
                >
                  <option value="">All customers</option>
                  <option value="active">Active</option>
                  <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
                </select>
              </label>

              <label>
                Sort by
                <select
                  value={filters.sort}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    updateFilter("sort", event.target.value)
                  }
                >
                  {SORT_OPTIONS.map(([value, label]) => (
                    <option key={value} value={value}>
                      {label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>

              {hasActiveFilters && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="admin-customers__reset"
                  onClick={clearFilters}
                >
                  <X size={15} />
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="admin-customers__error" role="alert">
              <span>{error}</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={refreshCustomers}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="admin-customers__table-wrap">
            <table className="admin-customers__table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Customer</th>
                  <th>Phone</th>
                  <th>Orders</th>
                  <th>Order value</th>
                  <th>Account</th>
                  <th>Joined</th>
                  <th aria-label="Actions" />
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {isLoading ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="7" className="admin-customers__state">
                      <LoaderCircle className="is-spinning" size={25} />
                      Loading customers...
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : customers.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="7" className="admin-customers__state">
                      <Users size={28} />
                      <strong>No customers found</strong>
                      <span>
                        Try changing your search or filter criteria.
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  customers.map((customer) => (
                    <tr key={customer._id}>
                      <td>
                        <div className="admin-customers__identity">
                          <span className="admin-customers__avatar">
                            {(customer.fullName || "C")
                              .charAt(0)
                              .toUpperCase()}
                          </span>

                          <div>
                            <strong>{customer.fullName}</strong>
                            <span>{customer.email}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td>{customer.phone || "â€”"}</td>

                      <td>
                        <strong>
                          {customer.orderStats?.totalOrders ?? 0}
                        </strong>
                      </td>

                      <td className="admin-customers__amount">
                        {formatPrice(
                          customer.orderStats?.totalOrderValue
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td>
                        <span
                          className={`admin-customers__status ${
                            customer.isActive ? "is-active" : "is-inactive"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {customer.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td>{formatDate(customer.createdAt)}</td>

                      <td>
                        <Link
                          to={`/admin/customers/${customer._id}`}
                          className="admin-customers__view"
                          aria-label={`View ${customer.fullName}`}
                        >
                          <Eye size={17} />
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <footer className="admin-customers__pagination">
            <span>
              Showing {customers.length} of {pagination.total} customers
            </span>

            <div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(pagination.page - 1)}
                disabled={isLoading || !pagination.hasPreviousPage}
              >
                <ArrowLeft size={16} />
                Previous
              </button>

              <span>
                {pagination.page} / {Math.max(pagination.pages, 1)}
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => changePage(pagination.page + 1)}
                disabled={isLoading || !pagination.hasNextPage}
              >
                Next
                <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </footer>
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

export default AdminCustomers;

==================== backend\src\services\admin\admin.service.js ====================
import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";
import Category from "../../models/category/Category.model.js";
import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD = 5;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 5;
const LOW_STOCK_LIMIT = 5;

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_asc: { price: 1, _id: 1 },
  price_desc: { price: -1, _id: -1 },
  name_asc: { name: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { name: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const ACTIVE_ORDER_STATUSES = [
  "placed",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "shipped",
];

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (
    typeof value !== "string" ||
    !/^\\d+$/.test(value)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeAdminProductQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "category",
    "status",
    "stockStatus",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  if (
    query.category !== undefined &&
    typeof query.category !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Category must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const category = query.category?.trim();

  if (search && search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  if (query.category !== undefined && !category) {
    throwBadRequest("Category cannot be empty.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product status filter.");
  }

  const stockStatus = query.stockStatus ?? "all";

  if (
    !["all", "in_stock", "low_stock", "out_of_stock"].includes(
      stockStatus
    )
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid stock status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  };
};

const getDashboardStats = async () => {
 
const [
  totalOrders,
  totalProducts,
  totalCustomers,
  activeCustomers,
  inactiveCustomers,
  activeOrders,
  totalCancelledOrders,
  revenueResult,
  orderValueResult,
  cancelledValueResult,
  lowStockCount,
  recentOrders,
  lowStockProducts,
] = await Promise.all([
  Order.countDocuments(),

  Product.countDocuments({ isActive: true }),

  User.countDocuments({ role: "customer" }),

  User.countDocuments({
    role: "customer",
    isActive: true,
  }),

  User.countDocuments({
    role: "customer",
    isActive: false,
  }),

  Order.countDocuments({
    status: {
      $in: ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"],
    },
  }),

  Order.countDocuments({ status: "cancelled" }),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $match: {
        paymentStatus: "paid",
        status: { $ne: "cancelled" },
      },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Order.aggregate([
    {
      $match: { status: "cancelled" },
    },
    {
      $group: {
        _id: null,
        total: { $sum: "$total" },
      },
    },
  ]),

  Product.countDocuments({
    isActive: true,
    stock: { $lte: 5 },
  }),

  Order.find()
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .limit(8)
    .select(
      "orderNumber customer.fullName total status paymentStatus createdAt"
    )
    .lean(),

  Product.find({
    isActive: true,
    stock: { $lte: 5 },
  })
    .sort({ stock: 1 })
    .limit(8)
    .select("name sku price stock image category")
    .lean(),
]);

const stats = {
  totalRevenue: revenueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  totalOrderValue: orderValueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  cancelledOrderValue: cancelledValueResult[0]?.total || 0,
  totalOrders,
  totalCancelledOrders,
  activeOrders,
  totalProducts,
  totalCustomers,
  activeCustomers,
  inactiveCustomers,
  lowStockCount,
};

return {
  stats,
  recentOrders,
  lowStockProducts,
};

};

const getAdminProducts = async (query = {}) => {
  const {
    search,
    category,
    status,
    stockStatus,
    sort,
    page,
    limit,
  } = normalizeAdminProductQuery(query);

  const filter = {};

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { name: searchRegex },
      { sku: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  if (category) {
    const categoryDocument = mongoose.isValidObjectId(category)
      ? await Category.findOne({ _id: category, isActive: true })
          .select("_id name")
          .lean()
      : await Category.findOne({
          isActive: true,
          $or: [
            { slug: category },
            {
              name: {
                $regex: `^${escapeRegex(category)}$`,
                $options: "i",
              },
            },
          ],
        })
          .select("_id name")
          .lean();

    const categoryFilter = categoryDocument
      ? {
          $or: [
            { categoryId: categoryDocument._id },
            {
              category: categoryDocument.name,
              categoryId: null,
            },
            {
              category: categoryDocument.name,
              categoryId: { $exists: false },
            },
          ],
        }
      : { category };

    filter.$and = [
      ...(filter.$and || []),
      categoryFilter,
    ];
  }

  if (stockStatus === "in_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "low_stock") {
    filter.stock = { $gt: 0, $lte: LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD };
  }

  if (stockStatus === "out_of_stock") {
    filter.stock = 0;
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [
    products,
    total,
    categoryDocuments,
    legacyCategories,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    Product.find(filter)
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    Product.countDocuments(filter),

    Category.find({ isActive: true })
      .select("name")
      .lean(),

    Product.distinct("category"),
  ]);

  const categoryNames = new Map();

  for (const name of [
    ...categoryDocuments.map((item) => item.name),
    ...legacyCategories,
  ]) {
    if (typeof name !== "string" || !name.trim()) continue;

    const normalizedName = name.trim();
    const key = normalizedName.toLocaleLowerCase();

    if (!categoryNames.has(key)) {
      categoryNames.set(key, normalizedName);
    }
  }

  return {
    products,
    categories: [...categoryNames.values()].sort((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b)
    ),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminProductById = async (productId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findById(productId).lean();

  if (!product) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Product not found."
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const updateProductStatus = async (productId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(productId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid product ID.");
  }

  const product = await Product.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: productId, isActive: !isActive },
    { $set: { isActive } },
    { new: true, runValidators: true }
  ).lean();

  if (!product) {
    const exists = await Product.exists({ _id: productId });

    if (!exists) {
      throw new ApiError(
        HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
        "Product not found."
      );
    }

    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
      `Product is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
    );
  }

  return product;
};

const activateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, true);

const deactivateProduct = (productId) =>
  updateProductStatus(productId, false);

const adminService = {
  getDashboardStats,
  getAdminProducts,
  getAdminProductById,
  activateProduct,
  deactivateProduct,
};

export default adminService;

==================== backend\src\services\admin\admin-customer.service.js ====================
import mongoose from "mongoose";

import User from "../../models/user/User.model.js";
import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const DEFAULT_PAGE = 1;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT = 12;
const MAX_LIMIT = 100;
const MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH = 100;
const RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT = 10;

const SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
  newest: { createdAt: -1, _id: -1 },
  oldest: { createdAt: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_asc: { fullName: 1, _id: 1 },
  name_desc: { fullName: -1, _id: -1 },
});

const throwBadRequest = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST, message);
};

const throwNotFound = (message) => {
  throw new ApiError(HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND, message);
};

const escapeRegex = (value) =>
  value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const parseInteger = (value, field, min, max) => {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < min || parsed > max) {
    throwBadRequest(
      `${field} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}.`
    );
  }

  return parsed;
};

const normalizeQuery = (query = {}) => {
  const allowedFields = new Set([
    "search",
    "status",
    "sort",
    "page",
    "limit",
  ]);

  for (const field of Object.keys(query)) {
    if (!allowedFields.has(field)) {
      throwBadRequest(`Unsupported query parameter: ${field}.`);
    }
  }

  if (
    query.search !== undefined &&
    typeof query.search !== "string"
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Search must be a valid string.");
  }

  const search = query.search?.trim() || "";

  if (search.length > MAX_SEARCH_LENGTH) {
    throwBadRequest("Search query is too long.");
  }

  const status = query.status ?? "all";

  if (!["all", "active", "inactive"].includes(status)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer status filter.");
  }

  const sort = query.sort ?? "newest";

  if (
    typeof sort !== "string" ||
    !Object.hasOwn(SORT_OPTIONS, sort)
  ) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer sorting option.");
  }

  const page =
    query.page === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_PAGE
      : parseInteger(query.page, "Page", 1, 1000000);

  const limit =
    query.limit === undefined
      ? DEFAULT_LIMIT
      : parseInteger(query.limit, "Limit", 1, MAX_LIMIT);

  return { search, status, sort, page, limit };
};

const getAdminCustomers = async (query = {}) => {
  const { search, status, sort, page, limit } = normalizeQuery(query);

  const filter = { role: "customer" };

  if (status === "active") filter.isActive = true;
  if (status === "inactive") filter.isActive = false;

  if (search) {
    const searchRegex = new RegExp(escapeRegex(search), "i");

    filter.$or = [
      { fullName: searchRegex },
      { email: searchRegex },
      { phone: searchRegex },
    ];
  }

  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [customers, total] = await Promise.all([
    User.find(filter)
      .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
      .sort(SORT_OPTIONS[sort])
      .skip(skip)
      .limit(limit)
      .lean(),

    User.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);

  const customerIds = customers.map((customer) => customer._id);

  const orderStats = customerIds.length
    ? await Order.aggregate([
        {
          $match: {
            user: { $in: customerIds },
          },
        },
        {
          $group: {
            _id: "$user",
            totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
            deliveredOrders: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0],
              },
            },
            totalOrderValue: { $sum: "$total" },
            cancelledOrderValue: {
              $sum: {
                $cond: [
                  { $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] },
                  "$total",
                  0,
                ],
              },
            },
          },
        },
      ])
    : [];

  const statsMap = new Map(
    orderStats.map((item) => [item._id.toString(), item])
  );

  const result = customers.map((customer) => {
    const stats = statsMap.get(customer._id.toString());

    return {
      ...customer,
      orderStats: {
        totalOrders: stats?.totalOrders ?? 0,
        deliveredOrders: stats?.deliveredOrders ?? 0,
        totalOrderValue: stats?.totalOrderValue ?? 0,
        cancelledOrderValue: stats?.cancelledOrderValue ?? 0,
      },
    };
  });

  return {
    customers: result,
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      total,
      pages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
      hasNextPage: page * limit < total,
      hasPreviousPage: page > 1,
    },
  };
};

const getAdminCustomerById = async (customerId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOne({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  })
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (!customer) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  const [summaryResult, recentOrders] = await Promise.all([
    Order.aggregate([
      {
        $match: {
          user: customer._id,
        },
      },
      {
        $group: {
          _id: null,
          totalOrders: { $sum: 1 },
          deliveredOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "delivered"] }, 1, 0],
            },
          },
          cancelledOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [{ $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] }, 1, 0],
            },
          },
          activeOrders: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [
                {
                  $in: [
                    "$status",
                    ["placed", "confirmed", "processing", "shipped"],
                  ],
                },
                1,
                0,
              ],
            },
          },
          totalOrderValue: { $sum: "$total" },
          cancelledOrderValue: {
            $sum: {
              $cond: [
                { $eq: ["$status", "cancelled"] },
                "$total",
                0,
              ],
            },
          },
        },
      },
    ]),

    Order.find({ user: customer._id })
      .select(
        "orderNumber status paymentStatus paymentMethod subtotal total items createdAt"
      )
      .sort({ createdAt: -1, _id: -1 })
      .limit(RECENT_ORDERS_LIMIT)
      .lean(),
  ]);

  const summary = summaryResult[0] || {
    totalOrders: 0,
    deliveredOrders: 0,
    cancelledOrders: 0,
    activeOrders: 0,
    totalOrderValue: 0,
    cancelledOrderValue: 0,
  };

  return {
    customer,
    summary,
    recentOrders,
  };
};

const updateCustomerStatus = async (customerId, isActive) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(customerId)) {
    throwBadRequest("Invalid customer ID.");
  }

  if (typeof isActive !== "boolean") {
    throwBadRequest("Customer status must be a boolean.");
  }

  const customer = await User.findOneAndUpdate(
    {
      _id: customerId,
      role: "customer",
      isActive: !isActive,
    },
    {
      $set: { isActive },
    },
    {
      new: true,
      runValidators: true,
    }
  )
    .select("_id fullName email phone role isActive createdAt updatedAt")
    .lean();

  if (customer) return customer;

  const exists = await User.exists({
    _id: customerId,
    role: "customer",
  });

  if (!exists) {
    throwNotFound("Customer not found.");
  }

  throw new ApiError(
    HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
    `Customer is already ${isActive ? "active" : "inactive"}.`
  );
};

const adminCustomerService = {
  getAdminCustomers,
  getAdminCustomerById,
  updateCustomerStatus,
};

export default adminCustomerService;

import orderService from "../../services/order/order.service.js";

const createOrder = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const result = await orderService.createOrder({
      customer: req.body.customer,
      items: req.body.items,
      deliveryMethod: req.body.deliveryMethod,
      paymentMethod: req.body.paymentMethod,
      userId: req.user?._id || null,
    });

  }
};

import mongoose from "mongoose";

const orderItemSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    product: {
      productId: {
        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
        ref: "Product",
        required: true,
      },
      sku: {
        type: String,
        required: true,
        trim: true,
        uppercase: true,
      },
      name: {
        type: String,
        required: true,
        trim: true,
      },
      slug: {
        type: String,
        required: true,
        trim: true,
      },
      image: {
        type: String,
        required: true,
        trim: true,
      },
    },
    quantity: {
      type: Number,
      required: true,
      min: 1,
      validate: Number.isInteger,
    },
    unitPrice: {
      type: Number,
      required: true,
      min: 0,
    },
    lineTotal: {
      type: Number,
      required: true,
      min: 0,
    },
  },
  { _id: false }
);

const customerSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    fullName: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
      maxlength: 80,
    },
    email: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
      lowercase: true,
    },
    phone: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
    },
    addressLine1: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
    },
    addressLine2: {
      type: String,
      default: "",
      trim: true,
    },
    city: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
    },
    province: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
    },
    postalCode: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      trim: true,
    },
  },
  { _id: false }
);

const statusHistorySchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    status: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      enum: [
        "placed",
        "confirmed",
        "processing",
        "shipped",
        "delivered",
        "cancelled",
      ],
    },
    timestamp: {
      type: Date,
      default: Date.now,
    },
    note: {
      type: String,
      default: "",
      trim: true,
      maxlength: 500,
    },
  },
  { _id: false }
);

const orderSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    orderNumber: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      unique: true,
      trim: true,
      uppercase: true,
    },
    user: {
      type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
      ref: "User",
      default: null,
      index: true,
    },
    customer: {
      type: customerSchema,
      required: true,
    },
    items: {
      type: [orderItemSchema],
      required: true,
      validate: {
        validator: (items) => items.length > 0,
        message: "An order must contain at least one product.",
      },
    },
    subtotal: {
      type: Number,
      required: true,
      min: 0,
    },
    deliveryFee: {
      type: Number,
      default: null,
      min: 0,
    },
    total: {
      type: Number,
      required: true,
      min: 0,
    },
    deliveryMethod: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      enum: ["standard", "express"],
    },
    paymentMethod: {
      type: String,
      required: true,
      enum: ["cod",],
    },
    paymentStatus: {
      type: String,
      enum: ["pending", "paid", "failed", "refunded"],
      default: "pending",
    },
    status: {
      type: String,
      enum: [
        "placed",
        "confirmed",
        "processing",
        "shipped",
        "delivered",
        "cancelled",
      ],
      default: "placed",
      index: true,
    },
    statusHistory: {
      type: [statusHistorySchema],
      default: [],
    },
    cancellationReason: {
      type: String,
      default: "",

);

orderSchema.index({ user: 1, createdAt: -1 });
orderSchema.index({ guestAccessTokenHash: 1 });
orderSchema.index({ "customer.email": 1, createdAt: -1 });
orderSchema.index({ status: 1, createdAt: -1 });

const Order = mongoose.model("Order", orderSchema);

export default Order;
