import { Router } from "express";

import orderController from "../../controllers/order/order.controller.js";

import authenticate from "../../middleware/auth/auth.middleware.js";
import optionalAuthenticate from "../../middleware/auth/optional-auth.middleware.js";
import validate from "../../middleware/validate.middleware.js";

import {
  createOrderSchema,
  cancelOrderSchema,
  guestOrderConfirmationSchema,
} from "../../validators/order/order.validator.js";

const router = Router();

// Create order: registered customer or guest
router.post(
  "/",
  optionalAuthenticate,
  validate(createOrderSchema),
  orderController.createOrder
);

// Guest order confirmation: secure token required
router.post(
  "/guest/:orderId/confirmation",
  validate(guestOrderConfirmationSchema),
  orderController.getGuestOrderConfirmation
);

// Registered customer's order history
router.get(
  "/my-orders",
  authenticate,
  orderController.getMyOrders
);

// Registered customer's individual order
router.get(
  "/:orderId",
  authenticate,
  orderController.getMyOrderById
);

// Cancel registered customer's order
router.patch(
  "/:orderId/cancel",
  authenticate,
  validate(cancelOrderSchema),
  orderController.cancelOrder
);

export default router;


========== backend/src/services/order/order.service.js ==========

import { randomBytes, randomUUID, createHash } from "node:crypto";

import mongoose from "mongoose";

import Order from "../../models/order/Order.model.js";
import Product from "../../models/product/Product.model.js";

import ApiError from "../../utils/ApiError.js";
import { HTTP_STATUS } from "../../constants/index.js";

const MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY = 100;
const GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES = 32;

const generateOrderNumber = () =>
  `NEXA-${Date.now().toString().slice(-8)}-${randomUUID()
    .replace(/-/g, "")
    .slice(0, 8)
    .toUpperCase()}`;

const generateGuestAccessToken = () =>
  randomBytes(GUEST_TOKEN_BYTES).toString("hex");

const hashGuestAccessToken = (token) =>
  createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

const normalizeEmail = (email) =>
  String(email || "").trim().toLowerCase();

const sanitizeOrder = (order) => {
  if (!order) return null;

  const safeOrder = order.toObject
    ? order.toObject()
    : { ...order };

  delete safeOrder.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return safeOrder;
};

const validateOrderId = (orderId) => {
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(orderId)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid order ID."
    );
  }
};

const createOrder = async ({
  customer,
  items,
  deliveryMethod,
  paymentMethod,
  userId = null,
}) => {
  if (!customer || !Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Required order information is missing."
    );
  }

  if (paymentMethod !== "cod") {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Currently, only Cash on Delivery is available."
    );
  }

  if (!["standard", "express"].includes(deliveryMethod)) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid delivery method."
    );
  }

  if (items.length > 50) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "An order cannot contain more than 50 products."
    );
  }

  const normalizedItems = items.map((item) => ({
    sku: String(item.sku || "").trim().toUpperCase(),
    quantity: Number(item.quantity),
  }));

  const uniqueSkus = new Set(
    normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku)
  );

  if (
    uniqueSkus.size !== normalizedItems.length ||
    normalizedItems.some(
      (item) =>
        !item.sku ||
        !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) ||
        item.quantity < 1 ||
        item.quantity > MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY
    )
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Invalid or duplicate products in your order."
    );
  }

  const guestAccessToken = userId
    ? null
    : generateGuestAccessToken();

  const guestAccessTokenHash = guestAccessToken
    ? hashGuestAccessToken(guestAccessToken)
    : null;

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let createdOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const products = await Product.find({
        sku: { $in: normalizedItems.map((item) => item.sku) },
        isActive: true,
      }).session(session);

      if (products.length !== normalizedItems.length) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "One or more products are unavailable."
        );
      }

      const productMap = new Map(
        products.map((product) => [product.sku, product])
      );

      const orderItems = [];
      let subtotal = 0;

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        if (!product) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
            `Product ${item.sku} was not found.`
          );
        }

        if (product.stock < item.quantity) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Insufficient stock for ${product.name}.`
          );
        }

        const unitPrice = Number(product.price);
        const lineTotal = unitPrice * item.quantity;

        if (
          !Number.isFinite(unitPrice) ||
          unitPrice < 0 ||
          !Number.isFinite(lineTotal)
        ) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            "Invalid product pricing configuration."
          );
        }

        subtotal += lineTotal;

        orderItems.push({
          product: {
            productId: product._id,
            sku: product.sku,
            name: product.name,
            slug: product.slug,
            image: product.image,
          },
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice,
          lineTotal,
        });
      }

      for (const item of normalizedItems) {
        const product = productMap.get(item.sku);

        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          {
            _id: product._id,
            isActive: true,
            stock: { $gte: item.quantity },
          },
          {
            $inc: { stock: -item.quantity },
          },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.modifiedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            `Stock changed for ${product.name}. Please try again.`
          );
        }
      }

      const orderData = {
        orderNumber: generateOrderNumber(),
        user: userId || null,
        guestAccessTokenHash,
        customer: {
          fullName: customer.fullName.trim(),
          email: normalizeEmail(customer.email),
          phone: customer.phone.trim(),
          addressLine1: customer.addressLine1.trim(),
          addressLine2: customer.addressLine2?.trim() || "",
          city: customer.city.trim(),
          province: customer.province.trim(),
          postalCode: customer.postalCode.trim(),
        },
        items: orderItems,
        subtotal,
        deliveryFee: null,
        total: subtotal,
        deliveryMethod,
        paymentMethod: "cod",
        paymentStatus: "pending",
        status: "placed",
        statusHistory: [
          {
            status: "placed",
            timestamp: new Date(),
            note: "Your order has been successfully placed.",
          },
        ],
      };

      const [order] = await Order.create(
        [orderData],
        { session }
      );

      createdOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return {
    order: sanitizeOrder(createdOrder),
    guestAccessToken,
  };
};

const getCustomerOrders = async (userId) => {
  return Order.find({ user: userId })
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .lean();
};

const getCustomerOrderById = async (orderId, userId) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: userId,
  }).lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found."
    );
  }

  return order;
};

const getGuestOrderConfirmation = async (
  orderId,
  accessToken
) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  if (
    typeof accessToken !== "string" ||
    !/^[a-f\d]{64}$/i.test(accessToken)
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.UNAUTHORIZED,
      "Invalid order access credentials."
    );
  }

  const tokenHash = hashGuestAccessToken(accessToken);

  const order = await Order.findOne({
    _id: orderId,
    user: null,
    guestAccessTokenHash: tokenHash,
  })
    .select("+guestAccessTokenHash")
    .lean();

  if (!order) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
      "Order not found or access denied."
    );
  }

  delete order.guestAccessTokenHash;

  return order;
};

const cancelOrder = async (orderId, userId, reason) => {
  validateOrderId(orderId);

  const normalizedReason = String(reason || "").trim();

  if (
    normalizedReason.length < 5 ||
    normalizedReason.length > 500
  ) {
    throw new ApiError(
      HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
      "Cancellation reason must contain 5 to 500 characters."
    );
  }

  const session = await mongoose.startSession();

  let cancelledOrder;

  try {
    await session.withTransaction(async () => {
      const order = await Order.findOne({
        _id: orderId,
        user: userId,
      }).session(session);

      if (!order) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.NOT_FOUND,
          "Order not found."
        );
      }

      if (
        !["placed", "confirmed", "processing"].includes(
          order.status
        )
      ) {
        throw new ApiError(
          HTTP_STATUS.BAD_REQUEST,
          "This order is no longer eligible for cancellation."
        );
      }

      for (const item of order.items) {
        const stockUpdate = await Product.updateOne(
          { _id: item.product.productId },
          { $inc: { stock: item.quantity } },
          { session }
        );

        if (stockUpdate.matchedCount !== 1) {
          throw new ApiError(
            HTTP_STATUS.CONFLICT,
            "Unable to restore product inventory."
          );
        }
      }

      order.status = "cancelled";
      order.cancellationReason = normalizedReason;

      order.statusHistory.push({
        status: "cancelled",
        timestamp: new Date(),
        note: normalizedReason,
      });

      await order.save({ session });

      cancelledOrder = order;
    });
  } finally {
    await session.endSession();
  }

  return sanitizeOrder(cancelledOrder);
};

const orderService = {
  createOrder,
  getCustomerOrders,
  getCustomerOrderById,
  getGuestOrderConfirmation,
  cancelOrder,
};

export default orderService;


========== backend/src/validators/order/order.validator.js ==========

import { z } from "zod";

const customerSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().trim().min(3).max(80),
  email: z.string().trim().email().max(254),
  phone: z.string().trim().min(7).max(20),
  addressLine1: z.string().trim().min(5).max(200),
  addressLine2: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().default(""),
  city: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  province: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  postalCode: z.string().trim().min(2).max(20),
}).strict();

const orderItemSchema = z.object({
  sku: z.string().trim().min(3).max(40).transform((value) =>
    value.toUpperCase()
  ),
  quantity: z.number().int().min(1).max(100),
}).strict();

export const createOrderSchema = z.object({
  customer: customerSchema,
  items: z.array(orderItemSchema).min(1).max(50),
  deliveryMethod: z.enum(["standard", "express"]),
  paymentMethod: z.literal("cod"),
}).strict();

export const cancelOrderSchema = z.object({
  reason: z.string().trim().min(5).max(500),
}).strict();

export const guestOrderConfirmationSchema = z.object({
  accessToken: z.string().regex(
    /^[a-f\d]{64}$/i,
    "Invalid guest order access token."
  ),
}).strict();


========== frontend/src/features/checkout/pages/CheckoutPage.jsx ==========
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useShopStore from "../../../store/useShopStore";
import useAccount from "../../account/hooks/useAccount";
import orderService from "../../orders/services/orderService";

import CustomerInformation from "../components/CustomerInformation";
import ShippingAddressForm from "../components/ShippingAddressForm";
import DeliveryMethod from "../components/DeliveryMethod";
import PaymentMethod from "../components/PaymentMethod";
import OrderSummary from "../components/OrderSummary";

import "../checkout.css";

const CHECKOUT_FORM_ID = "nexamart-checkout-form";
const GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX = "nexamart-guest-order:";

const INITIAL_FORM_VALUES = {
  fullName: "",
  email: "",
  phone: "",
  addressLine1: "",
  addressLine2: "",
  city: "",
  province: "",
  postalCode: "",
};

const validateForm = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Please enter your full name.";
  }

  if (
    !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email.trim())
  ) {
    errors.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
  }

  if (values.phone.trim().length < 7) {
    errors.phone = "Please enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (values.addressLine1.trim().length < 5) {
    errors.addressLine1 = "Please enter your complete street address.";
  }

  if (values.city.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.city = "Please enter your city.";
  }

  if (values.province.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.province = "Please enter your province.";
  }

  if (values.postalCode.trim().length < 2) {
    errors.postalCode = "Please enter your postal code.";
  }

  return errors;
};

const getOrderId = (order) => order?._id || order?.id;

const CheckoutPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const cartItems = useShopStore((state) => state.cartItems);
  const clearCart = useShopStore((state) => state.clearCart);

  const { currentUser } = useAccount();

  const [formValues, setFormValues] = useState(() => ({
    ...INITIAL_FORM_VALUES,
  }));

  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [deliveryMethod, setDeliveryMethod] = useState("standard");
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState("cod");

  const subtotal = useMemo(
    () =>
      cartItems.reduce(
        (total, item) =>
          total + Number(item.product?.price || 0) * item.quantity,
        0
      ),
    [cartItems]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser) return;

    setFormValues((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      fullName:
        previous.fullName ||
        currentUser.fullName ||
        currentUser.name ||
        "",
      email: previous.email || currentUser.email || "",
      phone: previous.phone || currentUser.phone || "",
    }));
  }, [currentUser]);

  const handleFieldChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormValues((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [field]: value,
    }));

    setErrors((previous) => {
      if (!previous[field]) return previous;

      const updated = { ...previous };
      delete updated[field];

      return updated;
    });

    setSubmitError("");
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (submitting) return;

    if (!cartItems.length) {
      setSubmitError("Your cart is empty.");
      return;
    }

    const validationErrors = validateForm(formValues);

    if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(validationErrors);
      setSubmitError("Please correct the highlighted fields.");
      return;
    }

    setErrors({});
    setSubmitError("");
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const result = await orderService.createOrder({
        customer: {
          fullName: formValues.fullName.trim(),
          email: formValues.email.trim(),
          phone: formValues.phone.trim(),
          addressLine1: formValues.addressLine1.trim(),
          addressLine2: formValues.addressLine2.trim(),
          city: formValues.city.trim(),
          province: formValues.province.trim(),
          postalCode: formValues.postalCode.trim(),
        },
        items: cartItems,
        deliveryMethod,
        paymentMethod,
      });

      const orderId = getOrderId(result.order);

      if (!orderId) {
        throw new Error(
          "Order was created, but its confirmation ID is missing."
        );
      }

      if (result.guestAccessToken) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(
            `${GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX}${orderId}`,
            result.guestAccessToken
          );
        } catch {
          // Order creation remains successful if browser storage is unavailable.
        }
      }

      clearCart();

      navigate(`/order-confirmation/${orderId}`, {
        replace: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setSubmitError(
        error.response?.data?.message ||
          error.message ||
          "Unable to place your order. Please try again."
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!cartItems.length) {
    return (
      <MainLayout>
        <div className="checkout-page">
          <div className="checkout-container">
            <div className="checkout-empty">
              <ShoppingBag size={42} />

              <h2>Your cart is empty</h2>

              <p>
                Add products to your cart before proceeding to checkout.
              </p>

              <Link to="/shop" className="checkout-submit-button">
                Explore Products
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </MainLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="checkout-page">
        <div className="checkout-container">
          <Link to="/cart" className="checkout-back-link">
            <ArrowLeft size={17} />
            Back to Cart
          </Link>

          <div className="checkout-header">
            <div>
              <span className="checkout-eyebrow">SECURE CHECKOUT</span>
              <h1>Complete Your Order</h1>
              <p>
                Provide your details to place your NexaMart order.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="checkout-layout">
            <main className="checkout-main">
              <form
                id={CHECKOUT_FORM_ID}
                className="checkout-form"
                onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                noValidate
              >
                <CustomerInformation
                  values={formValues}
                  errors={errors}
                  onChange={handleFieldChange}
                />

                <ShippingAddressForm
                  values={formValues}
                  errors={errors}
                  onChange={handleFieldChange}
                />

                <DeliveryMethod
                  value={deliveryMethod}
                  onChange={setDeliveryMethod}
                />

                <PaymentMethod
                  value={paymentMethod}
                  onChange={setPaymentMethod}
                />

                {submitError && (
                  <div className="checkout-error-message" role="alert">
                    {submitError}
                  </div>
                )}
              </form>
            </main>

            <aside className="checkout-sidebar">
              <OrderSummary
                items={cartItems}
                subtotal={subtotal}
                submitting={submitting}
              />
            </aside>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default CheckoutPage;

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { CheckCircle2, PackageCheck } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import orderService from "../../orders/services/orderService";
import {
  formatOrderPrice,
  formatOrderDate,
  getOrderStatusLabel,
} from "../../orders/utils/orderUtils";

import "../checkout.css";

const GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX = "nexamart-guest-order:";

const getErrorMessage = (error) =>
  error.response?.data?.message ||
  error.message ||
  "Unable to load your order details.";

const getItemName = (item) =>
  item.product?.name ||
  item.productName ||
  item.name ||
  item.sku ||
  "Product";

const getItemLineTotal = (item) =>
  Number(
    item.lineTotal ??
      item.totalPrice ??
      Number(item.unitPrice ?? item.price ?? item.product?.price ?? 0) *
        Number(item.quantity ?? 0)
  );

const OrderConfirmationPage = () => {
  const { orderId } = useParams();

  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const loadOrder = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      setOrder(null);

      try {
        const guestAccessToken = sessionStorage.getItem(
          `${GUEST_ORDER_TOKEN_PREFIX}${orderId}`
        );

        const result = guestAccessToken
          ? await orderService.getGuestOrderConfirmation(
              orderId,
              guestAccessToken
            )
          : await orderService.getMyOrderById(orderId);

        if (!result) {
          throw new Error("Order details could not be found.");
        }

        if (isMounted) {
          setOrder(result);
        }
      } catch (requestError) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setError(getErrorMessage(requestError));
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    if (orderId) {
      loadOrder();
    } else {
      setError("Invalid order reference.");
      setLoading(false);
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [orderId]);

  const renderUnavailableState = (title, message) => (
    <div className="confirmation-card">
      <PackageCheck size={48} />
      <h1>{title}</h1>
      <p>{message}</p>

      <Link to="/shop" className="confirmation-button">
        Continue Shopping
      </Link>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <main className="confirmation-page">
        <div className="confirmation-container">
          {loading ? (
            renderUnavailableState(
              "Loading Your Order",
              "Please wait while we retrieve your order details."
            )
          ) : error || !order ? (
            renderUnavailableState(
              "Order Details Unavailable",
              error ||
                "This order could not be found. Please check your order history."
            )
          ) : (
            <div className="confirmation-card">
              <div className="confirmation-icon">
                <CheckCircle2 size={48} />
              </div>

              <span className="checkout-eyebrow">
                NEXAMART ORDER
              </span>

              <h1>Thank You for Your Order!</h1>

              <p>
                Your order has been successfully placed.
              </p>

              <div className="confirmation-order-number">
                <span>Order Reference</span>
                <strong>{order.orderNumber || order._id}</strong>
              </div>

              <div className="confirmation-details">
                <div>
                  <span>Customer</span>
                  <strong>
                    {order.customer?.fullName || "Customer"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Order Status</span>
                  <strong>
                    {getOrderStatusLabel(order.status)}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Order Date</span>
                  <strong>
                    {formatOrderDate(order.createdAt)}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Payment Method</span>
                  <strong>
                    {order.paymentMethod === "cod"
                      ? "Cash on Delivery"
                      : "Online Payment"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Delivery Method</span>
                  <strong>
                    {order.deliveryMethod === "standard"
                      ? "Standard Delivery"
                      : order.deliveryMethod}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>Product Subtotal</span>
                  <strong>
                    {formatOrderPrice(order.subtotal)}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="confirmation-order-items">
                <h3>Ordered Products</h3>

                {(order.items || []).map((item, index) => (
                  <div
                    className="confirmation-item"
                    key={item._id || item.sku || index}
                  >
                    <span>
                      {getItemName(item)} Ã— {item.quantity}
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {formatOrderPrice(getItemLineTotal(item))}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="confirmation-order-total">
                <span>Order Total</span>
                <strong>
                  {formatOrderPrice(order.total)}
                </strong>
              </div>

              <p className="confirmation-note">
                Your order has been securely saved. Delivery charges
                will be confirmed before dispatch.
              </p>

              <Link to="/shop" className="confirmation-button">
                Continue Shopping
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default OrderConfirmationPage;

========== frontend/src/features/checkout/utils/checkoutValidation.js ==========

const validateCheckoutForm = (values) => {
  const errors = {};

  if (!values.fullName.trim()) {
    errors.fullName = "Full name is required.";
  } else if (values.fullName.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.fullName = "Please enter a valid full name.";
  }

  if (!values.email.trim()) {
    errors.email = "Email address is required.";
  } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email)) {
    errors.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
  }

  const phone = values.phone.replace(/\D/g, "");

  if (!values.phone.trim()) {
    errors.phone = "Phone number is required.";
  } else if (phone.length < 10 || phone.length > 15) {
    errors.phone = "Please enter a valid phone number.";
  }

  if (!values.addressLine1.trim()) {
    errors.addressLine1 = "Street address is required.";
  }

  if (!values.city.trim()) {
    errors.city = "City is required.";
  }

  if (!values.province.trim()) {
    errors.province = "Province is required.";
  }

  if (!values.postalCode.trim()) {
    errors.postalCode = "Postal code is required.";
  }

  return errors;
};

export default validateCheckoutForm;


========== frontend/src/features/orders/services/orderService.js ==========
import apiClient from "../../../lib/apiClient.js";

const getResponseData = (response) => response.data?.data;

const getMyOrders = async () => {
  const response = await apiClient.get("/orders/my-orders");

  return getResponseData(response)?.orders ?? [];
};

const getMyOrderById = async (orderId) => {
  const response = await apiClient.get(`/orders/${orderId}`);

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const getGuestOrderConfirmation = async (orderId, accessToken) => {
  const response = await apiClient.post(
    `/orders/guest/${orderId}/confirmation`,
    { accessToken }
  );

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const createOrder = async ({
  customer,
  items,
  deliveryMethod = "standard",
  paymentMethod = "cod",
}) => {
  const payload = {
    customer,
    items: items.map(({ product, quantity }) => ({
      sku: product.sku || product.id,
      quantity,
    })),
    deliveryMethod,
    paymentMethod,
  };

  const response = await apiClient.post("/orders", payload);

  const result = getResponseData(response);

  if (!result?.order) {
    throw new Error("Order could not be created. Please try again.");
  }

  return result;
};

const cancelOrder = async (orderId, reason) => {
  const response = await apiClient.patch(
    `/orders/${orderId}/cancel`,
    { reason }
  );

  return getResponseData(response)?.order ?? null;
};

const orderService = {
  createOrder,
  getMyOrders,
  getMyOrderById,
  getGuestOrderConfirmation,
  cancelOrder,
};

export default orderService;

========== frontend/src/features/orders/hooks/useOrders.js ==========
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import orderService from "../services/orderService";

const useOrders = () => {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const refreshOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result = await orderService.getMyOrders();

      setOrders(Array.isArray(result) ? result : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err.response?.data?.message ||
          err.message ||
          "Unable to load your orders."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshOrders();
  }, [refreshOrders]);

  return {
    orders,
    loading,
    error,
    refreshOrders,
  };
};

export default useOrders;

========== frontend/src/features/cart/pages/CartPage.jsx ==========

import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";

import MainLayout from "../../../layouts/MainLayout";
import useShopStore from "../../../store/useShopStore";

import CartItem from "../components/CartItem";
import CartSummary from "../components/CartSummary";

import "../cart.css";

export default function CartPage() {
  const cartItems = useShopStore((state) => state.cartItems);
  const updateQuantity = useShopStore(
    (state) => state.updateQuantity
  );
  const removeFromCart = useShopStore(
    (state) => state.removeFromCart
  );

  const totalItems = cartItems.reduce(
    (total, item) => total + item.quantity,
    0
  );

  const subtotal = cartItems.reduce(
    (total, item) =>
      total + Number(item.product.price || 0) * item.quantity,
    0
  );

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <section className="cart-page">
        <div className="cart-page__container">
          <div className="cart-page__heading">
            <div>
              <span className="cart-page__eyebrow">
                YOUR SHOPPING BAG
              </span>

              <h1>Shopping Cart</h1>

              <p>
                Review your selected products before checkout.
              </p>
            </div>

            <Link to="/shop" className="cart-page__back">
              Continue Shopping
            </Link>
          </div>

          {cartItems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="cart-empty">
              <div className="cart-empty__icon">
                <ShoppingBag size={34} />
              </div>

              <h2>Your cart is empty</h2>

              <p>
                Discover something you love and add it to your bag.
              </p>

              <Link to="/shop" className="cart-empty__button">
                Explore Products
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="cart-layout">
              <div className="cart-items">
                <div className="cart-items__header">
                  <h2>Your Items</h2>
                  <span>{totalItems} items</span>
                </div>

                {cartItems.map((item) => (
                  <CartItem
                    key={item.product.id}
                    item={item}
                    onUpdateQuantity={updateQuantity}
                    onRemove={removeFromCart}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>

              <CartSummary
                subtotal={subtotal}
                totalItems={totalItems}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}
